fees.name: Tourist visa (embassy/consulate sticker visa)
fees.validity: 3 months validity, 1 month stay, single entry
fees.notes: Fee published by Afghanistan Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Applications go through the e-consulate portal (econsulate.mfa.gov.af) and are collected at Afghan embassies/consulates. Fees can vary slightly by mission.

fees.name: Tourist e-visa (E-Afghans portal, launched March 2026)
fees.validity: 90 days validity from issue, 30 days stay, single entry, Kabul International Airport entry only
fees.notes: USD 8 non-refundable application fee paid upfront, then USD 120 visa fee plus ~3% payment processing charge (~USD 3.71) after approval; total ~USD 128-132. E-Afghans portal (eafghans.com) is the official application site but was not directly fetchable at time of research; fee figures corroborated by multiple independent reports of the portal's published schedule, so marked official:false pending direct verification.

fees.name: Business visa (multiple entry)
fees.validity: 3 months multiple entry at USD 40; 6 months USD 80; 1 year USD 160; 2 years USD 250; 3 years USD 300
fees.notes: Tiered by validity: USD 40 (3-month) to USD 300 (3-year), payable in USD or Afghani equivalent. Extension: USD 15 per month up to one year. Requires business licence, passport copy, bank statements.

fees.name: Arrival visa (Kabul International Airport, invitation-based)
fees.notes: Arrival visas exist but require prior MFA approval and an official invitation; they are not a walk-up tourist VOA. MFA page cites fees per Article 27 of the Travel and Residence Law without publishing an amount, so amount left null.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.validity: up to 72 hours (per general visa-type descriptions)
fees.notes: Transit visa is listed among official visa categories, but no fee amount is published on the MFA type page; amount left null rather than estimated.

AFG.free_visa_notes: Visas are not free in general. Some third-party sources report gratis visas for Indian nationals under reciprocity, but this could not be verified on an official Afghan government source, so it is not recorded as a reciprocity variation. Visit visa (relatives/sports/exhibitions) is USD 80-240 depending on duration per MFA (https://mfa.gov.af/en/page/39001).

fees.name: Tourist visa (embassy-issued)
fees.notes: Fee published by the Embassy of Angola in Washington DC; consular fees can differ by embassy. Proof of subsistence means (~USD 200/day) required.

fees.name: e-Visa / pre-approved visa on arrival (SME e-Visa portal)
fees.notes: Applied via the official SME e-Visa portal (smevisa.gov.ao); pre-approval issued online, visa collected and paid at the border in USD or kwanza. The fee is not published on a publicly accessible official page (third-party sites report ~USD 120), so amount is left null rather than guessed.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (with online pre-approval)
fees.notes: Paid at dedicated e-Visa counters at the port of entry in USD or kwanza. Amount not verifiable on an official public page (unofficial sources cite USD 120); left null per accuracy rules.

fees.name: Ordinary (business) visa
fees.validity: up to 30 days per stay, extendable
fees.notes: Embassy of Angola (Washington DC) fee for ordinary/business visa for US applicants; processing 5-8 business days. Short-term visa is USD 80 at the same mission.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Requires yellow fever vaccination certificate and proof of onward travel.

vfs.note: VFS Global operates Angola visa application centres in some countries (e.g. Nigeria, visa.vfsglobal.com/nga/en/ago); the service fee is set per centre and the page was not publicly accessible to verify an amount. Many other corridors still apply directly to Angolan embassies.

AGO.free_visa_notes: Since late 2023 Angola grants visa-free entry for tourism to citizens of ~98 countries (incl. USA, UK, Canada, EU, China, Russia and others) for up to 30 days per trip and 90 days per calendar year (Presidential Decree 189/23). Confirmed for US citizens by travel.state.gov. Nationals not on the exemption list (e.g. India, Nigeria, Pakistan, Philippines, Bangladesh generally) still need a visa. No fee for diplomatic/official/courtesy visas.

fees.name: Type C short-stay visa (single entry) via e-visa.al
fees.notes: All Albanian visas are applied for online at e-visa.al; there is no separate e-visa vs sticker fee. Fees are set per nationality by Council of Ministers Decision (VKM) No. 329, dated 29.05.2024 - schedule ranges from gratis (e.g. Algeria, Palestine, China) to EUR 100 (e.g. Belarus, Kazakhstan). EUR 35 is the fallback rate where no reciprocity fee is set. Minors aged 6-12 pay half the adult fee.

fees.name: Type C short-stay visa (two entries)
fees.notes: Two-entry and multiple-entry fees vary widely by nationality (e.g. Nigeria: EUR 25 single / EUR 40 two-entry / EUR 80 multiple). No single amount applies; see reciprocity_variations and the official VKM 329/2024 schedule.

fees.name: Type A airport transit visa
fees.notes: The VKM 329/2024 schedule lists Type A airport-transit fees per nationality alongside Type C; default EUR 35 where no reciprocity rate exists. Applied via e-visa.al.

fees.name: Type C short-stay visa for business purposes
fees.notes: Albania has no separate business-visa fee; business travel uses the Type C visa at the same nationality-based tariff as tourism.

variations.note: Type C single/two/multiple entry all EUR 15 (apply at Beijing, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul missions via e-visa).
China: short-stay Type C not listed (visa-free for short stays); Type D long-stay visa is gratis.
Single entry EUR 25; two entries EUR 40; multiple entries EUR 80.
Single entry EUR 20; two/multiple entries EUR 35.
Single, two and multiple entries all EUR 30.
Single entry EUR 25; two entries EUR 40; multiple entries EUR 80.
Single entry EUR 30; two/multiple entries EUR 50. (Russians are visa-free during the summer season under Albania's seasonal exemption when in force.)
US, UK and Canadian citizens do not require a visa for short stays (not in the visa-required schedule); US citizens may stay up to one year.

ALB.free_visa_notes: Most Western, EU, Gulf-resident and many other nationalities enter Albania visa-free for 90 days (US citizens up to 1 year). Holders of valid multiple-entry Schengen visas (previously used), or valid US/UK/EU residence permits, enter visa-free. Some visa-required nationalities pay no fee: Algeria and Palestine are gratis for all visa types; China's Type D is gratis. Saudi and Qatari citizens are visa-free for tourism 15 Apr-31 Dec 2026. Albania is NOT a Schengen member, so the Schengen fee does not apply.

fees.name: De facto: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) via France or Spain
fees.validity: up to 90 days in 180 (Schengen); Andorra itself imposes no limit via visa
fees.notes: Andorra issues no visas of its own. Entry is only possible through France or Spain, so the standard Schengen visa fee (EUR 90 adults, EUR 45 children 6-11, since 11 June 2024) applies de facto for visa-required nationalities. Apply at a French or Spanish consulate/visa centre.

AND.free_visa_notes: Andorra does not require or issue any visa for entry (official Govern d'Andorra position); a passport (or EU national ID card) suffices. However, Andorra is landlocked between France and Spain and is not in the Schengen Area, so visa-required nationalities need a double- or multiple-entry Schengen visa (EUR 90) from France or Spain to reach and leave Andorra.

fees.name: Single-entry tourist (visit) visa - 30 days
fees.notes: Base government fee AED 252, plus 5% VAT. GDRFA-Dubai published rate; fees are consistent across UAE federal ICP system but sponsor/typing-centre service charges add to the total actually paid by applicants.

fees.name: Single-entry tourist (visit) visa - 60 days
fees.notes: Base government fee AED 352, plus 5% VAT. Additional charges of AED 10 Knowledge Dirham + AED 10 Innovation Dirham apply, and AED 500 extra if applicant is already inside the UAE.

fees.name: 96-hour transit visa
fees.notes: 48-hour transit visa is issued free of charge for eligible transit passengers; the 96-hour transit visa carries the AED 50 government fee. Airline/agent service charges may apply on top.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: UAE grants many nationalities free entry permits/visa-on-arrival (e.g. most GCC-adjacent and many eligible passport holders receive a free 30/90-day stamp). No separate official fee schedule for a distinct 'visa on arrival' product was found beyond the standard tourist visa fees above; could not verify a specific paid VOA amount on an official source.

fees.name: Electronic travel authorisation
fees.notes: UAE does not operate a separate eTA scheme distinct from its e-visa/entry-permit system; no official eTA fee found.

fees.name: Business/multi-entry visit visa
fees.notes: ICP/GDRFA publish per-service fee cards for multiple-entry and business visit visas but the exact current AED amount could not be independently verified on an official page in this session; left null rather than guessed.

ARE.free_visa_notes: UAE grants visa-free or free-of-charge visa-on-arrival entry to a large number of nationalities (varies by passport, typically 30-90 days). For nationalities that do require a paid visa, the standard tourist visa fees above (AED 252 for 30 days / AED 352 for 60 days, plus 5% VAT) apply via GDRFA/ICP sponsorship, most commonly arranged through airlines, hotels, or UAE-based sponsors rather than a self-service consumer e-visa portal.

fees.name: Tourist visa (consular)
fees.notes: Consular fee is USD 150 or EUR 150 depending on the consular office; payable in local currency of the post. Some embassy schedules (e.g. Embassy in Vietnam) still publish lower legacy amounts, so confirm at the specific consulate.

fees.name: AVE - Autorizacion de Viaje Electronica (electronic travel authorization)
fees.validity: 3 months from issue; 90-day stay, multiple entry, one extension possible
fees.notes: Fee stated as USD 400 on the official Embassy of Argentina in Singapore page; applied for via migraciones.gob.ar/ave. Processing up to 20 business days. Chinese citizens with a valid US visa/green card and Indian/Dominican nationals with equivalent US visas are exempt from needing the AVE for tourism.

fees.name: Business visa (consular, transitory)
fees.notes: Per Embassy of Argentina in Vietnam transitory-visa schedule: business USD 100; market survey / trade fair USD 50; technical/professional USD 100 (USD 50 for religious activity). Amounts may vary by consular post.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No visa needed if departing within 12 hours of arrival with onward ticket and declared as a transit traveller (must remain in the airport/station). Fee per Embassy in Vietnam schedule; may vary by post.

ARG.free_visa_notes: Nationals of ~90 countries (US, EU, UK, Canada, most of Latin America, etc.) enter visa-free for up to 90 days. The former 'reciprocity fee' for US, Canadian and Australian citizens has been abolished. No fee for visa-exempt travellers.

fees.name: E-Visa — Visitor visa (up to 21 days of stay)
fees.validity: Single entry, up to 21 days of stay
fees.notes: Non-refundable fee, published on the official MFA e-visa portal as USD 8 (equivalent to AMD 3,000 in the MFA consular fee table). Extension possible up to 60 extra days at the Migration and Citizenship Service.

fees.name: E-Visa — Visitor visa (up to 120 days of stay)
fees.validity: Single entry, up to 120 days of stay
fees.notes: Non-refundable. Portal lists USD 38; MFA consular fee table lists AMD 15,000 / USD 39 for the same category at embassies.

fees.name: Visitor visa at embassy/consulate (up to 21 days of stay)
fees.notes: MFA consular fee table valid from 1 Jan 2026: AMD 3,000 / USD 8 / EUR 7 / RUB 700. Non-refundable.

fees.name: Visitor visa at embassy/consulate (up to 120 days of stay)
fees.notes: AMD 15,000 / USD 39 / EUR 34 / RUB 3,300. Non-refundable.

fees.name: Multiple-entry visitor visa (up to 60 days of stay, 6-month validity)
fees.validity: Multiple entry, 6 months, up to 60 days of stay
fees.notes: AMD 20,000 / USD 52 / EUR 46 / RUB 4,500. Non-refundable.

fees.name: Multiple-entry visitor visa (up to 120 days of stay, 1-year validity)
fees.validity: Multiple entry, 1 year, up to 120 days of stay
fees.notes: AMD 40,000 / USD 103 / EUR 91 / RUB 8,700. Non-refundable.

fees.name: Single-entry transit visa
fees.notes: AMD 10,000 / USD 26 / EUR 23 / RUB 2,200. Non-refundable.

fees.name: Multiple-entry transit visa (1-year validity)
fees.notes: AMD 18,000 / USD 47 / EUR 41 / RUB 4,000. Non-refundable.

fees.name: Visitor visa on arrival at border crossing points
fees.validity: Single entry, up to 21 days (AMD 3,000) or up to 120 days (AMD 15,000)
fees.notes: State-duty amounts mirror the visitor visa schedule (AMD 3,000 for 21 days, AMD 15,000 for 120 days). The current MFA visa page emphasizes the e-visa route and does not restate VOA amounts explicitly, so this row is corroborated by the MFA consular fee schedule plus secondary sources rather than a dedicated official VOA fee page.

ARM.free_visa_notes: Not free for everyone, but broad exemptions: nationals of many countries are visa-exempt unilaterally or by agreement (EU/EEA, CIS, and others; lists at mfa.am/en/visafreelist and mfa.am/en/whoneedvisa) and may stay up to 180 days per year. Temporary exemption 1 Jul 2026 – 1 Jul 2027 for nationals of 111 countries holding a residence permit (valid 6+ months from entry) issued by the USA, EU/Schengen states, UAE, Bahrain, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait or Oman. Official and diplomatic visas are free. Some nationalities can apply only with an invitation at embassies (invitation state duty AMD 5,000, paid by the inviter).

fees.name: Tourist Visa on Arrival
fees.notes: US$100.00 or equivalent Eastern Caribbean Currency per passenger, including children. Confirmed on the official Department of Immigration site and by the Antigua and Barbuda Consulate General in New York (abconsulate.nyc).

fees.name: Electronic Entry Visa (EEV) - single entry
fees.notes: The official portal displays the exact fee only inside the application flow (official FAQ: 'click Apply... to find out the e-Visa fee'). USD 100 single-entry is consistently corroborated by multiple secondary sources; treat as indicative until confirmed in the portal. Fee is a non-refundable processing fee; expedited processing costs extra.

fees.name: Electronic Entry Visa (EEV) - multiple entry
fees.notes: USD 200 for 1-year multiple-entry EEV, corroborated by multiple secondary sources; official portal shows the fee inside the application flow. Non-refundable processing fee.

fees.name: Consular/sticker visa (legacy paper process)
fees.notes: The official Visa Fees page (immigration.gov.ag/fees/visa-fees/) currently publishes no fee table; visa issuance has largely moved to the eVisa system and visa-on-arrival. No verifiable consular fee amount found on an official source.

ATG.free_visa_notes: Most nationalities (including USA, GBR, CAN, EU, IND per official exempt list) do not need a visa for short tourist stays. Fees above apply only to the relatively small set of visa-required nationalities. No nationality-based reciprocity fee schedule is published; VOA and e-visa fees are flat for all visa-required nationals.

fees.name: Visitor visa (subclass 600) - Tourist stream, applied outside Australia
fees.validity: Stays of up to 3, 6 or 12 months as granted
fees.notes: Base application charge from 1 July 2026 (was AUD 200). Verified via Home Affairs GetPriceList API (subclass 600-29B). Onshore (in-Australia) application is AUD 630. Frequent Traveller stream (eligible passports, e.g. CHN) is AUD 1,845; Sponsored Family and Approved Destination Status streams AUD 250. All subclass 600 applications are lodged online via ImmiAccount or on paper via an Australian Visa Application Centre.

fees.name: Visitor visa (subclass 600) - Business Visitor stream
fees.notes: Base application charge from 1 July 2026 (subclass 600-31). ETA/eVisitor-eligible passports use those free/cheap options for business visitor activities instead.

fees.name: eVisitor (subclass 651)
fees.validity: 12 months, multiple entries, up to 3 months per stay
fees.notes: Free - AUD 0.00 confirmed via Home Affairs price list API. Tourism or business visitor purposes.

fees.name: Electronic Travel Authority (subclass 601)
fees.validity: 12 months (or until passport expiry), multiple entries, up to 3 months per stay
fees.notes: No visa application charge (AUD 0.00 in Home Affairs price list); AUD 20 service fee payable in the Australian ETA app, confirmed on official Australian High Commission page. Apply only via the official Australian ETA mobile app.

fees.name: Transit visa (subclass 771)
fees.notes: Free - AUD 0.00 confirmed via Home Affairs price list API.

variations.note: UK and European passport holders use the free eVisitor (651) instead of paying the AUD 250 subclass 600 charge.
US and Canadian passport holders use the ETA (601): no visa charge, AUD 20 app service fee.

Not ETA/eVisitor-eligible; must apply for the Visitor visa (subclass 600) at AUD 250 offshore. This is nationality-based eligibility routing, not a reciprocity fee schedule - the subclass 600 charge itself is the same for all nationalities. China additionally has access to the Frequent Traveller stream (AUD 1,845, up to 10-year validity).

vfs.operator: VFS Global (Australian Visa Application Centres; TT Services in some regions)
vfs.note: Applications are normally lodged online via ImmiAccount, but biometrics collection and optional paper lodgement/assisted services go through Australian Visa Application Centres run by VFS Global (e.g. India) or TT Services. Service fees vary by centre and service; third-party sources cite roughly INR 2,000-2,500 for biometric collection in India, but no exact amount could be verified on an official VFS/government page, so amount left null.

AUS.free_visa_notes: Australia requires an authority to travel for all non-citizens, but eVisitor (651, European passports) and Transit visa (771) are free, and the ETA (601) costs only a AUD 20 app service fee. Everyone else pays AUD 250 for the offshore Visitor visa (600) from 1 July 2026.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - adult
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Standard EU-wide Schengen visa fee (EUR 90 since 11 June 2024). Children 6-12: EUR 45; under 6: free. Austrian Consulate General New York lists USD 103 (adult) / USD 52 (child 6-12), collected in local currency at consulates/VFS.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - business purpose
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Business travel uses the same Type C Schengen visa and fee as tourism; there is no separate business visa fee.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.notes: Type A airport transit visa carries the same fee as Type C under the EU Visa Code.

fees.name: National visa (Type D, 91 days - 6 months) - adult
fees.validity: 91 days to 6 months (longer stays not covered by Schengen C)
fees.notes: Austrian national Visa D fee raised from EUR 150 to EUR 195 (adults) / EUR 97 (children under 6) effective 1 July 2025, per Austrian Embassy London. NY consulate lists USD 223 / USD 111. Included because tourists staying >90 days use Visa D; long-term residence/work permits excluded.

fees.name: e-Visa
fees.notes: Austria has no e-visa; applications are lodged in person at embassies/consulates or VFS Global centres. From late 2026/2027 the EU ETIAS authorisation (EUR 20, ages 18-70) will apply to visa-exempt travellers, but it was not yet in force as of this record date.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: Austria does not issue visas on arrival; a Schengen visa must be obtained before travel.

variations.note: EU visa facilitation agreement rate (~EUR 35; NY consulate lists USD 40). The EU-Russia facilitation agreement is fully suspended since Sep 2022, so Russian citizens now pay the standard EUR 90; the reduced rate still applies to other facilitation-agreement countries (e.g. Armenia, Azerbaijan, Albania non-biometric). IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, CAN all pay the standard EUR 90 - no reciprocity discounts.

vfs.note: Typical published VFS Global service charge for Austria in India is around INR 2,479 (~EUR 27); service fees vary by country/centre, generally in the EUR 25-45 range, plus optional add-ons (courier, premium lounge). Payable in local currency at the centre.

AUT.free_visa_notes: Austria is a Schengen member; citizens of EU/EEA, Switzerland and ~60 visa-exempt countries (USA, GBR, CAN, JPN, etc.) enter visa-free for 90/180 days at no cost (until ETIAS EUR 20 comes into force). Visa fee waived for children under 6, and under the EU Visa Code for certain categories (researchers, some students on trips, representatives of non-profits aged <=25 attending events).

fees.name: ASAN Visa e-visa (standard, 3 working days)
fees.validity: 90 days validity, single entry, up to 30 days stay
fees.notes: USD 20 state fee + USD 5 mandatory service fee = USD 25 total on the official evisa.gov.az portal (portal itself is bot-protected; state-fee amount confirmed on Embassy of Azerbaijan Washington page).

fees.name: ASAN Visa e-visa (urgent, 3 hours)
fees.validity: 90 days validity, single entry, up to 30 days stay
fees.notes: USD 50 state fee + USD 10 service fee = USD 60 total; urgent e-visa issued within 3 hours including holidays.

fees.name: Single-entry visa (embassy sticker visa, incl. tourist)
fees.validity: typically up to 90 days, single entry
fees.notes: Standard state fee is USD 20 for nearly all nationalities per the MFA country fee schedule; EU-member-state citizens pay EUR 35 under the EU-Azerbaijan visa facilitation agreement (also 35 EUR for Switzerland and Norway); UK/Iceland/Ireland pay GBP 18 at the London embassy.

fees.name: Multiple-entry visa (business, private visit, etc.)
fees.validity: multiple entry, duration per visa category
fees.notes: Current schedule per Law on State Fee (arts 16.1.6-16.1.7) quoted on official VFS Azerbaijan pages: USD 160 general multiple-entry; USD 185 for US citizens (per LA Consulate General), USD 190 for US work visas, USD 150 for South Korea, USD 200 for Pakistan. Some older embassy PDFs (Washington) still list USD 350 for multiple-entry - the 160/185 figures are the more recent published schedule.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: USD 20 per the VFS Global Azerbaijan (Egypt) official fee table.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: Visa issuance upon arrival is suspended until further notice (per Embassy of Azerbaijan in Washington); no current fee published. Travellers use the ASAN e-visa instead.

variations.note: Multiple-entry visa fee for US citizens is USD 185 (USD 190 for multiple-entry work visa) per Consulate General in Los Angeles; single-entry USD 20.
Multiple-entry visa fee for Pakistani citizens is USD 200 per VFS/MFA published schedule; single-entry USD 20.
London embassy charges GBP 18 single-entry (GBP 300 multiple-entry) for UK, Iceland and Ireland citizens.
Standard USD 20 single-entry state fee per MFA country fee schedule; all are also e-visa eligible (USD 25).
Russian citizens do not need a visa for Azerbaijan (bilateral visa-free regime), hence absent from the fee schedule.

vfs.note: Azerbaijan routes embassy visa applications through VFS Global in at least Iraq (service charge USD 25 cash per application) and Egypt (EGP 1265 incl. VAT per application); service fees vary by centre. VFS Global is also the authorised partner for the Azerbaijan e-visa (azerbaijan.vfsevisa.com).

AZE.free_visa_notes: Citizens of several countries (e.g. Russia, Turkey, Georgia, most CIS states) enter Azerbaijan visa-free under bilateral agreements and pay no fee.

fees.name: Entry visa (simple entry, online via migration.gov.bi)
fees.notes: Applied online on the official CGM portal; same fee schedule as visas obtained at embassies or on arrival.

fees.name: Entry visa - multiple entry
fees.notes: Obtainable online, at the airport, or through Burundian embassies.

fees.name: Airport entry visa (visa d'entree aeroport)
fees.notes: CGM portal lists 'Visa d'entree aeroport' as a service; entry-visa tariff is USD 90 per the official fee table. Pre-application online is encouraged.

fees.name: Business travel (uses standard entry visa)
fees.notes: Burundi does not publish a separate business-visa category; business travellers use the standard simple/multiple entry visa (USD 90). Stay extension: USD 10 per 5 days (max 25 days), then USD 70 per month.

variations.note: East African Community citizens: free EAC visa/pass valid 6 months per official CGM tariff table.

BDI.free_visa_notes: Visas are not free generally; EAC member-state citizens receive a free 6-month EAC entry pass and free student visas.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C), adults and children 12+
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Children 6-12 pay EUR 45; children under 6 free. Fee waivers for pupils/students on study trips, researchers, non-profit event participants aged 25 or under, and certain diplomatic passport holders. Paid in EUR (or local-currency equivalent) at submission; non-refundable.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C) for business purposes
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Same uniform Schengen C-visa fee; no separate business-visa category or price.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (type A)
fees.notes: Uniform Schengen Visa Code fee applies to type A airport transit visas.

fees.name: ETIAS travel authorisation (EU-wide, covers Belgium)
fees.notes: Not yet in operation as of 2026-07-02; expected to start in late 2026 after the EU Entry/Exit System. Free for under-18s and over-70s.

fees.name: E-visa
fees.notes: Belgium does not issue e-visas; Schengen visas are sticker visas applied for at embassies/consulates or outsourced centres.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: Belgium does not offer visa on arrival; visas must be obtained before travel (exceptional border visas aside).

variations.note: EU-Russia visa facilitation agreement (EUR 35 fee) is suspended since 2022; Russian nationals pay the standard EUR 90 Schengen fee.

Reduced fee under EU visa facilitation agreements (also covers e.g. Albania/Bosnia nationals not exempt). None of the key tracked nationalities (IND, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD) benefit - they pay the standard EUR 90.

vfs.note: India: INR 2,700 per application incl. 18% GST (Mumbai centre INR 2,750); optional courier ~INR 760. Service fees vary by country/centre - typically roughly EUR 25-35 equivalent. Belgium also uses TLScontact in some countries.

BEL.free_visa_notes: Visa-exempt nationalities (EU/EEA, USA, GBR, CAN, JPN and other Annex II countries) currently enter free for short stays; the EUR 20 ETIAS authorisation will apply once operational. Note: from 1 July 2026 the Belgian long-stay (type D) handling fee rises to EUR 250, but long-stay permits are out of scope for this record.

fees.name: e-Visa, 30 days, single entry
fees.notes: Official portal evisa.bj (redirects to evisa-ng.gouv.bj). Fee schedule from the portal's 'Les couts des visas d'entree au Benin' article: 50 EUR (approx 32,798 FCFA). Portal blocked direct fetch; amount corroborated by MFA honorary-consulate fiche (embassy-assisted rate 60 EUR = 50 + 10 EUR service surcharge).

fees.name: e-Visa, 30 days, multiple entry
fees.notes: Approx 49,197 FCFA. Embassy-assisted applications (no bank card) pay 85 EUR (10 EUR surcharge).

fees.name: e-Visa, 90 days, multiple entry
fees.notes: Approx 65,596 FCFA. Embassy-assisted applications pay 110 EUR (10 EUR surcharge).

fees.name: Embassy-assisted e-visa (traveller without bank card)
fees.validity: 30 days single entry (85 EUR for 30-day multiple, 110 EUR for 90-day multiple)
fees.notes: Benin has abolished sticker visas: visa applications are exclusively electronic (per beninembassy.us). Embassies only assist with e-visa filing for a fixed 10 EUR service fee, bringing totals to 60/85/110 EUR.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: No visa on arrival: the Benin visa application is done exclusively electronically via the official e-visa platform; visa must be obtained before travel.

BEN.free_visa_notes: Citizens of all African countries and territories are visa-exempt for stays up to 90 days (ECOWAS/UEMOA free movement extended to all of Africa), so IND/USA/GBR/CHN/RUS/etc. pay the flat EUR e-visa fees while NGA and other African nationals enter free. Fees are flat by visa type with no nationality-based reciprocity schedule. Confidence marked medium because the official portal (evisa-ng.gouv.bj) refused automated fetches; the 50/75/100 EUR schedule was confirmed via the portal's indexed fee article and the Benin MFA honorary-consulate information sheet (which documents the +10 EUR embassy-assisted totals of 60/85/110 EUR).

fees.name: Short-stay tourist visa, single entry (eVisa Burkina)
fees.notes: Applied online via the official visaburkina.bf portal or through an embassy; hotel reservation required. Fee published as 33,000 F CFA.

fees.name: Business visa, single entry
fees.notes: Multiple entry business visa: 93,500 F CFA. Conference/studies/training/visit visa: 55,000 F CFA single / 71,500 F CFA multiple. Cooperation visa: 44,000 F CFA single / 79,500 F CFA multiple.

fees.name: Express visa (emergency travel, single entry)
fees.notes: Expedited processing for emergency travel.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: For layovers/transit; can be applied for via the eVisaBurkina portal.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (airport and land borders)
fees.notes: US Embassy Ouagadougou states visas not obtained in advance cost 94,000 F CFA (approx USD 190) at the port of entry. Not published on the visaburkina.bf tariff pages; verify at the border. Significantly more expensive than the e-visa.

fees.name: Embassy-issued visa (Embassy of Burkina Faso, Washington DC)
fees.notes: Per US Embassy guidance, the Burkina Faso Embassy in Washington DC issues a 5-year multiple-entry visa for USD 140. Embassy fees vary by mission.

fees.name: Tourist visa (embassy/consulate sticker visa, MRV)
fees.validity: Varies (typically 3-12 months, single or multiple entry)
fees.notes: Bangladesh sets visa fees strictly by reciprocity, so there is no single tourist-visa fee; see reciprocity_variations. Examples from the Bangladesh Consulate General New York schedule: USA single USD 160, UK single USD 124, China single USD 35, Nigeria single USD 100, Pakistan single USD 4, Philippines single USD 60, Russia single USD 50, Canada single CAD 75, India free. Application form is completed online at the official MRV portal visa.gov.bd, then submitted to a mission; fee list subject to change without notice.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival (30 days, single entry)
fees.validity: Max 30 days, single entry; extendable once by 30 days
fees.notes: Official Special Branch VOA instructions state USD 50 excluding processing fees (or as decided by the authority); payable in cash only at the Sonali Bank PLC counter at the port of entry. Third-party sources report USD/EUR 51 including tax. Issuance is at the discretion of the immigration officer.

fees.name: E-visa
fees.notes: Bangladesh does not offer a true e-visa or eTA. visa.gov.bd is the official Machine Readable Visa (MRV) online application portal: applicants complete the form online, print it, and submit it with fees to a Bangladesh mission or visa office.

fees.name: Business visa (embassy sticker visa)
fees.notes: Business visas use the same nationality-based reciprocity fee schedule as tourist visas at most missions (e.g., USA: multiple-entry employment/long-validity USD 190 at the NY Consulate). No single universal fee exists.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Transit visa fees follow the same nationality-based reciprocity schedule; not verified as a distinct published amount on a central official source, so amount left null.

variations.note: Visa required but issued free of charge for Indian citizens ('VISA REQUIRED WITHOUT FEE'); only the application-centre service fee applies in India (approx INR 825 incl. tax).
Single entry USD 160; multiple-entry/employment USD 190 (Bangladesh Consulate General New York schedule).
Single entry USD 124 (GBP 78); multiple entry USD 124-794 depending on validity.
Single entry USD 35 (approx RMB 200); multiple entry USD 100 (approx RMB 585).
Single entry USD 100; double entry USD 250.
Single entry USD 4 (approx PKR 200); double USD 8; multiple USD 10.
Single entry USD 60; double USD 80; multiple USD 120.
Single or double entry USD 50; multiple entry USD 100. Russian citizens are also VOA-eligible (USD 50).
Single entry CAD 75; multiple entry CAD 150. Canadians are also VOA-eligible (USD 50).
CHF 40 single entry, CHF 80 double/multiple entry (Bangladesh Mission Geneva).

vfs.operator: DU Digital Global (Bangladesh Visa Application Centre, India); no VFS Global/TLScontact for most other countries - applications go direct to missions
vfs.note: In India, Bangladesh visa applications are submitted via Bangladesh Visa Application Centres run by DU Digital Global: service fee INR 699.5 plus taxes (approx INR 825 total). Elsewhere, applicants generally apply directly at Bangladesh embassies/consulates using the visa.gov.bd MRV form; service fees vary by centre.

BGD.free_visa_notes: Visas are not free in general, but Indian citizens receive Bangladesh visas free of charge (reciprocity), paying only the application-centre service fee. Some nationalities are visa-exempt or eligible for the USD 50 visa on arrival.

fees.name: Short-stay Schengen visa (Type C) - tourism/visit
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Bulgaria is a full Schengen member; the standard Schengen short-stay fee of EUR 90 applies. Children 6-11 are exempt from the visa fee per the MFA fees page; children under 6 are visa-fee exempt. Fee is non-refundable if the visa is refused.

fees.name: Short-stay Schengen visa (Type C) - business
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Same Type C fee as tourist; purpose is documented via business supporting documents.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.notes: MFA lists the airport transit fee at EUR 90, same as the short-stay fee.

fees.name: E-visa
fees.notes: Bulgaria does not operate an e-visa; applications are lodged at consulates or outsourced centres (VFS Global). ETIAS (EU-wide travel authorisation for visa-exempt travellers) is not yet in operation as of this record date.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: Bulgaria does not issue visas on arrival except rare humanitarian border cases; visas must be obtained in advance.

variations.note: The EU-Russia visa facilitation agreement (reduced EUR 35 fee) is suspended for ordinary Russian passport holders; the standard EUR 90 Schengen fee applies. VFS Russia additionally charges a service fee of EUR 22.8 incl. VAT, payable in RUB (source: visa.vfsglobal.com/rus/ru/bgr via VFS Contentful data).

No reciprocity discount; standard Schengen Type C fee of EUR 90 applies (children 6-11 exempt per MFA). Visa facilitation agreements with reduced EUR 35 fees exist only for a limited set of countries (e.g. certain Eastern Partnership states) referenced on the MFA fees page.

vfs.service_fee: INR 3080 (India, incl. GST); varies by centre, e.g. THB 1,554 (~EUR 42) Thailand, IDR 615,000 Indonesia, EUR 22.8 Russia, EUR 25 Belarus, MVR 2,070 Maldives
vfs.note: Bulgaria outsources visa applications to VFS Global in 25+ source countries. The published VFS logistics/service fee varies by centre, roughly EUR 22-45 equivalent; India charges INR 3080 VFS Logistics per application plus optional add-ons (SMS INR 420, courier INR 735, lounge INR 3360).

BGR.free_visa_notes: EU/EEA/CH citizens and ~60 visa-exempt nationalities (USA, GBR, CAN, AUS, JPN, etc.) need no visa for stays up to 90/180 days; the EUR 90 fee applies only to visa-required nationalities. Children 6-11 are exempt from the visa fee; children under 6 pay nothing.

fees.name: Tourist eVisa (2 weeks, single entry)
fees.notes: Split payment on evisa.gov.bh: BD 4 non-refundable application fee paid first, BD 9 visa fee paid on approval (total BD 13). Proof of funds required (bank statement, ~BD 300-500/month income).

fees.name: Multiple-entry visitor eVisa (1 year)
fees.validity: 1 year, multiple entry (up to 90 days per stay)
fees.notes: Requires hotel reservation, return ticket, and bank statement.

fees.name: Multi-entry return visa (5 years)
fees.notes: Available only to UK, Irish, Canadian and US nationals.

fees.name: Family visit eVisa
fees.notes: Requires kinship documentation, hotel reservation, return ticket, bank statement.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (2 weeks)
fees.notes: BD 25 is widely published by airline/visa-industry sources for the 2-week VOA at Bahrain International Airport; exact amount could not be confirmed on the fee page of evisa.gov.bh (portal blocks automated access, fees shown at payment step). Eligibility list itself is official.

fees.name: Visit eVisa extension (2 weeks, single entry)
fees.notes: Extension processed within 1 working day.

fees.name: Business visit visa
fees.notes: Business visits are generally covered by the same eVisa/visit-visa fee schedule or NPRA sponsored visas; no separate published business-visa fee was verifiable on official sources.

fees.name: Transit
fees.notes: No separate published transit-visa fee found on official sources; airside transit without entering Bahrain requires no visa. Travellers entering during layovers use the eVisa/VOA.

variations.note: Eligible for the special 5-year multi-entry return visa (BD 50) in addition to standard eVisa options (also Ireland).
eVisa-eligible online; standard fee (BD 4 application + BD 9 visa). Indians with valid US/UK/Schengen visas or GCC residence are also VOA-eligible.
Generally not eligible for unsponsored eVisa/VOA; require a sponsored NPRA visit visa. Fee depends on visa type granted; not published as a flat schedule.

BHR.free_visa_notes: GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council) nationals do not require a visa to enter Bahrain. All other nationalities need an eVisa, visa on arrival, or sponsored visa.

fees.name: Visitor's Visa (eVisa, single entry)
fees.notes: Applied via official MOFA eVisa portal (evisa.mofa.gov.bs); non-refundable. Seaman's visa also USD 160.

fees.name: Multiple entry visa (3 months / 6 months / 1 year)
fees.notes: Non-refundable.

fees.name: Multiple entry visa (3 years)
fees.notes: Not available via the online portal; apply through a mission.

fees.name: Sponsored Visitor Visa facilitation fee
fees.notes: Facilitation fee in addition to applicable visa fee.

fees.name: Visitor visa via consulate (single entry)
fees.notes: Consulates route applicants to the MOFA eVisa system; same fee schedule. Prices may vary for Bahamian visas issued at British Embassies where the UK represents the Bahamas.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No transit visa fee is published on the MOFA eVisa fee schedule; category not listed separately, so amount left null rather than guessed.

BHS.free_visa_notes: Many nationalities (e.g. USA, GBR, CAN, EU) are visa-exempt for tourist stays in the Bahamas; fees above apply only to visa-required nationalities. No fee differences by nationality were found on official sources.

fees.name: Short-stay visa (Type C), single entry
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Fees are set centrally in EUR by BiH regulation but published by each embassy in local currency, so amounts vary by mission: BiH Embassy Washington DC lists USD 39 single / USD 70 multiple; BiH Embassy Amman lists USD 71 for Visa C. The central MFA (mfa.gov.ba) fee schedule was unreachable at time of research. Applicants must apply at a BiH diplomatic/consular mission - there is no e-visa.

fees.name: Short-stay visa (Type C), multiple entry
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period, multiple entries
fees.notes: BiH Embassy Amman also lists USD 71 for multiple-entry Visa C; amounts vary by embassy.

fees.name: Long-stay visa (Type D)
fees.validity: long stay (over 90 days), typically up to 6 months
fees.notes: Type D covers long-stay purposes including business assignments; embassy-issued only. Amount varies by mission.

fees.name: Transit visa (Type B)
fees.notes: Transit visa exists but no fee amount was published on the official embassy pages consulted; amount not verified so left null.

BIH.free_visa_notes: Bosnia and Herzegovina is NOT a Schengen member; Schengen fees do not apply. Citizens of the EU/EEA, USA, UK, and many other countries enter visa-free for up to 90 days. No e-visa or standard visa-on-arrival programme exists; visas are issued at BiH diplomatic missions (border issuance only in exceptional, justified humanitarian cases under BiH law). No published nationality-based reciprocity fee schedule was found; fee differences observed are per-embassy currency conversions rather than reciprocity.

fees.name: Short-term visa type C (embassy sticker, any number of entries)
fees.notes: Single consular fee of EUR 60 applies to all visa types (B transit, C short-term, D long-term) and all entry counts since 1 Jan 2017. Expedited processing (2 working days) doubles the fee to EUR 120. Children under 14 exempt.

fees.name: E-visa (single entry, e-Pasluga portal, launched 20 Mar 2025)
fees.validity: single entry, stay up to 30 days
fees.notes: Same consular fee as sticker visas (EUR 35 for EU citizens, EUR 60 others, free for Japanese citizens) plus a mandatory EUR 6 internet-acquiring/service fee. Processed within 7 calendar days, no visa support documents needed. Cannot be used to enter Belarus via Russia.

fees.name: Airport visa at Minsk National Airport
fees.notes: Base EUR 60 fee increased by 100% (EUR 120 total) if no Belarusian embassy operates in the applicant's country, or by 200% (EUR 180 total) if one does. Prior arrangement via MFA visa support usually required.

fees.name: Short-term visa type C for business (same consular schedule)
fees.notes: Belarus charges one flat consular fee regardless of visa purpose or number of entries; EUR 120 for urgent processing.

fees.name: Transit visa type B
fees.validity: transit, stay up to 2 days per transit
fees.notes: Same flat EUR 60 fee (EUR 120 urgent) as other visa types, confirmed on the Belarus Embassy in India fee table.

variations.note: Reduced EUR 35 rate for all entry-visa types for EU citizens (and stateless persons permanently resident in EST/LVA/LTU) since 1 Jul 2020; children under 12 exempt. Source: https://mfa.gov.by/en/visa/stavki/
Japanese citizens are exempt from the visa consular fee (e-visa page confirms free for Japanese citizens; the EUR 6 e-visa service fee still applies).
Russian citizens do not need a visa for Belarus (Union State / EAEU visa-free regime).

Standard EUR 60 consular rate applies; no reciprocity reduction published for these nationalities. Note: Chinese ordinary-passport holders are visa-exempt under the 2018 BLR-CHN mutual visa-waiver agreement for stays up to 30 days.

vfs.note: Since 1 Oct 2019 Belarusian visa applications from India (Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, Kolkata, Chennai) and some other countries can be lodged via VFS Global; the VFS service fee is charged on top of the EUR 60 consular fee but the current published amount could not be verified (visa.vfsglobal.com/ind/en/blr returned 403). Most applicants elsewhere apply directly at Belarusian embassies.

BLR.free_visa_notes: Belarus operates broad visa-free regimes alongside its visa system: citizens of ~80 states may enter visa-free for up to 30 days via Minsk National Airport, EU/Schengen-country citizens may enter visa-free at any border under a unilateral programme (periodically extended), and RUS/EAEU and Chinese ordinary-passport holders are visa-exempt under bilateral agreements. Fees above apply only to nationalities/routes that still require a visa.

fees.name: Single entry visa (all other nationals)
fees.notes: Fee schedule effective 1 May 2020. BZD pegged 2:1 to USD. Exemption: US permanent residents or holders of a valid US visitor visa do not need a Belize visa.

fees.name: Multiple entry visa (all other nationals)
fees.notes: Fee schedule effective 1 May 2020.

fees.name: Belize eVisa
fees.notes: Official eVisa portal exists (evisa.immigration.gov.bz) but was unreachable at research time and no fee is published on immigration.gov.bz; fee unverified, recorded as null.

variations.note: Single entry BZD 3,000; multiple entry BZD 4,000 (People's Republic of China nationals).
Single entry BZD 750; multiple entry BZD 1,000 (India, Nepal, Thailand, Burma/Myanmar, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Sri Lanka).

BLZ.free_visa_notes: Many nationalities (e.g. USA, GBR, CAN, EU, CARICOM) are visa-exempt for tourist stays. Holders of a valid US visitor visa or US permanent residence are exempt from Belize visa requirements. No visa-on-arrival or eTA regime found on official sources; no separate business or transit visa fee is published (the single/multiple entry visa schedule applies).

fees.name: Visa de Turismo (consulate-issued)
fees.notes: Official consular tariff (Resolucion Ministerial 081, 13 Apr 2015): 'Visas de Turismo, conforme a normativa vigente y reciprocidad' USD 30. The former USD 160 sticker tourist visa for US/Puerto Rico citizens is obsolete: US citizens are visa-exempt since 1 Dec 2025 (Decreto Supremo 5497).

fees.name: Tourist visa on arrival (border/airport, Group II)
fees.notes: Third-party sources widely cite ~USD 95 (BOB 665) paid in cash at the border, vs USD 30 at a consulate, but no current official published amount could be verified; some reports say VOA availability changed in mid-2025. Amount left null per accuracy rules.

fees.name: Visa Multiple (business and investment, multiple entry, 1 year)
fees.notes: Official consular tariff. Related 'Visa de Objeto Determinado' (work/health/family) is USD 85.

fees.name: Visa en Transito
fees.notes: Listed as gratuito (no charge) in the official consular tariff.

variations.note: Visa-exempt (Group I) since 1 Dec 2025 under Decreto Supremo 5497; previously a USD 160 sticker visa applied. 90-day visa-free stay.
Group I visa-exempt for tourism (up to 90 days per year); no fee.
Group II: tourist visa required, USD 30 at a consulate per official tariff; visa on arrival at higher unverified cost may be available.
Visa required with prior authorisation for Group III nationalities; consular fee USD 30 per official tariff. Group assignment should be confirmed with the consulate.

BOL.free_visa_notes: Group I nationalities (incl. US, UK, EU, Canada, Australia, NZ, Russia; expanded 1 Dec 2025 by Decreto Supremo 5497 to add USA, South Korea, Israel, UAE and others) enter visa-free for tourism up to 90 days per year. Transit visa is free of charge for all.

fees.name: Electronic Visitor Visa (e-Visa, VIVIS) - USA/Canada/Australia citizens
fees.validity: Up to 10 years for US citizens (multi-year for Canadian/Australian citizens), stays up to 90 days
fees.notes: Fee of US$80.90 confirmed on official gov.br consulate pages; applications only via the official portal https://brazil.vfsevisa.com (operated by VFS Global). gov.br pages are behind anti-bot protection, so the amount was captured from the official page snippet rather than a full page fetch.

fees.name: Visitor Visa (VIVIS) - tourism, embassy/consulate sticker visa
fees.notes: Base VIVIS consular fee could not be verified verbatim on an accessible official page (gov.br is behind a CAPTCHA/WAF); fee is charged by reciprocity and varies by nationality - confirmed reciprocity exceptions listed in reciprocity_variations (Angola USD 180, Algeria USD 85, China USD 115) from the official VFS Global Brazil visa-application-centre pages.

fees.name: Visitor Visa (VIVIS) - business
fees.notes: Business travel uses the same VIVIS visitor visa and the same reciprocity-based fee schedule as tourism. Base amount unverified on an accessible official page; see reciprocity_variations.

fees.name: Visitor Visa (VIVIS) - transit
fees.notes: Brazil has no separate transit-visa fee schedule; transit falls under the VIVIS visitor visa with the same reciprocity-based fees.

variations.note: e-Visa fee of US$80.90 via the official brazil.vfsevisa.com portal; these are currently the only three nationalities under Brazil's e-visa scheme (reinstated April 2025 after suspension of the visa waiver).
VIVIS reciprocity exception published on official VFS Global Brazil visa application centre page (Lebanon corridor): China USD 115.
VIVIS reciprocity exception: Angola USD 180 (official VFS Global Brazil page).
VIVIS reciprocity exception: Algeria USD 85 (official VFS Global Brazil page).

UK and Russian ordinary-passport holders are visa-exempt for short visits to Brazil (no fee). Indian nationals require a VIVIS; nationality-specific reciprocity amount not verified on an accessible official page - standard VIVIS schedule applies.
Visa-required nationalities on the standard VIVIS schedule; no published reciprocity exception found for them on accessible official pages, amounts not verified so left null (never guessed).

vfs.note: VFS Global runs Brazil visa application centres in multiple source countries (e.g. Lebanon, China, Angola in our data) and also operates the official e-visa portal brazil.vfsevisa.com. Published service charge is USD 13 (incl. tax, cash) at the Lebanon centre; China page publishes 27.8 CNY per application; Angola collects in Kwanza at local exchange rate - service fees vary by centre.

BRA.free_visa_notes: Most nationalities (including the EU/Schengen states, UK, Japan, Russia and most of Latin America) enter Brazil visa-free for tourism/business stays of up to 90 days, so no visa fee applies to them. Brazil is NOT a Schengen member. There is no visa-on-arrival and no eTA scheme; visa-required nationals use an embassy VIVIS visa, except US/Canadian/Australian citizens who use the USD 80.90 e-visa.

fees.name: Entry visa - single entry (online application)
fees.validity: One entry within a three-month period
fees.notes: Also quoted as BDS$200.00. Applications are made online via the Immigration Department portal (apps.immigration.gov.bb); processing about three weeks. Fee payable by postal money order/bank draft for mail applications.

fees.name: Entry visa - multiple entry (online application)
fees.validity: Numerous entries within a six-month period
fees.notes: Also quoted as BDS$400.00. Same fee applies regardless of travel purpose (tourism/business); Barbados does not publish a separate business visa fee.

fees.name: Transit (exemption)
fees.notes: No separate transit visa fee published; cruise ship passengers in transit and crew members transiting within 12 hours are exempt from visa requirements. Other transit travellers who need a visa pay the standard entry visa fee.

BRB.free_visa_notes: Nationals of many countries (incl. USA, GBR, CAN, most of EU/Commonwealth Caribbean) do not require a visa for short stays. Members of the Diplomatic Corps of visa-required countries are exempt from the visa fee. No visa-on-arrival or eTA regime exists; visa-required nationals apply online in advance.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival - single entry (Category C nationalities)
fees.notes: Obtainable at all immigration posts in Brunei; Form 19 distributed on arriving flights.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival - multiple entry (Category C nationalities)
Embassy-issued visit visa - single entry (Brunei Embassy, Washington DC)
fees.notes: Embassy fees are set locally in local currency and vary by mission; payment cash/money order, non-refundable.

fees.name: Embassy-issued visit visa - multiple entry (Brunei Embassy, Washington DC)
Business/professional visit visa (Brunei High Commission, New Delhi)
fees.notes: Same fee as single-entry visit visa at the New Delhi mission.

fees.name: Transit visa (issued at Brunei International Airport only)
fees.notes: MFA page confirms the transit visa (72h, airport only) but does not publish the fee; third-party sources cite ~BND 5, unverified on an official source so amount left null.

variations.note: Short visit visa single entry INR 1,000; multiple entry INR 2,500 at Brunei High Commission New Delhi (mfa.gov.bn/india-newdelhi). Diplomatic/official passports gratis.
USA, UK, Canada and most Western nationalities are visa-exempt for short tourist stays (14-90 days depending on nationality, MFA Category D); no visa fee applies.
Category C nationalities eligible for visa on arrival: BND 20 single / BND 30 multiple entry.

BRN.free_visa_notes: Brunei is not a Schengen member and has no e-visa or eTA. Many nationalities (MFA Category D, incl. USA, UK, EU, most ASEAN) enter visa-free for 14-90 days at no cost. Category C nationalities get visa on arrival (BND 20/30); Categories A/B must apply at a Brunei mission where fees are set in local currency.

fees.name: Tourist visa (online application via Department of Immigration portal)
fees.validity: Single visa covering approved stay; processed within 5 working days
fees.notes: One-time, non-refundable USD 40 application fee. Applied online at https://immi.gov.bt/ or via a licensed tour operator. Separate from the mandatory Sustainable Development Fee (SDF) of USD 100 per adult per night (USD 50 for children 6-11, free under 6), payable with the visa application. Bhutan issues no embassy sticker visas for tourism; all tourist visas are processed online. Bhutan is not a Schengen member.

fees.name: Entry permit for Indian nationals (visa-free, permit at entry or online)
fees.notes: Indian nationals need no visa; an entry permit is issued with no advance fee (passport with 6 months validity or voter ID). They must pay SDF of INR 1,200 per person per night (children 5 and under exempt; 6-12 pay 50%). Day visits (under 24h) to border towns Phuentsholing, Samtse, Gelephu and Samdrup Jongkhar are SDF-exempt.

fees.name: Entry arrangements for Bangladesh and Maldives nationals
fees.notes: Nationals of Bangladesh and the Maldives are exempt from the standard USD 40 visa fee regime under bilateral arrangements; exact permit/visa fee (if any) not published with a specific amount on the official portal, so amount left null rather than estimated. SDF rules for these nationalities are set by government notification.

variations.note: Visa-free; entry permit with no advance fee, but SDF of INR 1,200 per night applies instead of the USD 100 SDF charged to other nationalities.

BTN.free_visa_notes: Not free for most nationalities: USD 40 online visa fee plus mandatory SDF of USD 100/adult/night. Indian nationals enter visa-free on a no-fee permit but pay SDF of INR 1,200/night. There is no separate embassy sticker visa, visa-on-arrival fee (for the general public), eTA, business or transit visa fee schedule published; all entries go through the Department of Immigration online system (immi.gov.bt).

fees.name: Tourist Visa (TV) - embassy sticker visa
fees.validity: typically single entry, up to 3 months
fees.notes: Official Department of Immigration and Citizenship schedule (effective 1 April 2015) published by the Botswana Embassy in Brussels: Tourist Visa BWP 500 (EUR 50). Fees charged in local currency vary by mission; e.g. the Botswana Embassy in Washington DC publishes USD 30 (single entry, up to 1 month) / USD 50 (multiple entry, up to 3 months).

fees.name: e-Visa (evisa.gov.bw)
fees.validity: single entry ~1 month or multiple entry ~3 months
fees.notes: Official portal is https://evisa.gov.bw. The gov.bw tourism-visa page confirms online application (7-14 working days processing) but does not publish the fee; the fee is shown inside the portal at payment. Third-party sources report BWP 300 single-entry / BWP 500 multiple-entry, but this could not be verified on an official page, so amount is left null.

fees.name: Business Visa (BV)
fees.notes: BWP 1500 (EUR 140) per the official 2015 schedule. The Washington DC embassy lists Business Visa at USD 50 (single entry); amounts vary by mission.

fees.name: Transit Visa (TRV)
fees.validity: per travel; gov.bw also lists multiple-entry transit up to 3 months BWP 500 (~USD 50) and beyond 3 months up to 3 years BWP 1000 (~USD 100)
fees.notes: BWP 500 per travel per the official 2015 embassy schedule; gov.bw transit visa page lists BWP 500 (multiple entry up to 3 months), BWP 1000 (up to 3 years), and BWP 1500 (up to 3 years for tour operators/transporters).

BWA.free_visa_notes: Nationals of ~100 countries (incl. USA, UK, EU, most Commonwealth and SADC) enter Botswana visa-free for up to 90 days, so most tourists pay no visa fee. Diplomatic and Official visas are gratis. No visa-on-arrival or eTA regime exists; visa-required nationals must obtain an e-visa or embassy visa in advance.

fees.name: Short-stay visa, single entry (embassy-issued, 30 days)
fees.notes: The CAR embassy in Paris (paris.diplomatie.gouv.cf) publishes the application procedure but no tariff online. EUR 75 for a single-entry 30-day visa is reported by the Bangui M'Poko airport site and consistently by French visa agencies as the fee set by CAR authorities for applications in France. USD ~82 is quoted by US-based agencies. Confirm with the embassy where you apply.

fees.name: Short-stay visa, multiple entry (embassy-issued, 90 days)
fees.notes: EUR 155 multiple-entry 90-day fee widely reported for applications via the CAR Embassy in Paris; not published on an official CAR government page. US agencies quote ~USD 150. Verify with the embassy.

fees.name: Business visa (embassy-issued)
fees.notes: Business travel uses the same short-stay visa category; agencies report the same EUR 75/155 tariff as tourist, but no official published business-specific fee could be verified.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (pre-authorised only)
fees.notes: VOA at Bangui M'Poko is possible only if an express authorization was requested in advance via a CAR diplomatic mission; no published fee. Arriving without a valid visa incurs a 200,000 FCFA (~EUR 300) penalty.

fees.name: E-visa (no official system)
fees.notes: CAR has no official government e-visa as of 2026-07. Sites such as evisa-centrafrique.com are third-party facilitators (operated by a private company), not the official portal, and publish no fee schedule. The embassy in Paris offers online submission of the standard visa application only.

CAF.free_visa_notes: Visa-free entry for nationals of several African states (e.g. Cameroon, Chad, Republic of the Congo, DRC, Benin, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Cote d'Ivoire, Liberia, Niger, Rwanda, Senegal) plus Israel and the United States, per the Bangui airport authority. All other nationalities need an embassy-issued visa; no reciprocity fee schedule by nationality is published.

fees.name: Visitor visa (Temporary Resident Visa), single or multiple entry
fees.validity: Multiple-entry, up to 10 years or passport expiry; stays up to 6 months per entry
fees.notes: Per person; family of 5+ applying together capped at CAD 500. Same fee for single and multiple entry. Biometrics fee of CAD 85 per person (CAD 170 family max) usually applies in addition. Also covers business visitors - Canada has no separate business visa; visa-required business travellers apply for the same visitor visa (CAD 100).

fees.name: Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA)
fees.validity: Up to 5 years or passport expiry
fees.notes: Applied for online on the official IRCC eTA portal only.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No fee for the transit visa; biometrics (if required) are also free for transit visa applicants.

vfs.note: IRCC routes paper/biometrics submissions through VFS Global Visa Application Centres worldwide (find-a-VAC on canada.ca). Core VAC service charge varies by country/centre and could not be verified on an official page at time of writing; published optional-service charges (India schedule, effective 2024) include two-way courier CAD 22.90 / INR 1,365, photo CAD 3.26, premium lounge CAD 63.63. Biometrics fee (CAD 85) is paid to IRCC, not VFS.

CAN.free_visa_notes: Canada charges the same flat visitor-visa fee (CAD 100) to all visa-required nationalities - no reciprocity schedule. Transit visas are free. No visa on arrival and no e-visa program; visa-exempt air travellers need only the CAD 7 eTA.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - adult
fees.validity: Up to 90 days within a 180-day period
fees.notes: Base EUR fee set by Visa Code; local representations bill in local currency (e.g. USD 103 at the US-facing Swiss embassy page, CHF 82 via the Canada fee schedule). Amount adjusted periodically for exchange-rate movement - last Swiss update 31.03.2026 / 01.04.2026.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - child 6-11 years
fees.validity: Up to 90 days within a 180-day period
fees.notes: Half of the adult Schengen fee, per EU Visa Code.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - child under 6
fees.validity: Up to 90 days within a 180-day period
fees.notes: Free of charge.

fees.name: Schengen airport/short-stay transit visa
fees.notes: Switzerland does not publish a separate transit-visa fee; airport/short-stay transit visas are charged at the same standard Schengen visa fee as the short-stay (Type C) visa.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (business purpose)
fees.validity: Up to 90 days within a 180-day period
fees.notes: No separate business-visa fee category; business purpose uses the standard Schengen short-stay fee schedule.

variations.note: Reduced Schengen visa fee (EUR 35, listed as USD 40 on the Swiss US-facing fee page) applies under EU visa-facilitation agreements for citizens of Armenia, Azerbaijan, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Moldova, Serbia and Ukraine.

vfs.note: UNVERIFIED as of 2026-07-02 re-audit: independent checks returned conflicting figures - VFS's own visa-type page for India (visa.vfsglobal.com/ind/en/che/visa-type) returned INR 2,000 via structured extraction, while a July 2025 NDTV report cited a post-hike VFS service charge of INR 2,680 for Switzerland in India; neither matches the previously-recorded INR 2,690, and the one-pager URL previously cited as the source does not reliably render Swiss-visa fee content (it served India-inbound tourist-visa content instead). Set to null pending confirmation directly on VFS Global's live fee calculator for the Switzerland (CHE) India centre. Regardless of exact amount, this VFS logistics/service fee is additional to the Schengen visa fee and varies by country/application centre.

CHE.free_visa_notes: Not applicable generally - Switzerland (as a Schengen member) requires a visa for many nationalities for stays over the visa-free allowance. Visas are issued free of charge for spouses/children of Swiss and EU/EFTA nationals, CERN and UN personnel on official trips, and students on short study stays up to 90 days. Many nationalities (e.g. most of the EU/EFTA, UK, US, Canada, Japan, South Korea, Australia, etc.) do not need any visa at all for short tourist/business stays up to 90 days and pay no fee.

fees.name: Visa de Permanencia Transitoria Simple (single-entry consular tourist/business visa)
fees.validity: single entry, stay up to 90 days (shorter for some nationalities)
fees.notes: Chile has no flat fee: the official 'Cuadro de Aranceles de Visas' sets a per-nationality USD amount (e.g. BGD $10, IND $42, PHL $40, PAK $122, NGA $200; $0 for China, Kazakhstan, Morocco, Tunisia, Palestine). Applied online via SAC (tramites.minrel.gov.cl) and issued by consulates; fee paid only if approved. Covers tourism and business visits. Official PDF: consulado.gob.cl/consulados/site/docs/20190220/20190220161313/cuadro_de_visas_corregido060326.pdf

fees.name: Visa de Permanencia Transitoria Múltiple (multiple-entry consular visa)
fees.validity: multiple entries, stay up to 90 days per entry (shorter for some nationalities)
fees.notes: Multiple-entry fee per Art. 13 of Decreto Supremo N.296/2021 (Ministry of Interior). Examples: BGD $18, IND $76, PHL $88, PAK $202, NGA $208, Lesotho $258. Not available for some nationalities (e.g. Venezuela, Libya, Somalia only get single-entry).

variations.note: Single-entry USD 42 / multiple-entry USD 76, 90 days. EXEMPT from visa if holding a valid US visa (except C) or Green Card with 6+ months validity (since 01.04.2019).
Visa-free, 90 days.
Visa-free, 90 days (incl. British Overseas Territories listed in official table).
Visa required but fee USD 0 (gratis) for single and multiple entry, 90 days. Exempt from visa if holding a US/Canada visa (except transit) or Green Card with 6+ months validity.
Single-entry USD 200 (30-day stay) / multiple-entry USD 208 (60-day stay).
Single-entry USD 122 (30-day stay) / multiple-entry USD 202 (90-day stay).
Single-entry USD 40 (60-day stay) / multiple-entry USD 88 (90-day stay).
Single-entry USD 10 / multiple-entry USD 18, 90 days.
Visa-free, 90 days.
Visa-free, 90 days.

CHL.free_visa_notes: Most Western, Latin American and many Asian nationalities (~100 countries incl. USA, Canada, UK, EU, Australia, Japan, Russia) enter Chile visa-free for up to 90 days with no fee. The old airport 'reciprocity fee' (USD 117-160 for AUS/CAN/USA) was fully abolished (US 2014, Canada 2014, Australia Dec 2019). No e-visa product, no eTA, no visa on arrival; visa-required nationals must obtain the consular Permanencia Transitoria visa in advance. Chile is not a Schengen member.

fees.name: Ordinary visa (L tourist / M business etc.), single entry - base schedule for non-US nationals applying in the US
fees.validity: single entry, typically 3 months to enter
fees.notes: 25% visa-fee reduction officially extended until 31 Dec 2026. Double entry USD 34, 6-month multiple USD 45, 12+ month multiple USD 68. Express service +USD 25. Same schedule applies to business (M) visas - fee depends on entries, not visa category.

fees.name: Ordinary visa for US citizens (any entries, incl. 10-year multiple)
fees.validity: single, double or multiple entry up to 10 years
fees.notes: Flat USD 140 for US citizens regardless of number of entries; reduced rate valid until 31 Dec 2026.

fees.name: Business (M) visa
fees.notes: China prices visas by number of entries, not category: business visa costs the same as tourist on each national schedule.

fees.name: China e-visa (evisa.mfa.gov.cn, launched 2025-26)
fees.notes: China rolled out an online e-visa via the MFA portal; multiple 2026 reports state it is currently free of charge when applied directly on the official portal, but the fee could not be independently verified on an official English page at time of writing - amount left null.

fees.name: Port visa (visa on arrival at designated ports)
fees.validity: short stay, issued at port for urgent/invited travel or tour groups
fees.notes: China issues 'port visas' only in limited urgent/group cases; fee follows the national reciprocity schedule and is published per port - no single nationwide amount, so left null.

fees.name: 240-hour visa-free transit
fees.validity: up to 240 hours (10 days) at designated ports
fees.notes: Visa-free transit carries no fee. Separately, 30-day unilateral visa-free entry applies to 40+ countries (incl. most EU, UK, Japan, Australia, Canada) until at least 31 Dec 2026 - also free.

variations.note: Flat fee for any entry type incl. 10-year multiple; reduced schedule until 31 Dec 2026 (official Chinese Embassy in US).
Single entry INR 2,900; double 4,400; 6-mo multiple 5,900; 1-yr+ multiple 8,800 (official CVASC Delhi fee schedule); CVASC service fee extra.

Fees are set per-country by reciprocity and published in local currency by each Chinese embassy/CVASC (e.g. UK schedule published as an image on visaforchina.cn London and could not be machine-verified). Many of these nationalities also fall under mutual visa exemptions (e.g. Russia-China group exemption, 2025 unilateral trial exemptions). Check local CVASC schedule.

vfs.operator: CVASC (Chinese Visa Application Service Center, official outsourced network; not VFS Global)
vfs.note: China routes most applications through its own CVASC centres. Service fee varies by country/centre; India (Delhi): INR 2,107 regular / INR 3,106 express incl. tax. Other countries publish local-currency service fees on their visaforchina.cn centre page.

CHN.free_visa_notes: China is not visa-free for everyone, but until 31 Dec 2026 it grants unilateral 30-day visa-free entry to nationals of 40+ countries (most of the EU, UK, Japan, South Korea, Australia, NZ, Canada, Brazil, etc.) and 240-hour visa-free transit to 54+ nationalities - both free of charge. A 25% reduction on all consular visa fees also runs until 31 Dec 2026.

fees.name: e-Visa (pre-enrolled biometric visa, collected at Abidjan airport)
fees.notes: EUR 70 dossier fee + EUR 3 online payment commission. SNEDAI is the official government-mandated operator; snedai.com/e-visa is the only official portal. Pre-authorisation emailed, biometric visa issued on arrival at Abidjan airport.

fees.name: Biometric sticker visa (embassy-issued, short stay 1-3 months)
fees.notes: Fee paid online (snedai.com or ci-embassyepay.org depending on mission) before the enrollment appointment. Amount is set per embassy/currency rather than by nationality. Diplomatic and service passport holders are exempt.

fees.name: Biometric sticker visa - business (same fee schedule as short-stay)
fees.notes: Embassies list business, tourism, family visit and study under the same biometric visa fee (EUR 58 at London embassy, EUR 50 at Paris embassy). Long-stay visa at the Canada embassy is CAD 200.

fees.name: Transit
fees.notes: No separately published transit visa fee found on official sources; transit travellers use the standard e-visa (EUR 73) or embassy biometric visa. Airside transit without entry does not require a visa.

CIV.free_visa_notes: Not free in general. Nationals of ECOWAS member states (and some bilateral-agreement countries) enter visa-free. Diplomatic/service passport holders are exempt from the visa fee.

fees.name: Short-stay e-visa (standard processing)
fees.notes: Official ministry fee schedule: 100,000 XAF standard short-stay. Embassies bill local-currency equivalents (e.g. EUR 153 at High Commission London, USD 93 at Embassy Washington). Fees non-refundable even if refused.

fees.name: Short-stay e-visa (express processing)
fees.notes: Express (approx. 24-72h) processing; EUR 229 equivalent published by High Commission London.

fees.name: Tourist/short-stay visa via embassy (Washington DC published fee)
fees.notes: Embassy of Cameroon in Washington DC consular fee schedule; application itself is submitted through the evisacam.cm portal. Long-stay (up to 6 months) USD 184.

fees.name: Transit visa (4-30 days)
fees.notes: Transit not required if continuing on same/next connecting flight with valid passport and onward ticket. XAF equivalent 100,000.

fees.name: Business (short-stay) visa
fees.notes: Business travel uses the short-stay visa category; same tariff as tourist short-stay (100,000 XAF standard / 150,000 XAF express).

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: No general visa-on-arrival regime since the 2023 e-visa rollout; pre-approval via evisacam.cm is required, with the visa sticker issued on arrival at Douala/Yaounde for approved e-visa holders. No separate on-arrival fee verified.

CMR.free_visa_notes: Nationals of CEMAC member states (Chad, CAR, Congo, Gabon, Equatorial Guinea) and Nigeria enter visa-free. No reciprocity-based fee schedule published for other nationalities; the flat XAF tariff applies to all, converted to local currency at each mission. High Commission London notes fee waivers exist for certain applicant categories.

fees.name: Ordinary visa, single entry, 1 month (embassy-issued)
fees.notes: Embassy of the DRC (Washington DC) fee schedule. Single entry: 1 month $100, 2 months $135, 6 months $400. Fees non-refundable.

fees.name: Ordinary visa, multiple entry (embassy-issued)
fees.notes: Multiple entry: 1 month $120, 2 months $150, 3 months $160, 6 months $450.

fees.name: Business visa (embassy-issued, same ordinary-visa fee schedule)
fees.notes: Business travel uses the ordinary visa fee tiers (single entry from $100, multiple entry from $120). US citizens instead pay $185 for a 2-year visa under the US-DRC reciprocity agreement.

fees.name: Airport transit visa
fees.notes: One-way transit $45; round-trip transit $75.

fees.name: e-Visa (evisa.gouv.cd, DGM)
fees.notes: DRC operates an official e-visa portal run by the Direction Generale de Migration (DGM), but the fee schedule is only shown inside the JavaScript application and could not be verified directly; third-party sources cite around $300 online plus the $90 border entry fee (VAP). Amount left null rather than guessed. Related DGM 'visa volant' authorization fees are reported at $250 (ordinary) / $800 (specific) plus $50 file fees.

fees.name: Border entry fee / visa on arrival (VAP - visa aeroportuaire/portuaire)
fees.notes: USD 90 payable in cash at the point of entry (e.g. N'djili International Airport, land/sea borders); mandatory for holders of e-visa/visa volant pre-authorizations. Widely corroborated; official portal FAQ could not be scraped directly (JS-rendered).

variations.note: US-DRC reciprocity agreement: 2-year visa for tourism, study and business at $185 (Embassy of the DRC in Washington DC).

fees.name: Short-stay visa (30 days, normal processing)
fees.notes: Embassy of the Republic of Congo in South Africa publishes a duration-based fee schedule (also payable in ZAR: R1,200). Express service costs $70. Longer validities: 60 days $85, 90 days $110, 365 days $350 (normal); fees are VAT inclusive. Fee schedules vary by issuing embassy/consulate.

fees.name: Visa (Embassy of the Republic of Congo, Washington DC)
fees.notes: Search-engine snippet of the official DC embassy consular fee page cites a $200 visa fee; direct WebFetch of this page failed with an expired TLS certificate so the amount could not be independently re-verified on this run. Diplomatic visas are fee-exempt. Cash or money order only.

fees.name: Republic of Congo e-visa
fees.notes: republic-congo.com appears to be the online visa application portal referenced by third-party visa guides, but the site returned HTTP 403 (CloudFront block) on every fetch attempt during this research session, so its fee amount could not be verified on an official source. Do not treat this domain's ownership/officialness as confirmed.

COG.free_visa_notes: No general visa-free or visa-on-arrival regime identified for entry into the Republic of the Congo; most nationalities require an advance visa. Could not verify a reciprocity fee schedule (by nationality) on an official source in this session.

fees.name: Visitor Visa Type V - Tourism (study USD 56 + issuance USD 52)
fees.validity: up to 2 years, stays up to 180 days per year
fees.notes: Two-stage fee: non-refundable study fee USD 56 paid at application; reduced tourist/airport-transit issuance fee USD 52 paid only if approved (Res. 3969/2026 art. 4.1.h). If applied in the Euro zone or Cuba: EUR 44 study + EUR 40 issuance = EUR 84. Stamp tax (impuesto de timbre) not included.

fees.name: Visitor Visa Type V - general categories (business meetings, events, medical, etc.)
fees.validity: up to 2 years depending on category
fees.notes: Standard Type V fee: USD 56 study + USD 138 issuance = USD 194 (EUR 44 + EUR 106 = EUR 150 in Euro zone/Cuba). Applies to non-tourist V categories; tourist and airport-transit categories get the reduced USD 52 issuance fee instead.

fees.name: Visitor Visa Type V - business
fees.notes: Business travel falls under Visitor Type V standard tariff: USD 56 study + USD 138 issuance (EUR 44 + EUR 106 in Euro zone/Cuba).

fees.name: Visitor Visa Type V - airport transit
fees.notes: Airport transit shares the reduced issuance fee with tourism: USD 56 study + USD 52 issuance (EUR 44 + EUR 40 in Euro zone/Cuba), per Res. 3969/2026 art. 4.1.h.

fees.name: Visitor Visa Type V - academic program (student)
fees.notes: Reduced academic tariff: USD 16 study + USD 21 issuance = USD 37 (EUR 12 + EUR 17 = EUR 29 in Euro zone/Cuba), per Res. 3969/2026 art. 4.1.g.

variations.note: Spanish nationals: study and issuance both free (Res. 3969/2026 art. 4.1.j).
Ecuadorian nationals: issuance free; study fee USD 31 (EUR 24 in Euro zone/Cuba), per Ley 1203/2008 and Res. 3969/2026 art. 4.1.c.
Japan and South Korea nationals pay only the study-stage fee (USD 56 / EUR 44); issuance free (art. 4.1.d).
Peruvian nationals settling in the Amazonas/Putumayo river basins pay only the study fee (art. 4.1.e).
Bolivian nationals on academic-program visitor visas pay only a study fee of USD 17 (EUR 13); issuance free (art. 4.1.f).

COL.free_visa_notes: Nationals of ~100 countries (incl. USA, GBR, CAN, RUS, PHL and most of the Americas/Europe) are visa-exempt for short stays up to 90 days (extendable to 180/year). Visa-required nationalities among the key set include IND, CHN, NGA, PAK, BGD. No visa on arrival or eTA; fees are set in USD (or EUR for applications lodged in the Euro zone and Cuba) by Resolución 3969 de 2026 and paid in local currency. No reciprocity fees for IND/USA/GBR/CHN/NGA/PAK/PHL/BGD/RUS/CAN beyond the standard schedule.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (45 days, single entry)
fees.notes: Issued at Moroni Prince Said Ibrahim airport (and Ouani, Anjouan) after biometric enrolment; cash only (EUR, USD or KMF). France Diplomatie and the Comoros Embassy in Paris state ~EUR 30, but the Comoros Permanent Mission to the UN lists EUR 60 for the 45-day visa - amount at the counter may vary; verify before travel.

fees.name: Visa on arrival - 45 days (per Comoros UN Mission schedule)
fees.notes: Comoros Permanent Mission to the UN publishes 45 days EUR 60; conflicts with EUR 30 published by France Diplomatie/Comoros Embassy Paris.

fees.name: Long-validity visitor visa - 1 year
fees.notes: Per Comoros Permanent Mission to the UN fee schedule, obtained on the spot.

fees.name: Long-validity visitor visa - 10 years
fees.notes: Per Comoros Permanent Mission to the UN fee schedule, obtained on the spot.

fees.name: E-visa
fees.notes: Comoros operates no official e-visa or eTA system; all travellers use the visa-on-arrival regime.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No separate transit-visa fee published on official sources; short visits fall under the standard visa on arrival.

fees.name: Tourist visa, single entry (Embassy of Cabo Verde, Washington DC)
fees.validity: Stay up to 90 days (extendable once); must be used within 180 days of issue
fees.notes: Embassy sticker-visa fee published by the Cabo Verde Embassy in the USA; fee is the same schedule used for tourist and temporary categories (money order, cash or bank check).

fees.name: Tourist/temporary visa, multiple entry (Embassy of Cabo Verde, Washington DC)
fees.validity: Multiple entries; temporary multiple-entry allows total stay of 90 days within one year of issue
fees.notes: Multiple-entry rate from the same embassy fee schedule.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (border/SEF, added via EASE pre-registration)
fees.notes: A visa can be added during EASE pre-registration or obtained on arrival. Third-party sources report roughly EUR 25 (approx. 2,750 CVE), but no official published amount was verifiable, so amount is null. Note: from 1 January 2026 nationals of certain listed countries must obtain a visa BEFORE arrival (VOA no longer available to them), per notice on ease.gov.cv.

fees.name: EASE pre-registration + Airport Security Tax (TSA), international flights
