fees.notes: Mandatory pre-registration on www.ease.gov.cv up to 5 days before travel and payment of the TSA of 3,400 CVE (approx. EUR 30.83 / USD 35). Not a visa, but required of visa-exempt travellers too; can also be paid on arrival. Domestic inter-island flights: 150 CVE.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Transit visa category exists per the MFA consular portal, but no specific published fee was found; embassy fee schedule (USD 60 single / 114 multiple) likely applies but is not explicitly stated for transit.

fees.name: Temporary visa (business, cultural, medical, family visit)
fees.validity: Single entry: stay up to 180 days; multiple entry (USD 114): 90 days total within one year
fees.notes: Business travel falls under the 'temporary' visa category; embassy schedule lists USD 60 single entry / USD 114 multiple entries.

CPV.free_visa_notes: Since 1 January 2019, nationals of the EU/EEA, UK, Switzerland and most African countries are visa-exempt for stays up to 30 days; they must still pre-register on EASE and pay the 3,400 CVE Airport Security Tax (TSA). From 1 January 2026, a list of nationalities announced on ease.gov.cv must obtain a visa prior to arrival.

fees.name: Consular visa (visa consular)
fees.validity: single entry; typically up to 30-day initial stay, extendable to 90/180 days by DGME
fees.notes: Fee from the official Arancel Consular of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (rree.go.cr): 'Por el otorgamiento de visas consulares' USD 30. Costa Rica has no e-visa, eTA, or visa on arrival; all visas are issued at consulates.

fees.name: Consulted/restricted visa (visa consultada, authorized by DGME)
fees.notes: Arancel Consular: 'visas consultadas y autorizadas por la Dirección General de Migración y Extranjería' USD 50.

fees.name: Multiple-entry visa (visa múltiple, authorized by DGME)
fees.notes: Arancel Consular: multiple visas when authorized by DGME, USD 100.

fees.name: Land transit visa to Panama (VT1 single / VT2 double)
fees.notes: Search snippets of the rree.go.cr tariff reference VT1 USD 30 (single) and VT2 USD 60 (double land transit to Panama), but the amounts could not be confirmed on the fetched tariff page, so left null. Business travel uses the same consular tourist/visitor visa; there is no separate business visa fee category.

CRI.free_visa_notes: Citizens of first- and second-group countries (e.g. USA, Canada, UK, EU, Japan) enter Costa Rica visa-free for up to 180 days; no eTA or entry fee applies. Diplomatic and official visas are issued free of charge.

fees.name: Tourist e-Visa (eVisaCuba, replaces the paper tourist card)
fees.validity: Single entry, stay up to 90 days, extendable once by 90 days; valid for use within about 12 months of issue
fees.notes: Since mid-2025 Cuba requires the electronic tourist visa (eVisaCuba) instead of the paper tourist card for air arrivals. The fee is set by each Cuban consulate in local currency and is NOT published centrally, so no single global amount can be stated. Verified official example: TTD 108 at the Cuban Embassy in Trinidad and Tobago. Third-party/consular reports put typical amounts around GBP 22 (UK) and EUR 22 (Spain), but these were not verified on an official page and are therefore not recorded as amounts. Travellers departing the USA have historically bought the tourist card/e-visa via airlines or authorised agencies at USD ~50-100, but those are agency/airline prices, not an official government fee.

fees.name: Business visa (D-7 / commercial)
fees.notes: Fee is the 'consular fee stipulated for this service' at each consulate; no amount is published centrally. Payment at consulates is typically cash, certified bank payment, money order or bank transfer.

fees.name: Transit visa (A-6)
fees.notes: Issued by Cuban consulates; fee set locally per consulate fee schedule and not published centrally.

CUB.free_visa_notes: Cuba is not visa-free for most visitors: nearly all tourists need the e-visa (former tourist card). Fees vary by the country/consulate where you apply (verified example: TTD 108 in Trinidad and Tobago), not by nationality. Separately, all travellers must complete the free D'Viajeros advance-information form (dviajeros.mitrans.gob.cu) before arrival.

fees.name: Short-stay visa (Category C, single/multiple entry, 1-90 days)
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period; MEV validity 6 months to 5 years
fees.notes: Cyprus has fully harmonised fees with the Schengen Visa Code (EUR 90 since 01/12/2022 alignment, current as of 2026). Children 6-12: EUR 45; children under 6: free. Free for pupils/students on study trips, researchers, diplomatic/service passport holders, and under-25s attending non-profit seminars/sport/cultural events. Cyprus visas are national (not yet full Schengen), but holders of valid multi-entry Schengen visas or Schengen residence permits may enter Cyprus visa-free (except Turkish and Azerbaijani citizens).

fees.name: Short-stay visa (Category C) for business purposes
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: No separate business visa category; business travel uses the same Category C short-stay visa. Multiple-entry cascade rules apply for applicants in Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, Ghana and the USA.

fees.name: Airport Transit Visa (Category A, ATV)
fees.validity: transit through international transit zone only
fees.notes: Exemptions include holders of valid Schengen uniform visas/residence permits, valid US/Canada/Japan visas or residence permits, and family members of EU citizens.

fees.name: Visa issued at the border (Category C, LTV, up to 15 days)
fees.validity: up to 15 days (transit: time necessary for transit)
fees.notes: Not a routine visa-on-arrival regime; granted only by derogation for unforeseeable and compelling reasons. Visa extension in-country costs EUR 30 (free if force majeure/humanitarian).

variations.note: Reduced fee under EU Visa Facilitation Agreements. For Albania, Georgia, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia and Ukraine this applies only to non-biometric passport holders; biometric passport holders are visa-exempt. Source: https://www.gov.cy/en/information/visas/
Cape Verde nationals: EUR 67.50 (children 6-12: EUR 33.75) under the EU-Cape Verde visa facilitation agreement. Source: https://www.gov.cy/en/information/visas/

Standard EUR 90 fee; no reciprocity reduction listed for these nationalities. USA, GBR and CAN passport holders are visa-exempt for short stays (fee applies only if a visa is otherwise required, e.g. other travel documents).

vfs.note: Cyprus outsources visa application intake to VFS Global centres (e.g. India, UAE, UK and others; gov.cy refers applicants to the 'Visa Centre (External Service Provider)'). VFS India confirms a service charge is payable inclusive of 18% GST, but the exact published amount could not be verified on an official page at time of writing (VFS one-pager blocked; third-party sources cite around INR 541 excl. tax, unverified). Fee varies by centre/country.

CYP.free_visa_notes: Visa-free entry for EU/EEA/Swiss citizens, Annex II visa-exempt nationalities, holders of multi-entry Schengen visas or Schengen residence permits (except Turkish and Azerbaijani citizens), and refugees with Schengen-issued 1951 Convention travel documents. Visa is free of charge for children under 6, pupils/students/researchers travelling for study or research, diplomatic/service passport holders, and under-25 participants in non-profit seminars, conferences, sports, cultural or educational events.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C), adult
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Payable at application; not refunded on refusal. Children 6-11: EUR 45; children under 6 free. Payable in EUR or local-currency equivalent. Czechia is a Schengen member; this is the common Schengen fee.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.notes: Same fee schedule as Type C Schengen visa.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - business purpose
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Business travel uses the same Schengen Type C visa and fee; there is no separate business visa category.

variations.note: Reduced fee under EU Visa Facilitation Agreements. Ukraine express processing option: EUR 70. (Most of these nationalities are in practice visa-exempt for short stays with biometric passports; the reduced fee applies where a visa is still required.)

vfs.note: VFS Global service charge in India is INR 2,220 (incl. GST), non-refundable, paid at appointment booking. Service fees vary by country/centre; Czechia outsources short-stay visa intake to VFS Global in many countries.

CZE.free_visa_notes: No e-visa, visa on arrival, or eTA exists for Czechia. Schengen visa fee waived for: children under 6, family members of EU/EEA citizens, school pupils/students and accompanying teachers on study trips, researchers, and representatives of non-profit youth organisations (aged 25 or under) attending events. Certain long-term (Type D) visas are free for citizens of Japan, South Africa and Turkey. Note: from late 2026 the EU ETIAS travel authorisation (EUR 20) will apply to visa-exempt travellers across Schengen, but it is an EU-wide fee, not a Czech fee.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C), adult
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Fee raised to EUR 90 on 11 June 2024; confirmed current on Federal Foreign Office fee page. Children 6-11: EUR 45; under 6: free. Waivers for students on school trips, researchers, young NGO representatives under 25, and family members of EU/EEA citizens.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C) for business purposes
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Same Schengen type C fee regardless of purpose (tourism/business/visit). Foreign exhibitors with official trade fair passes may be fee-exempt.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (type A)
fees.notes: Airport transit visas fall under the uniform Schengen Visa Code fee (EUR 90 since 11 June 2024).

fees.name: E-visa
fees.notes: Germany does not issue e-visas; all visas are sticker visas issued via embassies/consulates (applications digitalised via the Consular Services Portal, but no separate e-visa product or fee). The EU ETIAS travel authorisation (EUR 20, visa-exempt nationals) was not yet in operation as of the update date.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: Germany does not offer visa on arrival; visas must be obtained in advance except at-border exceptional visas in emergency cases.

variations.note: Reduced EUR 35 Schengen visa fee under EU visa facilitation agreements (per Federal Foreign Office fee page). Note most of these nationalities are visa-free for short stays with biometric passports; fee applies where a visa is still needed.
Cabo Verde: reduced EUR 67.50 Schengen visa fee under visa facilitation agreement.

vfs.note: Germany routes Schengen/national visa applications through VFS Global in India and 30+ other countries. India service fee reported at approx INR 1,806-1,933 per applicant (pre-paid at appointment booking per German Consulate Mumbai); exact amount varies by centre and country and the VFS fee page returned 403 to automated fetch, so range is from recent secondary reporting - verify on visa.vfsglobal.com/ind/en/deu/ before relying on it. Optional courier return INR 733.

DEU.free_visa_notes: Not free in general. Fee waivers: children under 6, school pupils on educational trips, researchers, young non-profit representatives under 25, family members of EU/EEA citizens, and holders of official trade fair exhibitor passes.

fees.name: Short-stay e-Visa (15-90 days)
fees.notes: Fee published on the official Djibouti e-visa portal evisa.gouv.dj. The portal is a JavaScript app so the amount was cross-checked against multiple sources citing the portal; verify at application time.

fees.name: Transit e-Visa (1-14 days)
fees.notes: Issued via the official e-visa portal for short transits up to 14 days.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: Djibouti has largely replaced visa on arrival with the mandatory e-visa; arrival issuance is reported only in exceptional cases and no official current VOA fee schedule could be verified. Amount left null rather than guessed.

fees.name: Business travel (covered by e-visa) / embassy sticker visa
fees.notes: Business trips up to 90 days use the same short-stay e-visa (USD 23). The Washington DC embassy accepts paper applications but does not publish a fee schedule online; contact the embassy for sticker-visa fees. Amount left null.

fees.name: Visitor's visa (embassy/consulate application)
fees.notes: Official portal states 'The application fee is $200.00 to be paid at the Treasury department' without specifying currency; payment at the Dominica Treasury implies Eastern Caribbean dollars (XCD), though some third-party sources describe it as USD. Currency unverified on an official source - treat amount as $200 with currency ambiguity.

fees.name: In-transit entry (no visa required)
fees.notes: No separate transit visa or fee exists; any in-transit passenger or bona fide tourist with a return ticket may enter visa-free for up to 21 days.

DMA.free_visa_notes: Dominica has a very liberal visa regime: citizens of the Commonwealth (incl. GBR, CAN, IND-see note, NGA, PAK), CARICOM, USA and several EU states enter visa-free for up to 6 months; nationals of most other EU states, China, Japan, South Korea, Mexico, Venezuela etc. for up to 3 months; and any bona fide tourist or in-transit passenger with a return ticket for up to 21 days. There is no e-visa, eTA, or visa-on-arrival programme; the only travel formality is the free online ED card (edcard.dominica.gov.dm). Only a small set of nationalities need the embassy-issued visitor's visa. No separate business-visa fee schedule is published; the single visa application form and $200 fee apply.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C) - tourist/private visit
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Standard Schengen fee. Children aged 6-11 pay EUR 45; children under 6 are free. Paid in local currency at the application centre; a separate service fee to the outsourcing company (VAC) also applies.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C) - business
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: All short-stay categories (tourist, business, transit) share the identical EUR 90 fee per VFS Denmark fee schedule.

fees.name: Schengen airport transit / transit visa
fees.notes: Same fee as other short-stay categories per VFS Denmark fee schedule.

variations.note: Denmark (nyidanmark.dk) notes EU visa-facilitation agreements with Armenia and several other states (Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Moldova, Montenegro, Serbia, Ukraine - most of which are now visa-exempt with biometric passports). Reduced facilitation fee (typically EUR 35) could not be verified on the official Danish page, so amount is left null.

vfs.note: INR 2,109 (approx EUR 19) per application in India; service fee varies by country/centre. Mandatory courier charge EUR 4 (INR 444) for applicants outside Delhi. nyidanmark.dk confirms a service fee to the outsourcing company (VAC) applies in addition to the visa fee.

DNK.free_visa_notes: Denmark is a Schengen member: nationals of the EU/EEA and ~60 visa-exempt countries need no visa for short stays. Children under 6 pay no visa fee. Denmark has no e-visa, visa-on-arrival, or eTA scheme; the EU ETIAS travel authorisation (EUR 20) for visa-exempt travellers is expected but was not yet in operation at the time of writing.

fees.name: Tourist visa (single entry, consular)
fees.notes: MIREX consular fee as published on the official VFS Global Dominican Republic page (India). Multiple-entry tourist visa is USD 150. Paid at the visa application centre (in India ~INR 8,400 single / 12,600 multiple).

fees.name: Business visa (single entry, consular)
fees.notes: Multiple-entry business visa is USD 200.

fees.name: Tourist card (entry tax, Law 199-67)
fees.notes: Since 2018 the USD 10 tourist card fee is bundled into airline tickets issued outside the DR; travellers arriving by land or sea pay USD 10 at entry.

fees.name: E-Ticket (electronic entry/exit form)
fees.notes: Mandatory digital migration/customs/health form via the official DGM portal; free of charge. Not a visa or travel authorisation.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: MIREX lists transit as a visa category but no current fee could be verified on an official source; amount left null.

vfs.note: VFS logistic fee in India: INR 500 for tourist category, INR 1,000 for other categories (Delhi, Kolkata, Mumbai, Chennai, Bengaluru). Fees vary by country/centre; non-refundable.

DOM.free_visa_notes: Most visitors (USA, Canada, UK, EU, Russia, Japan, Israel, Mexico, most of the Americas, etc.) do not need a visa; they enter under the USD 10 tourist card (included in airfare for air arrivals) plus the free e-Ticket. No reciprocity-based fee differences found; MIREX consular fees appear uniform by visa category rather than nationality.

fees.name: Tourist (Tourism) visa - embassy sticker visa
fees.validity: typically up to 90 days, single entry for tourist category
fees.notes: Embassy of Algeria in Washington: USPS money order US$160 for US citizens; 'for all other nationalities please contact us'. Chancery fee explicitly varies by country of nationality (reciprocity); some nationalities exempt. Family, medical, student and press visas also US$160 for US citizens; work and cultural visas US$190.

fees.name: Business visa
fees.validity: single or multiple entry, at embassy discretion
fees.notes: US$160 by USPS money order for US citizens at the Washington embassy; other nationalities pay reciprocity-based amounts.

fees.name: Transit visa (max 7 days)
fees.notes: US$160 for US citizens at the Washington embassy.

fees.name: Regularization visa on arrival - Great South (Saharan) organized tours
fees.notes: Official MFA source confirms visa-on-arrival scheme (30-day max, agency issues QR-coded boarding authorization, fee paid on arrival) but does not publish the amount. Third-party/tour-operator reports cite roughly EUR 75-90 (or ~DZD 10,000+, varying with length of stay), payable in EUR or USD cash on arrival - unverified on an official source, so amount left null. Rest of Algeria remains embassy-visa only; Algeria has NO e-visa or eTA as of mid-2026.

variations.note: US citizens pay US$160 for tourist/business/transit/family/student/press visas and US$190 for work/cultural visas (Embassy of Algeria, Washington). Fees for other nationalities differ under reciprocity and are quoted by each embassy.

Fee payable by bank demand draft to 'Embassy of Algeria in New Delhi' (per VFS Global India page); exact INR amount published only in a fee table not retrievable from official sources (third parties report ~INR 9,700 for a 90-day visa - unverified, so left null).

vfs.note: VFS Global handles Algeria visa applications in India (Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Hyderabad; since Sept 2024), Nepal and Sri Lanka. VFS India service/logistic charge widely reported at ~INR 1,600, paid in cash/UPI/POS at submission, non-refundable, no exemptions (per VFS visa-type page). Exact amount sits in a fee table not machine-readable on the official page; service fees vary by centre and country.

DZA.free_visa_notes: Algeria is not visa-free generally. Only nationals of Libya, Malaysia, Mali, Mauritania, Seychelles, Tunisia, Sahrawi ADR (90 days) and Hong Kong (14 days) enter visa-free. Everyone else needs an embassy visa, except Saharan Great-South organized-tour visitors who can use the visa-on-arrival regularization scheme. Nationals of certain countries are exempt from chancery fees under reciprocity.

fees.name: Visa de Visitante Temporal - Turista (90 days)
fees.validity: 90 days from entry, extendable once for 90 more days (with additional fee)
fees.notes: Split as USD 50 application (solicitud) + USD 30 visa issuance (otorgamiento). No IVA. Applied online via the official e-Visas portal (serviciosciudadanos.cancilleria.gob.ec).

fees.name: e-Visas portal application (electronic tourist/transit visa)
fees.validity: per visa category (tourist 90 days, transit up to 30 days)
fees.notes: The e-Visas portal is Ecuador's sole application channel since 2024; fees are the standard USD 50 application + USD 30 issuance, no extra e-visa surcharge published.

fees.name: Visa de Visitante Temporal - Transeunte (transit)
fees.validity: up to 30 days, generally single entry (up to 2 entries within 30 days if transiting to/from a third country)
fees.notes: USD 50 application form + USD 30 visa fee per official tramite page.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: Ecuador has no visa-on-arrival scheme; visa-required nationalities must obtain the visa in advance via the e-Visas portal, while visa-exempt visitors receive a free 90-day entry stamp.

fees.name: Business travel (short stay)
fees.notes: Ecuador does not publish a separate short-stay business visa category; short business trips fall under the temporary visitor (tourist) visa regime (USD 50 + USD 30). No distinct official business-visa fee verified.

ECU.free_visa_notes: Most nationalities (incl. USA, GBR, CAN, RUS and most of the Americas/Europe) are visa-exempt for up to 90 days per year (extendable 90 more) and pay no visa fee on entry. Only ~45 listed nationalities (incl. IND, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, CHN, AFG, CUB, VEN) need a pre-arranged visa; fees are flat (USD 50 + USD 30) with no reciprocity-based variation.

fees.name: Tourist e-Visa (single entry)
fees.validity: 3 months validity, stay up to 30 days
fees.notes: Fee raised from USD 25 to USD 30 on the official portal effective late April 2026.

fees.name: Tourist e-Visa (multiple entry)
fees.validity: 6 months validity, each stay up to 30 days
fees.notes: Raised from USD 60 to USD 65 in April 2026.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (tourist, single entry)
fees.notes: Increased from USD 25 to USD 30 effective 1 March 2026 per Egyptian Travel Agents Association circular; no detailed public government announcement located, so amount not fully verified on an official portal. Payable in cash (USD/EUR/GBP) at bank kiosks before immigration.

fees.name: Embassy tourist visa - single entry (Washington DC schedule)
fees.notes: Multiple entry USD 62. UK, Canadian, Zimbabwean and Nigerian passport holders have different (reciprocity) fee schedules per the embassy. Consular fees vary by mission.

fees.name: Embassy business visa - single entry (Washington DC schedule)
fees.notes: Multiple entry USD 87.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Transit visa category exists but no fee published on the embassy page; transit under 6 hours without leaving the airport generally requires no visa. Amount unverified, set to null.

fees.name: Tourist visa via VFS Global India - single entry
fees.notes: Multiple entry INR 5,800. Fee includes INR 300 embassy processing fee; VFS logistic fee of INR 800 extra. Amounts corroborated via VFS one-pager references; page blocks automated fetch so treat as medium confidence.

variations.note: Egyptian Embassy Washington DC states UK, Canadian, Zimbabwean and Nigerian passport holders pay different consular fees than the standard USD 27/62 schedule; exact amounts not published on the page, so left null.
Indian applicants apply via VFS Global (single entry INR 2,700, multiple INR 5,800 incl. INR 300 embassy processing fee) rather than the standard e-visa route.

vfs.note: VFS logistic fee INR 800 incl. taxes for all Egypt visa application centres in India, paid cash/card at submission; fees vary by country/centre. BLS International also handles some Egypt visa categories in India.

fees.name: Tourist visa (embassy sticker visa)
fees.validity: Valid 3 months from issue; 30-day stay on arrival (extendable in Asmara)
fees.notes: Fee at the Eritrean Embassy in Washington DC via the CAPS online system. Plus $13 photo printing and $10 service fee. Fees at other Eritrean missions vary (e.g. Australian consulate charges AUD 90). No e-visa exists.

fees.name: Business visa
fees.validity: Valid 3 months from issue; 30-day stay on arrival
fees.notes: Embassy publishes a USD 100-300 range depending on duration; no single fixed amount, so amount left null.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Plus $13 photo printing and $10 service fee at the Washington DC embassy.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (pre-arranged only)
fees.notes: No general visa on arrival. Fee for the pre-arranged VOA is not published on any official source; amount left null.

ERI.free_visa_notes: Visas are not free; official/diplomatic passport visas are gratis per the Washington DC embassy. No published nationality-based reciprocity schedule found; the same USD fee schedule applies to all nationalities applying at the US embassy, but amounts differ by mission/local currency.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - standard fee
fees.validity: Short stay, up to 90 days in 180-day period
fees.notes: EU-wide Schengen visa fee increased from EUR 80 to EUR 90 effective 11 June 2024 per EU Visa Code revision (Commission review of visa fees, triggered by Euro area inflation and EU civil servant salary criteria); uniform across all 29 Schengen states. Verified against the European Commission's official Migration and Home Affairs announcement, which states the fee remains EUR 90 as of the most recent triennial review; the amount EUR 90 is correct but the file's prior note incorrectly dated the change to 2026 instead of 2024.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - children 6-11
fees.validity: Short stay, up to 90 days in 180-day period
fees.notes: Reduced fee for children aged 6 to 11 inclusive.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - children under 6
fees.validity: Short stay, up to 90 days in 180-day period
fees.notes: Fee exempt for children under 6 years old.

fees.name: Schengen airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.notes: Same standard Schengen visa fee structure applies to airport transit visas; reduced/exempt categories for children also apply.

variations.note: Reduced fee (~EUR 35, listed as $41 on the US consular page) for nationals of Azerbaijan, Armenia and Belarus aged 12+ under EU visa-facilitation agreements; exempt for those 11 and under.

Cabo Verde nationals: reduced fee under EU-Cabo Verde visa facilitation agreement, increased from EUR 60 to EUR 67.50 effective 11 June 2024 per the same EU Visa Code fee revision (confirmed on the European Commission's official Migration and Home Affairs site). Reduced rate for ages 12-17 and exemption under 12 not independently re-verified in this pass.

The EU suspended the EU-Russia visa facilitation agreement in 2022; Russian nationals are generally charged the standard/higher Schengen fee and face additional processing scrutiny. Exact current fee not independently verified on an official Spanish source in this research pass.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (C), adult
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Estonia is a Schengen member; common Schengen fee applies. Children 6-11: EUR 45; under 6: free. Fee waivers for students on study trips, researchers, representatives of non-profits aged 25 or under, and certain family members of EU citizens.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (C) for business purposes
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: No separate business visa category; business travel uses the same Schengen C visa and fee.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (A)
fees.notes: Listed as 'airport transport visa' 90 EUR on the Police and Border Guard Board state-fee schedule.

fees.name: Long-stay national visa (D)
fees.validity: up to 12 months, stays over 90 days
fees.notes: National D visa for stays beyond 90 days (not a residence permit). Children 6-11: EUR 60.

fees.name: Short-term one-time visa issued at the border
fees.notes: Estonia has no general visa-on-arrival regime; border visas are issued only in exceptional, justified cases under the Schengen Visa Code.

fees.name: ETIAS travel authorisation (visa-exempt travellers)
fees.notes: EU-wide ETIAS applies to Estonia as a Schengen state; fee published as EUR 20 by the EU, but launch date/fee not verified on an Estonian official source at time of writing, so amount left null.

variations.note: Reduced fee under EU visa facilitation agreements (per vm.ee).
Cabo Verde: adults EUR 67.50; children 12-18 EUR 35; under 12 free (per vm.ee).
EU-Russia visa facilitation agreement suspended since 2022; Russian citizens pay the standard EUR 90 fee (and Estonia heavily restricts issuance). Not listed among reduced-fee nationalities on vm.ee.
Standard Schengen fee; no facilitation agreement. USA, GBR and CAN citizens are visa-exempt for short stays.

vfs.note: Published on VFS Global Estonia-USA page as EUR 10.96 (USD 13) per short-term application and EUR 16.90 (USD 20) per D-visa application; service fees vary by centre/country.

EST.free_visa_notes: Visa-free for EU/EEA and Schengen visa-exempt nationalities. Fee waived for children under 6, students/pupils on study trips, researchers, non-profit representatives aged 25 or under at seminars/sports/cultural events, and certain family members of EU citizens.

fees.name: Tourist e-Visa (single entry, 30 days)
fees.notes: Reduced from USD 82 in late 2025. Extension fee USD 102. Official portal fee table.

fees.name: Tourist e-Visa (single entry, 90 days)
fees.notes: Still listed on the official portal fee table, but media reports (VisasNews) indicate the 90-day e-visa was suspended in Nov 2025; verify availability at application time. Extension fee USD 302.

fees.name: Tourist Visa on Arrival (Addis Ababa Bole airport)
fees.notes: Official portal confirms VOA for eligible countries but does not publish a separate VOA fee; expected to match the tourist e-visa fee (USD 62 for 30 days), payable at the airport. Amount left null as not explicitly published.

fees.name: Embassy sticker tourist visa (Washington DC schedule)
fees.notes: USD 60 single entry / USD 150 multiple entries at the Ethiopian Embassy in Washington DC; payable by money order only. Fees vary by mission.

fees.name: Business and Related Studies e-Visa (BRV, single entry 30 days)
fees.validity: 30 days single entry (90 days single entry USD 202)
fees.notes: Official portal fee table. Related categories: Conference visa (CV) USD 52/30 days; Investment visa (IV) USD 62/30 days single entry, USD 152/90 days multiple; Foreign Business Firm Employment (WV) USD 402/30 days; Journalist visa USD 152/30 days.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No transit e-visa category is published on the official e-visa portal; airside transit through Addis Ababa does not require a visa. No official transit visa fee found.

ETH.free_visa_notes: Citizens of Kenya and Djibouti with a valid passport enter Ethiopia visa-free (per official e-visa portal). No nationality-based fee reciprocity schedule is published; e-visa fees are uniform for all nationalities.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C), adult
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Common Schengen fee, confirmed on the Finnish Ministry for Foreign Affairs 2026 fee decree page. Children 6-11 pay EUR 45; children under 6, EU-citizen family members (Directive 2004/38/EC) and certain students/researchers are exempt. Covers tourism and business purposes alike.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C) for business purposes
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Same Schengen C visa and fee as tourist; purpose declared on application. No separate business visa fee.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (type A)
fees.notes: Airport transit visas carry the same EUR 90 Schengen fee under the EU Visa Code.

fees.name: E-visa
fees.notes: Finland does not issue short-stay e-visas. Applications are lodged at missions/VFS centres; the finlandvisa.fi portal is for forms and checklists only. (Finland's long-stay D visa has an electronic-application fee of EUR 95 vs EUR 120 on paper, but D visas are long-term and out of scope.)

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: Finland does not offer visa on arrival; visas must be obtained in advance (exceptional border visas only in emergencies, per Schengen rules).

fees.name: ETIAS travel authorisation (upcoming, for visa-exempt nationals)
fees.notes: ETIAS is not yet in operation as of this record date; the EU has published a planned EUR 20 fee (free under 18 / over 70), but since it is not yet chargeable the amount is left null.

variations.note: Reduced fee under EU visa facilitation agreements (EUR 70 for accelerated processing for Ukraine/Belarus). Source: https://um.fi/service-fees
Cabo Verde facilitation-agreement rate per um.fi service fee list.
EU-Russia visa facilitation is suspended; Russian nationals pay the standard EUR 90 fee (Finland also heavily restricts Russian tourist visa issuance).
Standard Schengen fee; no facilitation agreement. USA, GBR and CAN nationals are visa-exempt for short stays.

vfs.note: Finland outsources visa intake to VFS Global in most non-EU countries (e.g. India, China, Nigeria, UK). VFS confirms a taxed service charge on its official Finland pages but publishes the exact amount only in the appointment/one-pager flow; third-party trackers put India centres at roughly INR 1,900-3,100 after the Nov 2025 increase. Amount varies by centre and country - verify on the local VFS Finland page before applying.

FIN.free_visa_notes: Visa fee waived for children under 6, family members of EU/Finnish citizens under Directive 2004/38/EC, holders of diplomatic/service passports on official visits, and case-by-case for school/study trips, researchers and young non-profit event participants.

fees.name: Single Entry Visa (SEV)
fees.notes: Fiji Immigration Department fee schedule effective 1 Aug 2025 ('Application for Single Entry' FJD 93.00). Applied online via IMMIHUB portal; processing ~14 working days. amount_usd is approximate.

fees.name: Multiple Entry Visa (MEV)
fees.validity: 12 months from issuance, max 4 months per entry
fees.notes: 'Application for Multiple Entry' FJD 185.00 in the official 2025 fee schedule. amount_usd is approximate.

fees.name: Transit visa (pre-entry, transit over 3 hours / within 72 hours)
fees.notes: Transit is one of the pre-entry visa purposes handled via the same Single Entry Visa application (FJD 93). No separately published transit fee line in the 2025 schedule.

fees.name: Online pre-entry visa via IMMIHUB portal
fees.validity: 3 months (single entry) / 12 months (multiple entry at FJD 185)
fees.notes: Fiji's pre-entry visa is applied for online (IMMIHUB); same fee as SEV/MEV — this is the delivery channel, not a separate product. No separate eTA or visa-on-arrival fee regime exists.

FJI.free_visa_notes: Nationals of Fiji's visa-exempt countries (a broad list including USA, GBR, IND, CHN, RUS, CAN, PHL, BGD and most Commonwealth/EU states) receive a free visitor permit on arrival for stays up to 4 months; extension of a visitor's permit costs FJD 93. No fee differentiation by nationality is published — all non-exempt nationals pay the same SEV/MEV fees. Fiji is not a Schengen member and does not use VFS/TLS/BLS outsourced centres; applications go directly to the Fiji Immigration Department online.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C, tourism/visit, up to 90 days)
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Standard EU-wide Schengen fee (raised from EUR 80 to EUR 90 on 11 June 2024). Children 6-12: EUR 45; children under 6: free. Fee is non-refundable if refused. Many nationalities (USA, GBR, CAN, and other visa-exempt countries) do not need a visa for short stays.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C, business)
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Same uniform Schengen fee as tourism; there is no separate business-visa tariff.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (type A)
fees.notes: Same EUR 90 rate as the short-stay visa; EUR 35 for biometric-passport holders of EU visa-facilitation-agreement countries.

fees.name: e-Visa
fees.notes: France does not issue e-visas; applications go through France-Visas online but result in a sticker visa issued via consulates/external providers.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: France/Schengen does not offer visa on arrival; visas must be obtained in advance.

fees.name: ETIAS travel authorisation (upcoming, EU-wide)
fees.notes: Not yet in force as of 2026-07-02; the EU has set the ETIAS fee at EUR 20 (raised from EUR 10). Free for under-18s and over-70s. Recorded for forward reference only.

variations.note: Reduced fee under EU visa facilitation agreements (Ukrainians are additionally visa-exempt with biometric passports).
EU-Russia visa facilitation agreement suspended since September 2022; Russian nationals pay the full EUR 90 fee.

vfs.note: France outsources visa intake to external providers (VFS Global in India and many other countries; TLScontact/Capago elsewhere). In India the service fee is about EUR 22 per applicant charged in INR (roughly INR 2,000-2,500 depending on exchange rate and centre). EU rules cap service fees at half the visa fee (max EUR 45). Optional extras (courier, SMS, premium lounge) cost more.

FRA.free_visa_notes: Visa-free for many nationalities (USA, GBR, CAN, JPN, and all visa-exempt Schengen list countries) for stays up to 90/180 days. For visa-required nationals, the visa is free for children under 6, family members of EU/EEA citizens, students on school trips, researchers, and representatives of non-profits aged 25 or under attending events.

fees.name: Visitor entry (30 days or less) - no visa/permit required
fees.notes: Official FSM Embassy: 'A permit is not required for a person visiting the FSM for 30 days or less.' Valid passport (120+ days beyond entry) and onward/return ticket required. Extensions of up to an additional 60 days may be requested in person at an FSM Immigration Office.

fees.name: FSM Entry Permit (stays over 30 days)
fees.validity: up to 90 days (up to 1 year for USA/Palau/Marshall Islands citizens)
fees.notes: Fee not published on the official embassy application or FSM Immigration Regulations; the application form lists requirements only. Fees, where charged, are handled by FSM Immigration/state offices - contact FSM Embassy (202) 223-4343 for the current fee. Amount left null rather than guessed.

variations.note: US citizens (and Palau/Marshall Islands nationals) may be issued entry permits for the duration of visit up to one year under the Compact of Free Association, vs 90-day maximum for other nationals. This is a validity difference, not a published fee difference.

FSM.free_visa_notes: The Federated States of Micronesia has no visa regime for short visits: all nationalities may enter without a visa or permit for up to 30 days (extendable by up to 60 days at an FSM Immigration Office). There is no e-visa, eTA, visa-on-arrival fee, or outsourced visa centre (no VFS/TLS/BLS). Only stays beyond 30 days require an FSM Entry Permit; no fee for it is published on official sources.

fees.name: e-Visa single entry (1-3 months)
fees.notes: Official DGDI portal evisa.dgdi.ga. Fee EUR 70 (also quoted as XAF 45,000). Historically paid in cash on arrival; since Dec 2025 payable digitally via mobile money (MaDigiPaie). Portal was unreachable directly (TLS certificate issue); amount corroborated by multiple secondary reports of the official schedule.

fees.name: e-Visa multiple entry (6 months)
fees.notes: EUR 185 (also quoted as XAF 120,000). Same payment notes as single-entry e-visa.

fees.name: Embassy ordinary visa (sticker) - Embassy of Gabon, Washington DC
fees.notes: Embassy lists 'Ordinary Visas: $160' with 3-5 business day processing; validity not published. Fees at other Gabonese embassies may differ.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No verified official published fee for a transit visa; airside transit under 24h generally does not require a visa. Amount set to null rather than guessed.

GAB.free_visa_notes: Gabon announced visa-free entry for many African nationalities and ran a temporary free tourist e-visa promotion (Jul-Sep 2025); standard e-visa fees above otherwise apply. No universal free-visa regime.

fees.name: Standard Visitor visa - up to 6 months
fees.notes: Fee current from 8 April 2026 update. USD amount is the equivalent shown on the official fee calculator for USA applicants and varies slightly by application country due to exchange rate banding.

fees.name: Standard Visitor visa - 2 years multiple entry
fees.notes: Long-term multiple entry option; no Immigration Health Surcharge applies to visit visas.

fees.name: Standard Visitor visa - 5 years multiple entry
Standard Visitor visa - 10 years multiple entry
Visitor in Transit visa
fees.validity: single or double transit, up to 48 hours airside/landside
fees.notes: Direct Airside Transit Visa (DATV, no border crossing) fee not separately confirmed on official source in this pass; set to null in reciprocity notes if needed.

fees.name: Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA)
fees.validity: 2 years or until passport expires, multiple entry, stays up to 6 months per visit
fees.notes: Required in addition to (not instead of) a visa for nationalities that need a visa; USD equivalent not published by the official ETA page.

fees.name: Standard Visitor visa (business visitor activities)
fees.notes: UK does not issue a distinct 'business visa'; business visitors use the Standard Visitor visa at the same fee tiers as tourist visits.

vfs.operator: VFS Global (most countries as of 2025 transition) / TLScontact (some regions still transitioning)
vfs.service_fee: varies by country, typically GBP/USD 40-100 equivalent for standard service; premium lounge and same-day services cost extra
vfs.note: The UK Home Office outsources visa application centre operations (biometrics collection, document scanning) to VFS Global in most regions, with TLScontact still operating in some countries during a 2024-2025 transition. Service fees are set locally per country and are separate from the official Home Office visa fee; no single global published amount exists. Applicants should check the specific VAC for their country via the official 'Find a visa application centre' tool.

GBR.free_visa_notes: The UK is not visa-free for all nationalities. Many nationalities (EU/EEA, USA, Canada, Australia, Japan, South Korea, and others) do not need a visa for short visits but must obtain a paid Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA, GBP 20) before travel. Other nationalities require a full Standard Visitor visa. No reciprocity-based fee variation by nationality was found on official UK sources; UK visa fees are applied uniformly regardless of applicant nationality (fees do vary slightly by application country due to currency conversion banding on the official fee calculator).

fees.name: Georgia e-Visa (short-term, C category)
fees.validity: typically 120 days, 30-day stay (single/multiple entry depends on nationality)
fees.notes: USD 20 state fee + 2% service fee, paid by Visa/MasterCard on the official evisa.gov.ge portal. Non-refundable even if refused.

fees.name: Ordinary short-term visa (C1 tourism, embassy-issued)
fees.notes: Consular service tariff USD 20 (charged in local currency equivalent at some missions, e.g. 75 AED in the UAE). Applies to ordinary C1-C4 visas (tourism, family visit, business meetings, culture/sport, journalism, medical, humanitarian).

fees.name: Ordinary short-term visa (C2/C4 business purposes)
fees.notes: Business meetings and negotiations fall under the ordinary C-category visa; same USD 20 consular tariff.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Georgia issues transit visas but a distinct published transit fee could not be verified on an official page; consular tariffs for short-term categories are generally USD 20. Confirm via geoconsul.gov.ge tariffs section.

vfs.note: VFS Global runs Georgia visa application centres in India (and several other countries). Published service fee approx. INR 2,435 per application; mandatory courier fee of INR 846 at satellite locations (not New Delhi). Fees vary by centre and country.

GEO.free_visa_notes: Georgia is not a Schengen member and has one of the world's most liberal visa regimes: citizens of ~95+ countries/territories (incl. EU, USA, GBR, CAN, RUS, and all GCC states) may enter visa-free for up to 1 year. Fees above apply only to nationalities outside the visa-free list (e.g. IND, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, most of Africa/South Asia). There is no visa on arrival and no eTA. The flat USD 20 tariff applies uniformly; no nationality-based reciprocity fee schedule was found. Immigration D-category visas also carry a USD 20 fee (per embassy pages) but are out of scope here.

fees.name: Single entry visa (embassy sticker, e.g. Embassy of Ghana Washington DC)
fees.validity: Single entry, typically up to 3 months to enter; stay granted at border
fees.notes: Standard processing. Expedited: USD 140. Fees vary by mission; merchant fees added for card payment.

fees.name: Multiple entry visa (embassy sticker, Washington DC)
fees.notes: Standard processing. Expedited: USD 250.

fees.name: Ghana e-Visa single entry (evisa.immigration.gov.gh, launched 25 May 2026)
fees.notes: Standard processing 3-5 business days (portal says 72-96h). Priority 48h: USD 338; express 5h: USD 442. Fee shown inside application flow, not on the public landing page; amounts corroborated by press reports of the portal pricing - verify at checkout.

fees.name: Ghana e-Visa multiple entry
fees.notes: Standard tier. Priority: USD 608; express: USD 796. Same caveat as single-entry e-visa fee.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival / Emergency Entry Visa (EEV)
fees.notes: GIS revised fee schedule effective 15 May 2025: USD 200 for other nationals and Ghanaians with foreign passports. EEV for returning residents: GHS 259 (other nationals).

fees.name: Business visa
fees.notes: No separate business-visa fee published; business travel uses the same single/multiple entry visa fees (USD 100/180 at Washington) or the e-visa (tourist or business purpose).

fees.name: Transit visa (single, Washington DC mission)
fees.notes: Multiple transit: USD 130 (USD 150 expedited). GIS also lists a Transit Permit at USD 50 on its fees schedule.

fees.name: Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA)
fees.notes: The e-visa portal's eligibility checker distinguishes Visa Free / ETA / e-Visa by nationality, but no ETA fee is published; amount unverified.

variations.note: ECOWAS nationals (incl. Nigeria) are visa-free for 90 days - no visa or fee required.

From 25 May 2026 (Africa Day), holders of African passports pay no visa fees to travel to Ghana, per Ministry of Foreign Affairs announcement (https://mfa.gov.gh/index.php/ghana-launches-e-visa-portal/).

GHA.free_visa_notes: Visa-free: ECOWAS nationals (90 days); Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zimbabwe, Botswana, Singapore, Mauritius, Trinidad & Tobago (60 days). From 25 May 2026 all African passport holders are exempt from Ghana visa fees.

fees.name: Tourist e-Visa (single entry, <90 days)
fees.notes: Issued via official PAF (Police de l'Air et des Frontieres) portal paf.gov.gn. Non-refundable even if refused. Yellow fever certificate required. Processing about 3 business days.

fees.name: Business travel via e-Visa
fees.notes: Guinea's e-visa on the official PAF portal covers tourism, business and transit purposes at the same short-stay rate. A separate long-stay visa (VLS, 1 year) costs USD 150 but is a long-term category.

fees.name: Transit visa (max 3 days)
fees.notes: Applied for on the official PAF e-visa portal.

fees.name: Embassy-issued sticker visa
fees.notes: Guinean consulates (e.g. Consulate of Guinea) now redirect applicants to the official e-visa portal paf.gov.gn; no separate embassy sticker-visa fee schedule is published. Amount unverified, so left null.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: Entry at Conakry airport is possible with the e-visa pre-approval issued online; no separately published official on-arrival cash fee schedule was found, so amount is left null.

GIN.free_visa_notes: Visa-free entry applies only to ECOWAS member-state nationals and a few others; most travellers must obtain the paid e-visa.

fees.name: Single-entry visa (embassy-issued, Gambia High Commission London)
fees.validity: single journey; short visit up to 90 days
fees.notes: Fee schedules differ by Gambian mission; London charges GBP 40 single entry. The Washington DC embassy fee is widely reported around USD 100-139 but could not be verified on an official page, so it is not recorded as a separate amount.

fees.name: Multiple-entry visa (embassy-issued, Gambia High Commission London)
fees.validity: multiple journeys, validity up to 12 months
fees.notes: Multiple Journey Visa valid for stated number of journeys within up to 12 months per Gambia Immigration Department.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (Banjul International Airport and gazetted ports of entry)
fees.notes: Gambia Immigration Department confirms visa on arrival is available at gazetted ports of entry, but publishes no fee amount. Third-party sources report roughly USD 100-150; amount left null pending official confirmation. Payable in cash.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.validity: transit en route to onward destination
fees.notes: Transit visa category exists per Gambia Immigration Department; no separate fee published (London High Commission lists only single GBP 40 / multiple GBP 60).

GMB.free_visa_notes: Citizens of ECOWAS states, the UK, EU member states, Commonwealth countries and states with reciprocal visa-exemption agreements do not need a visa for stays up to 90 days. Separately, ALL passengers (except diplomats and children 2 and under) pay a Securiport airport security fee of D1000 (~USD 20) in cash on both arrival and departure - this is not a visa fee.

fees.name: Short-stay biometric e-visa (single entry, 30 days)
fees.notes: Official RGB-Visa portal (biometric pre-enrollment for entry via Osvaldo Vieira International Airport). A non-refundable EUR 2.50 transaction/processing fee is added at online payment. Fees are not refunded if the visa is refused.

fees.name: Multiple-entry visa, 3 months
fees.notes: Plus EUR 2.50 transaction fee.

fees.name: Multiple-entry visa, 6 months
fees.notes: Plus EUR 2.50 transaction fee.

fees.name: Multiple-entry visa, 1 year
fees.notes: Plus EUR 2.50 transaction fee. Suitable for frequent business travellers; Guinea-Bissau does not publish a separately priced business visa category on the official portal.

fees.name: Transit/stopover visa (single entry, 1 day)
fees.notes: Plus EUR 2.50 transaction fee.

fees.name: Visa on arrival at Bissau Osvaldo Vieira International Airport
fees.notes: No official published tariff found. Recent traveller reports cite approximately USD 120 / EUR 85, cash only (EUR, USD or XOF equivalent accepted). Amount left null because it could not be verified on an official government source.

GNB.free_visa_notes: ECOWAS member-state citizens enter Guinea-Bissau visa-free; the fees above apply only to visa-required nationalities. No nationality-based reciprocity fee schedule is published - the official portal lists uniform fees for all applicants.

fees.name: E-Visa (single-entry, tourism and business)
fees.validity: 90 days to enter; single entry, stay up to 90 days (some sources cite 30-day stay)
fees.notes: Official e-visa portal launched 1 July 2023 (equatorialguinea-evisa.com / egonline.vfsevisa.com, VFS Global technical partner). Fee payable only in USD by card. Processing ~24-72 hours to 5 working days. E-visa holders must arrive via Malabo International Airport. Portal blocked automated fetch; USD 75 fee corroborated by Fragomen and VFS Global press release.

fees.name: Embassy-issued sticker visa (tourist)
fees.notes: The e-visa platform replaced routine embassy visa applications from 1 July 2023; no current official embassy fee schedule could be verified. Amount left null rather than estimated.

fees.name: Business visa (via e-visa platform)
fees.notes: The single-entry e-visa covers both tourism and business travel at the same USD 75 fee.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: No general visa-on-arrival regime; travellers must obtain the e-visa before travel. UAE citizens are visa-exempt (90 days).

vfs.note: VFS Global operates the official e-visa platform (egonline.vfsevisa.com); no separately published VFS service fee was verifiable - the USD 75 appears to be the total published fee. No physical VFS/TLS/BLS visa application centres for Equatorial Guinea.

GNQ.free_visa_notes: Visa-free entry only for citizens of Barbados, Tunisia (30 days), Turkey (90 days), UAE (90 days), and CEMAC nationals (Cameroon, CAR, Chad, Congo, Gabon) with ID card or biometric passport. Everyone else needs the USD 75 e-visa.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C) - tourism
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Greece is a Schengen member; the common Schengen fee applies (EUR 90 since 11 June 2024, confirmed by EC Home Affairs and Greek MFA mission pages). Children 6-12 pay EUR 45; under 6 free. Waivers for school pupils, students, researchers and certain other categories.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C) - business
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Same uniform Schengen type C fee; no separate business-visa tariff.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (type A)
fees.notes: Same uniform fee as type C under the EU Visa Code.

fees.name: ETIAS travel authorisation (visa-exempt travellers)
fees.notes: EU-wide, not Greece-specific; fee set at EUR 20 (raised from the originally planned EUR 7). Free for under-18s and over-70s. Not yet in force as of the update date.

fees.name: E-visa
fees.notes: Greece does not operate an e-visa; applications are lodged at consulates or outsourced visa centres.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: No visa-on-arrival regime; visas must be obtained in advance.

variations.note: Reduced fee under EU visa facilitation agreements (EC Home Affairs).
Reduced fee under EU-Cabo Verde visa facilitation agreement.
EU-Russia visa facilitation agreement suspended since September 2022; standard EUR 90 fee applies.
Standard uniform Schengen fee; no reciprocity reduction or surcharge for these nationalities.
Visa-exempt for short stays; will require ETIAS (EUR 20) once operational.

vfs.operator: VFS Global (many corridors); Global Visa Center World (GVCW) handles Greece in India and some other countries
vfs.service_fee: approx USD 22-45 equivalent (e.g. AED 88 in UAE, USD 22 in Lebanon, USD 32-45 in USA)
vfs.note: Service/logistics fee varies by centre and country and is charged on top of the EUR 90 visa fee; verify on the local visa.vfsglobal.com Greece page. In India Greece uses GVCW, not VFS.

GRC.free_visa_notes: Visa fee waived for children under 6, school pupils/students/postgraduates and accompanying teachers on study trips, researchers, and representatives of non-profit organisations aged 25 or under attending events (EU Visa Code categories).

fees.name: Single-entry visa (applied prior to arrival, embassy-issued)
fees.validity: single entry, valid only for the period specified
fees.notes: Embassy of Grenada (Washington DC) schedule dated Mar 2018, still published. Payable by certified cheque/money order or online at pay.gov.gd. Multiple-entry visa is US$375.

fees.name: Multiple-entry visa (applied prior to arrival, embassy-issued)
fees.validity: multiple entry, valid only for the period specified

fees.name: Single-entry visa at port of entry (with pre-clearance letter)
fees.notes: EC$200 paid on arrival; pre-clearance letter fee US$10 payable to the Embassy of Grenada in advance. XCD pegged at 2.70 per USD (approx USD conversion).

fees.name: Multiple-entry visa at port of entry (with pre-clearance letter)
fees.notes: EC$375 paid on arrival.

fees.name: Online Immigration & Customs eD-card (edcard.gov.gd)
fees.notes: Digital embarkation/disembarkation card, not a visa; no published fee.

GRD.free_visa_notes: Most nationalities (US, Canada, UK, EU, CARICOM and many others) do not require a visa to visit Grenada. No published reciprocity fee schedule by nationality; the same USD/XCD fees apply to all visa-required nationalities. Grenada is not a Schengen member and has no e-visa portal or outsourced (VFS/TLS/BLS) visa centres. Fee schedule dated Mar 2018 but remains the currently published official schedule; confidence set to medium due to document age.

fees.name: Tourist/Traveler visa (visa de turista o viajero) - single entry, embassy-issued
fees.validity: single entry, stay up to 90 days
fees.notes: Confirmed on the official Consulate General of Guatemala in New York page and consistent with MINEX/IGM tariff (visa simple/turista US$50). Same fee schedule covers tourism and business travel; Guatemala has no separate business-visa tariff published.

fees.name: Tourist/Traveler visa - multiple entry
fees.notes: US$150 for multiple entries per official consulate fee schedule; MINEX tariff also lists multiple-entry tourist visa at US$150.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: MINEX lists visa categories for foreigners but a distinct transit-visa fee could not be verified (minex.gob.gt returned 403 on direct fetch); embassy schedules only publish single-entry US$50 / multiple-entry US$150.

GTM.free_visa_notes: Nationals of Category A countries (incl. USA, GBR, CAN, most of EU, RUS, and CA-4 members SLV/HND/NIC) enter Guatemala visa-free for up to 90 days; no fee applies. No e-visa, visa-on-arrival, or eTA scheme exists - visas are issued only at Guatemalan embassies/consulates. In-country extension of stay costs US$25 (paid in quetzales to IGM). No reciprocity-based fee differentiation found: the US$50/US$150 tariff applies uniformly to all visa-required nationalities (incl. IND, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD); Category C nationals need prior IGM approval but pay the same consular fee.

fees.name: Visitor visa on arrival (standard)
fees.notes: Approval letter required before boarding; apply via Ministry of Home Affairs eServices portal (eservices.iss.gov.gy), processing 10-14 working days per Embassy of Guyana Brussels.

fees.name: Visitor visa on arrival (expedited)
fees.notes: Expedited processing of the visa-on-arrival approval.

fees.name: Tourist visa (embassy-issued, single entry)
fees.notes: Fees are set per mission in local currency (e.g. High Commission New Delhi charges INR 5,000 single-entry tourist). No universal USD schedule published; see reciprocity_variations.

fees.name: Business visa (embassy-issued)
fees.notes: Per-mission local-currency fees (e.g. New Delhi: INR 7,000 single entry, INR 10,000 multiple entry). No universal USD schedule verified.

variations.note: Single-entry tourist visa fee at the Guyana High Commission, New Delhi (non-refundable).
Single-entry business visa at Guyana High Commission New Delhi; multiple entry INR 10,000.

GUY.free_visa_notes: Guyana grants visa-free entry to nationals of most countries, including USA, GBR, CAN, EU members, CARICOM and most Commonwealth states - no fee applies for them. Fees above apply only to the minority of nationalities (e.g. IND, CHN, NGA, PAK, BGD) that require a visa.

fees.name: Ordinary visa / entry permit (visit, single entry)
fees.validity: typically valid for a single visit within 3 months of issue
fees.notes: Immigration Department fee table effective 08-04-2026. Same HK$330 fee applies to visit, business and student ordinary visas outside the specified talent/investment schemes.

fees.name: Ordinary visa (business visit)
fees.notes: Business visits use the same ordinary visa fee of HK$330; no separate business-visa category.

fees.name: Entry permit, multiple entries (1 year)
fees.notes: 3-year multiple-entry permit costs HK$1,350.

fees.name: e-Visa (electronic visa/entry permit)
fees.notes: Hong Kong issues visas electronically ('e-Visa') since 2021 for online applications; the fee is the same ordinary visa/entry permit fee, no separate e-visa surcharge.

HKG.free_visa_notes: Nationals of about 170 countries/territories may visit Hong Kong visa-free for 7 to 180 days (e.g. GBR 180 days; USA, CAN, RUS, PHL and most others 14-90 days). Visas are only required for a small set of nationalities (incl. IND pre-arrival registration - free; NGA, PAK, BGD require visas at HK$330). No visa-on-arrival or paid eTA regime exists; India nationals instead complete a free online Pre-arrival Registration.

fees.name: Consular visa (visa no consultada) - single entry
fees.validity: Single entry; ~60 days validity per Embassy of Honduras in Canada (embassy pages vary: 30-60 days). Stay up to 90 days, extendable 90 more via INM.
fees.notes: Issued by Honduran diplomatic/consular officer without Foreign Ministry/INM authorization. Also confirmed at https://hondurasembassyuk.com/visa/ (single US$30 / multiple US$60). Honduras has no e-visa, no visa on arrival and no eTA; CA-4 nationals (GTM, SLV, NIC) enter freely.

fees.name: Consular visa (visa no consultada) - multiple entry
fees.validity: Multiple entries, valid up to 1 year from issue (Embassy of Honduras in Canada)
fees.notes: Also listed by the Honduran Embassy in the UK as US$60 for multiple entry.

fees.name: Consulted visa (visa consultada)
fees.notes: US$100 fee established by Art. 127 numeral 12 of the Migration and Foreign Nationality Law regulations (INM). Confirmed by the Honduran Embassy in the UK. Processing after INM authorization can take ~4-8 weeks. Exact nationality list (typically includes several Asian and African countries) is published by INM; not itemized on the fetched embassy pages.

fees.name: Business travel (same consular visa schedule)
fees.validity: single US$30 / multiple US$60, same as tourist consular visa
fees.notes: Honduras does not publish a separate business-visa fee; business purposes are handled under the same consular visa (tourist/business) at US$30 single / US$60 multiple, or US$100 if the nationality requires a consulted visa.

fees.name: Transit
fees.notes: No separately published transit-visa fee found on official INM/embassy pages; visa-required nationals transiting would use the standard consular/consulted visa schedule. Amount left null rather than guessed.

variations.note: Most Western nationalities (USA, Canada, EU, Russia and others) are visa-exempt for up to 90 days and pay no visa fee. Caveat: the Honduran Embassy in Canada page states British citizens require a visa prior to travel, which conflicts with common visa-exempt listings; treat GBR as verify-before-travel. Fee variation in Honduras is by visa category (consular US$30/60 vs consulted US$100), not by per-nationality price.

HND.free_visa_notes: Many nationalities (USA, Canada, EU/Schengen, and CA-4 neighbours Guatemala, El Salvador, Nicaragua under free movement) enter Honduras visa-free for up to 90 days at no cost. Diplomatic, official and courtesy visas are issued free of charge. Honduras is not a Schengen member and has no e-visa, visa-on-arrival or eTA programme.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C, single/multiple entry)
fees.validity: Stays up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Croatia is a full Schengen member (since Jan 2023). Standard Schengen fee EUR 90; children 6-11 pay EUR 45, under 6 free. Fee waived for family of EU/Croatian citizens, students on school trips, researchers, and other Visa Code categories. Fee is non-refundable if the visa is refused.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) for business purposes
fees.validity: Stays up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Business travel uses the same Schengen C visa and fee as tourism; only the purpose/supporting documents differ.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.notes: Same EUR 90 Schengen Visa Code fee applies to airport transit (A) visas.

variations.note: Reduced EUR 35 fee under EU visa facilitation agreements still in force. The former EUR 35 facilitation fee for Russia (and Belarus in part) was suspended by the EU; Russian nationals now pay the standard EUR 90. None of the key nationalities IND/USA/GBR/CHN/NGA/PAK/PHL/BGD/CAN have a differing fee - all pay EUR 90.

vfs.note: Published VFS logistics fee in India is INR 2553 incl. GST (visa fee quoted as INR 10,200 / EUR 90). Service fees vary by country/centre; mandatory two-way courier INR 1332 applies outside New Delhi. Croatia uses VFS Global visa application centres in many countries per MFA notice.

HRV.free_visa_notes: Not free in general, but EU/EEA/Swiss citizens and ~90 visa-waiver nationalities enter visa-free. Visa fee waived for children under 6 and Visa Code exemption categories. Croatia has no e-visa, no visa on arrival, and no eTA; ETIAS is not yet operational as of this record date.

fees.name: Tourist fee on arrival (all non-Haitian passport holders)
fees.notes: Not a visa: Haiti grants visa-free entry up to 3 months to most nationalities; a US$10 tourist fee is collected on arrival at the airport.

fees.name: Tourist visa, 3 months single entry (visa-required nationalities)
fees.notes: Embassy-issued sticker visa; apply at least 1 month before departure. Payment by money order/certified/cashier's check to the Embassy of Haiti in Washington.

fees.name: Tourist visa, 6 months multiple entry (visa-required nationalities)
fees.notes: Per Embassy of Haiti (Washington DC) consular fee schedule.

fees.name: Business visa
fees.notes: No separate business visa fee published on the embassy fee schedule; most business visitors enter visa-free. Amount unverified, set to null.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No transit visa fee published on official sources; likely not a distinct category. Set to null rather than guessing.

HTI.free_visa_notes: Haiti is visa-free for up to 3 months for citizens of most countries. Only nationals of the Dominican Republic, Panama, Colombia, Cuba, Syria, Libya, Iran, Vietnam and Yemen require a pre-arranged embassy visa. All arriving non-Haitian passport holders pay a US$10 tourist fee at the airport. Haiti has no e-visa, visa-on-arrival, or eTA scheme and does not use VFS/TLS/BLS outsourced centres. Key nationalities IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, RUS, CAN are all visa-exempt.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C)
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Standard Schengen visa fee, EUR 90 since 11 June 2024 (raised from EUR 80). Children 6-12: EUR 45; under 6: free. Fee is charged in local-currency equivalent at consulates/VFS centres. Covers tourism and business purposes alike.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C, business purpose)
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Same C-type visa and fee as tourist; purpose of travel is business.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (type A)
fees.notes: Airport transit visas carry the same EUR 90 Schengen fee under the EU Visa Code.

variations.note: The EU-Russia visa facilitation agreement (EUR 35 fee) was fully suspended in September 2022; Russian citizens pay the standard EUR 90 fee (confirmed on VFS Hungary Russia one-pager).
Reduced EUR 35 fee under EU visa facilitation agreements (Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus). Verify per consulate; this is an EU-wide arrangement, not a Hungary-specific reciprocity fee.

vfs.note: India figures incl. 18% GST, per VFS Global Hungary-India pages; service fee varies by country/centre (roughly EUR 15-40 equivalent). Hungary outsources short-stay visa intake to VFS Global in many source countries.

HUN.free_visa_notes: Hungary is a Schengen member; citizens of visa-exempt countries (USA, GBR, CAN, most of Latin America, etc.) need no visa and pay no fee for short stays. Children under 6 are visa-fee exempt. Hungary has no e-visa, visa-on-arrival or own eTA; the EU ETIAS travel authorisation (EUR 20) for visa-exempt travellers is not yet in force as of this record's date.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival / e-VOA (B1) - tourism, business meeting, goods purchasing, transit
fees.validity: e-VOA valid 90 days from issuance; 30-day stay, extendable once for 30 days (extension also IDR 500,000)
fees.notes: Fee is uniform for all eligible nationalities. Card payments incur bank processing surcharges. Same IDR 500,000 applies at the airport VOA counter and online e-VOA.

fees.name: C1 Tourist e-Visa (single entry, 60 days)
fees.notes: Fee per official evisa.imigrasi.go.id FAQ. Payment processing fees extra. Applied online at evisa.imigrasi.go.id.

fees.name: C1 visit visa via Indonesian Embassy (Washington DC consular tariff) - tourism/family visit/transit
fees.notes: Embassy consular tariffs are set locally in USD and differ from the domestic IDR e-visa tariff. Applications route through evisa.imigrasi.go.id.

fees.name: C2 single-entry business visa (Embassy Washington DC tariff)
fees.notes: Visas requiring pre-approval from the Directorate General of Immigration may be charged an additional telex fee. Domestic IDR tariff for C2 e-visa not verified on the official portal.

fees.name: Transit
fees.notes: No separate transit visa fee: transit is a permitted purpose under the VOA/e-VOA (IDR 500,000) or the embassy C1 visa (USD 65 at Washington DC). Direct airside transit without entering does not require a visa.

fees.name: eTA / travel authorisation
fees.notes: Indonesia has no separate eTA scheme; the e-VOA fulfils this role. Note the previously broad visa-free ASEAN exemption remains for ASEAN nationals (no fee).

vfs.note: VFS Global operates an official alternative e-VOA channel (indonesiavoa.vfsevisa.id) and assists some embassy applications; a VFS service fee is charged on top of the IDR 500,000 government fee but the published amount could not be verified (site blocked automated access). Applying directly at evisa.imigrasi.go.id avoids any service fee.

IDN.free_visa_notes: ASEAN member-state nationals (and a small list of other exempt countries) enter visa-free for short stays at no cost; most other nationalities pay the VOA/e-visa fees above. No reciprocity-based fee differentiation: VOA and e-visa fees are flat for all eligible nationalities.

fees.name: e-Tourist Visa (30 days, double entry)
fees.notes: Country-specific fee schedule dated 20-Feb-2026. Some nationalities pay USD 0 (e.g. Argentina, Indonesia, Jamaica, Mauritius, Myanmar, Uruguay; Russia, Thailand, Malaysia, Philippines pay 0 for 30-day). Bank charge of 3% added to all e-visa fees.

fees.name: e-Tourist Visa (1 year, multiple entry)
fees.validity: 1 year, max 180 days stay per calendar year
fees.notes: Japan, Singapore, Sri Lanka pay USD 25; South Africa USD 25; several nationalities USD 0. Plus 3% bank charge.

fees.name: e-Tourist Visa (5 years, multiple entry)
fees.validity: 5 years, max 180 days stay per calendar year
fees.notes: USA USD 160; UK/Gibraltar/Jersey/Guernsey/Isle of Man USD 484; Russia USD 120; Japan/Sri Lanka/South Africa USD 25. Plus 3% bank charge.

fees.name: e-Business Visa (1 year, multiple entry)
fees.notes: Fee schedule dated 15-Apr-2026. Notable variations: USA USD 140, UK USD 242, Australia/Saudi Arabia USD 215, UAE USD 415, Philippines USD 220, Thailand USD 200, Japan USD 25; several nationalities USD 0. Plus 3% bank charge.

fees.name: e-Medical / e-Medical Attendant Visa
fees.notes: USA USD 100, UK USD 129, Russia USD 120, Bangladesh USD 0. Plus 3% bank charge.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival (Japan, South Korea, UAE nationals only)
fees.notes: INR 2,000 or equivalent in foreign currency per passenger (including children). Available only at Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Mumbai airports.

fees.name: Regular (sticker) Tourist Visa - embassy issued
fees.validity: varies by nationality (up to 10 years for US nationals)
fees.notes: Regular visa fees are set per nationality by reciprocity; no single global amount. Example (US nationals): Tourist 10-year USD 160. Plus ICWF USD 3 and outsourcing (VFS) service fee where applicable. See reciprocity_variations.

fees.name: Regular Business Visa - embassy issued
fees.validity: varies by nationality (10 years for US nationals)
fees.notes: Example (US nationals): Business 10-year USD 160. Reciprocity-based; verify at the Indian mission for each nationality.

fees.name: Transit Visa
fees.notes: Example (US nationals): USD 40. Reciprocity-based per nationality.

variations.note: Regular 10-year tourist visa; business 10-year also USD 160; transit USD 40; plus USD 3 ICWF + VFS service fee (Embassy of India Washington DC).
5-year e-Tourist USD 160 (vs standard 200); e-Business USD 140; e-Medical USD 100.
5-year e-Tourist USD 484; e-Business USD 242; e-Medical USD 129. 30-day/1-year e-Tourist standard (25/40).
30-day e-Tourist free; 1-year USD 40; 5-year USD 120; e-Business/e-Medical USD 120.
30-day e-Tourist free; 1-year USD 40; 5-year USD 200; e-Business USD 220.
Standard schedule: 30-day USD 25 (USD 10 Apr-Jun), 1-year USD 40, 5-year USD 200, e-Business USD 120.
Bangladesh: e-Medical/e-Medical Attendant USD 0; not eligible for e-Tourist/e-Business (regular visa regime applies, generally gratis for Bangladeshis per Indian High Commission Dhaka).
Pakistani nationals are not eligible for India e-visa or visa on arrival; regular visas under a restrictive bilateral regime, fee not published centrally.
China not listed on the Feb/Apr 2026 official e-visa fee schedules; Chinese nationals apply for regular visas via Indian missions (fee per mission schedule, not verified).
Nigeria not on the official e-Tourist fee schedule; Nigerian nationals use regular embassy visas (fee per Indian High Commission Abuja, not verified on an official page).

vfs.note: USD 19 per application at VFS Global centres in the USA, plus USD 3 ICWF; optional courier USD 18 and emergency processing USD 100. Service fees vary by country/centre (e.g. GBP-denominated in the UK).

IND.free_visa_notes: Not free in general, but India grants gratis e-visas to a set of nationalities (Argentina, Cook Islands, Fiji, Indonesia, Jamaica, Kiribati, Marshall Is., Mauritius, Micronesia, Mongolia, Myanmar, Nauru, Niue, Palau, PNG, Samoa, Seychelles, Solomon Is., Tonga, Tuvalu, Uruguay, Vanuatu; and 30-day e-Tourist free for Russia, Thailand, Malaysia, Philippines). Nepal and Bhutan citizens need no visa for India.

fees.name: Short stay 'C' visa - single journey (tourist/visit)
fees.validity: Single entry, stay up to 90 days
fees.notes: Administration fee; non-refundable if refused or withdrawn. Ireland is NOT in the Schengen Area, so the Schengen fee does not apply.

fees.name: Short stay 'C' visa - multi journey
fees.validity: Multiple entries, valid up to 5 years
fees.notes: Non-refundable administration fee.

fees.name: Short stay 'C' business visa (single journey)
fees.validity: Single entry, stay up to 90 days
fees.notes: Same fee schedule as visit visa: EUR 60 single / EUR 100 multi journey.

variations.note: Nationals of these countries are exempt from the visa application fee (fee waiver agreements). Note some (e.g. Brazil, Argentina, Chile) are visa-exempt for short stays anyway; the waiver matters for long-stay/D visas. Qualifying family members of EU/EEA/Swiss citizens under Directive 2004/38/EC are also fee-exempt.
Standard fee applies where a visa is required (EUR 60 single / EUR 100 multi). USA, GBR and CAN nationals do not need a visa for short stays.

vfs.note: VFS Global service charge in India is INR 3,380 incl. taxes (effective 1 Jun 2021, still published); fees vary by country/centre. Optional extras: premium lounge INR 2,625, courier INR 500. Ireland routes visa applications through VFS Global in many countries.

IRL.free_visa_notes: Ireland has no e-visa, visa on arrival, or eTA scheme (not in Schengen; ETIAS does not apply). Nationals of the EU/EEA, UK, USA, Canada and many other countries enter visa-free for short stays. 24 nationalities plus EU-family beneficiaries are exempt from the application fee.

fees.name: Tourist visa (Type B) - embassy-issued after e-visa application
fees.validity: Enter within 3 months of issue; stay typically 30 days
fees.notes: Iran has no single published global fee table; fees are set by reciprocity per nationality and collected at the embassy when the e-visa (evisa.mfa.ir) application is approved. Example official schedule from the Iranian Embassy in The Hague: EU passports EUR 50 tourist / EUR 60 entry; Afghan passports EUR 80 tourist / EUR 100 entry; Iraqi nationals free by bilateral agreement.

fees.name: Electronic visa via evisa.mfa.ir
fees.notes: The official portal does not publish a universal fee table; the fee depends on nationality and is paid at the chosen collection point (embassy or airport), not online at submission. Amount left null per accuracy rules. Separate mandatory health-insurance charge applies via the e-visa system: EUR 10 (single/double entry or 90-day multiple) to EUR 15 (6-month or 1-year multiple), per the Iranian Embassy in India (https://india.mfa.gov.ir/en/generalcategoryservices/9588/visa-fees).

fees.name: Visa on arrival at Iranian international airports
fees.notes: Official MFA page confirms VOA fee must be paid in euros through banking terminals at the airport but does not publish amounts; the fee varies by nationality (third-party sources report roughly EUR 75-150, unverified). Travellers should pre-apply on evisa.mfa.ir at least two days before travel and bring the printed Grant Notice.

fees.name: Entry/business visa (Type A)
fees.notes: Example official fee from the Iranian Embassy in The Hague; other embassies charge different reciprocity-based amounts.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Transit visas are applied for through the same e-visa portal; no official public fee table found, amount varies by nationality. Not verified - left null.

variations.note: Visa-free for ordinary Indian passport holders entering by air for tourism, 15-day stay, max twice per 6 months (2024 unilateral waiver programme, see https://brussels.mfa.gov.ir/en/NewsView/740375). Longer stays or land entry require a visa via evisa.mfa.ir; fee not centrally published.
Visa-free only for organised tourist groups under the Iran-Russia group visa-waiver agreement; individual travellers need a visa.

Not VOA-eligible; must join an authorised guided tour, obtain a Visa Grant Notice via the MFA/travel agency, and apply at an embassy or interests section. Fees are reciprocity-based and not published centrally (UK applicants have reported roughly GBP 165 via third-party sources - unverified).
Not VOA-eligible; embassy application with prior approval (Visa Grant Notice) required. Fee not published on official sources found.
Afghan passport/travel-document holders: EUR 80 tourist / EUR 100 entry visa per Iranian Embassy in The Hague official schedule.
Free of charge under the Iran-Iraq bilateral agreement (per Iranian Embassy in The Hague).
Chinese ordinary passport holders are visa-exempt for tourism under Iran's unilateral visa-waiver programme (21-day stays under the 2019 waiver, extended under the 2024 programme).

IRN.free_visa_notes: Iran waives visas for citizens of ~33 countries under its 2024 unilateral tourist visa-waiver programme (including India (air only), UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Indonesia, Malaysia, Japan, Singapore, Vietnam, Brazil, Mexico, Serbia, Croatia, Belarus, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Tunisia, Tanzania, Zimbabwe, Mauritius, Seychelles and others): 15-day non-extendable stays, tourism only, max twice per 6 months. Russians are visa-free in organised groups only. All other travellers pay reciprocity-based fees that Iran does not publish in a single central table.

fees.name: Visit visa for tourism/religious purposes (embassy-issued)
