fees.validity: Valid 3 months from issue; stay up to 1 month
fees.notes: Fee published by Iraq Ministry of Foreign Affairs for tourist/religious visit visas (groups and individuals).

fees.name: Normal (regular) visa
fees.validity: Valid 3 months; stay up to 3 months (residency registration within 10 days)
fees.notes: MOFA 'regular visa' used for non-tourist purposes including business-type visits; companions exempt.

fees.name: Multiple-entry visa
fees.notes: Fee published by Iraq MOFA for multi-entry visas.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.validity: Valid 3 months; stay up to 7 days
fees.notes: Transit visa type listed on official MOFA page but no fee published; amount unverified.

fees.name: Federal Iraq e-visa (evisa.iq)
fees.validity: 90-day validity, stay up to 30 days (as commonly reported)
fees.notes: Official portal evisa.iq does not publish the fee on public pages (fee shown only inside the application flow). Third-party sources consistently report ~USD 155-160 total including mandatory health insurance (~206,000 IQD); amount left null as it could not be verified on an official page.

fees.name: Kurdistan Region e-visa (visit.gov.krd)
fees.notes: USD 75 fee is the fee charged on the official KRG portal visit.gov.krd. Portal blocked automated fetch (Cloudflare); figure corroborated across multiple recent sources citing the portal - treat with medium confidence.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (federal Iraq) - suspended
fees.notes: Iraqi Ministry of Interior suspended VOA issuance from 1 March 2025; travellers must use the e-visa (evisa.iq). Limited VOA reportedly remains at Kurdistan Region airports for eligible nationals; no official fee published.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C), adult
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period, valid for the whole Schengen area
fees.notes: Iceland is a Schengen member; the uniform Schengen visa fee applies. Confirmed on island.is and government.is: 'The fee for a visa application is EUR 90 (EUR 45 for six to twelve year olds).' Children under 6 are exempt under the EU Visa Code. Iceland issues visas directly only in London, New Delhi, Beijing and Washington D.C.; in ~120 other cities other Schengen states' embassies process applications on Iceland's behalf. Covers tourism, business and family visits (same C-visa fee).

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C), child 6-12
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Reduced child fee per the EU Visa Code; children under 6 pay no fee.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) for business
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: No separate business-visa fee; business travel uses the same uniform Schengen C visa at EUR 90.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.notes: Under the EU Visa Code the airport transit (A) visa carries the same fee as the C visa (EUR 90 adult / EUR 45 child 6-12). Iceland's official pages quote a single 'visa application fee' of EUR 90 without a separate transit schedule.

fees.name: ETIAS travel authorisation (visa-exempt travellers) - not yet in operation
fees.notes: ETIAS is NOT yet in force as of July 2026; launch expected in late 2026/2027 after the EES rollout. The EU set the fee at EUR 20 (free for under-18s and over-70s). No fee is currently payable to enter Iceland visa-free.

variations.note: The Schengen visa fee is uniform - Iceland publishes no nationality-based reciprocity schedule. Reduced EUR 35 rates under EU visa-facilitation agreements no longer apply to Russia (suspended since 2022; RUS nationals pay EUR 90). IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, CAN all pay the standard EUR 90 where a visa is required (USA/GBR/CAN nationals are visa-exempt for short stays).

vfs.note: India: VFS service charge INR 2,900 (approx EUR 29) per application, incl. 18% GST; optional extras (courier INR 518, SMS INR 345, etc.) on top. Service fees vary by centre/country - typically around EUR 29-40 equivalent (UK centres publish approx GBP/EUR 40). Iceland is represented via VFS in at least 14 source countries in our data (ARE, CAN, CHN, GBR, HKG, IDN, IND, IRL, JPN, MYS, PHL, SGP, THA, USA), usually operating for the Schengen state representing Iceland (often Denmark or Norway).

ISL.free_visa_notes: Nationals of EU/EEA countries and ~60 visa-exempt countries (incl. USA, GBR, CAN, JPN, AUS) need no visa and currently pay nothing for short stays; ETIAS (EUR 20) will apply to them once operational. Iceland has no e-visa or visa on arrival - all visas are issued in advance via embassies/VFS centres.

fees.name: ETA-IL (Electronic Travel Authorization)
fees.validity: Up to 2 years, multiple entries, max 90 days per visit
fees.notes: NIS 25, paid by credit card, non-refundable. Official portal of the Population and Immigration Authority (PIBA).

fees.name: eVisa-B2 (electronic visitor visa)
fees.notes: Applied online via PIBA portal; processing about 10 business days. Fee NIS 100.

fees.name: B/2 visitor visa (embassy/consulate sticker visa)
fees.notes: MFA publishes consular tariffs on a dynamic fee collector page (blocked to automated fetch); fee is charged in local currency and adjusted with exchange rates. In India it is currently INR 2,350 (see reciprocity_variations). No global USD amount could be verified, so amount left null.

fees.name: B/2 business visa (same B/2 category covers business visits)
fees.notes: Israel does not have a separate short-stay business visa; business visitors use the B/2 (or eVisa-B2 at NIS 100 where eligible). Consular fee same as tourist B/2.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: Israel has no general visa-on-arrival regime; travellers need an ETA-IL, eVisa-B2 or consular visa before travel.

fees.name: B/3 transit visa
fees.notes: Fee published only on the MFA consular tariff collector (not fetchable programmatically); amount unverified so left null.

variations.note: B/2 Business & Tourist embassy fee in India (effective 2 Jan 2025), plus INR 1,805 service/logistics fee at the application centre; fastrack option adds INR 5,942. Fees track the USD/INR rate.
Indian citizens resident in India are eligible for the eVisa-B2 online channel at NIS 100.
Visa-exempt nationalities pay only the NIS 25 ETA-IL; no visa fee.

vfs.note: Israel Visa Application Centres (VFS Global) in Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru charge INR 1,805 service/logistics fee per application (Jan 2025 schedule); VFS also runs Israel visa centres in other countries (e.g. UAE) where a service fee of about ILS 143 equivalent applies - varies by centre.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C, tourism, up to 90 days)
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Uniform Schengen fee per Regulation (EC) 810/2009, raised from EUR 80 to EUR 90 on 11 June 2024. Children 6-12: EUR 45; under 6: free; study/research (C) visas: free; EU-citizen family members: free. Consulates collect the local-currency equivalent, adjusted quarterly (e.g. USD 105.50 at Embassy Washington, Apr-Jun 2026).

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C, business)
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Same uniform Schengen C fee as tourism; no separate business tariff.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.notes: VFS/consular fee schedules list Categories A, B or C at the same EUR 90 uniform fee.

fees.name: ETIAS travel authorisation (EU-wide, for visa-exempt nationals)
fees.notes: EU-level authorisation, not Italy-specific. Fee set at EUR 20 (raised from the originally legislated EUR 7); free for under-18s and over-70s. Not yet in operation as of the record date - verify launch status before relying on it.

variations.note: Reduced Schengen fee under EU visa facilitation agreements (Embassy Washington lists USD 41.10 equivalent, Apr-Jun 2026). The EU-Russia facilitation agreement is suspended, so Russian nationals pay the full EUR 90. No special rates for IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, CAN (USA/GBR/CAN are visa-exempt for short stays).

vfs.note: Published VFS Global service charge per application in India (Bengaluru/Chennai/Hyderabad/Mumbai, effective Apr 2026), incl. taxes. Service fees vary by country and centre; optional premium-lounge/courier services cost extra. Italy also uses other outsourcers in some countries.

ITA.free_visa_notes: No e-visa or visa on arrival exists for Italy; all visas are embassy/consulate-issued Schengen or national visas. Schengen C visas are free for children under 6, study (C) and research (C) applicants, and family members of EU citizens. Italy also charges a national long-stay (Type D) visa fee (approx. EUR 116; Embassy Washington lists USD 136 for Apr-Jun 2026), outside the scope of this short-stay record.

fees.name: Entry visa (consular, issued at Jamaican mission prior to arrival)
fees.notes: No single flat fee: Jamaica charges strictly reciprocal consular visa fees per nationality (e.g. CHN US$60, PAK US$80, PHL US$25, RUS US$100, NGA US$20, USA US$160 for non-tourist purposes; Sri Lanka gratis). An additional US$15 consular fee is payable with every application (some missions quote US$20 administrative fee, e.g. Embassy Tokyo). Commonwealth/CARICOM nationals are visa-free.

fees.name: Port of Entry (POE) visa
fees.validity: single entry; length of stay as granted by immigration officer
fees.notes: PICA lists 'Port of Entry Visa: US$100.00'. Persons landing without a required prior visa who are not POE-eligible face a US$350.00 fee. PICA advises obtaining visas prior to arrival where possible.

fees.name: Electronic C5 immigration/customs declaration (enterjamaica.gov.jm)
fees.notes: Not a visa or paid eTA - a free online C5 arrival declaration operated by PICA. Jamaica has no paid eTA or e-visa system.

fees.name: Business visa (consular)
fees.notes: Same reciprocity-based fee schedule as the tourist/entry visa; several tourist-exemption nationalities (e.g. USA beyond tourism, Colombia, Panama, Venezuela for business) still need a visa at their nationality's reciprocal rate plus US$15 consular fee.

fees.name: Transit through Jamaica
fees.notes: No separately published transit visa fee; visa-required nationals transiting landside follow the standard entry-visa schedule. Cruise passengers do not require a visa per MFAFT. Amount set to null as no official transit-specific fee is published.

variations.note: Commonwealth - no visa required for India
US citizens visa-free for tourism up to 180 days; visa required for all other purposes at US$160 (reciprocal), obtained prior to arrival
Commonwealth - no visa required for UK
Visa-free up to 30 days for tourism; US$60 visa for other purposes
Commonwealth but visa required; US$20, obtained prior to arrival
Commonwealth but visa required; US$80, obtained prior to arrival
Visa required prior to arrival; US$25
Commonwealth - no visa required for Bangladesh
US$100; visa also obtainable at port of entry
Commonwealth - no visa required for Canada

JAM.free_visa_notes: Jamaica is visa-free for all Commonwealth and CARICOM nationals (incl. IND, GBR, CAN, AUS, BGD, ZAF) and for most of the Americas, EU/EEA and East Asia for tourism (30-180 days depending on nationality). Consular visa fees, where required, are strictly reciprocal per nationality (gratis to US$160) plus a US$15 consular fee. All visitors must complete the free online C5 declaration at enterjamaica.gov.jm.

fees.name: Single-entry visa on arrival
fees.notes: Fee waived if arriving via Aqaba (ASEZA) or if holding a Jordan Pass and staying at least 2 nights (3 days); otherwise the fee is charged on departure.

fees.name: Single-entry e-visa (Ministry of Interior eservices portal)
fees.validity: typically valid ~60 days from issue, 1 month stay
fees.notes: Same government fee schedule as visa on arrival; apply via https://eservices.moi.gov.jo (confirmed as official portal by Royal Jordanian, https://www.rj.com/en/jordan-e-visa).

fees.name: Double-entry entry visa
fees.notes: JOD 60 double-entry is the consistently published rate (US Embassy Amman and multiple visa guides) but could not be re-verified directly on a Jordanian government page during this crawl; Jordan Pass does not waive multi-entry fees.

fees.name: Multiple-entry entry visa
fees.notes: JOD 120 multiple-entry is the consistently published rate; not re-verified directly on a Jordanian government page during this crawl.

fees.name: Transit visa/permit
fees.notes: No transit visa needed for airside transit at Queen Alia Airport. A published transit fee could not be verified on an official source; amount left null.

JOR.free_visa_notes: Visa fee (single entry) is waived for Jordan Pass holders staying at least 2 nights, and for travellers entering via the Aqaba Special Economic Zone. Nationals of most Arab League states enter visa-free.

fees.name: Short-term single-entry visa (embassy/consulate sticker visa)
fees.validity: typically 3 months to enter; stays up to 90 days
fees.notes: Fee raised from JPY 3,000 to JPY 15,000 for applications filed on or after 1 July 2026 (first revision since 1978, cabinet-approved 19 June 2026). Payable in local currency at the embassy/consulate on issuance; collected only if the visa is granted. MOFA pages are Akamai-blocked to bots, so amounts cross-confirmed via consulate announcements (Consulate-General of Japan in Detroit, 'VISA FEES Effective July 1, 2026') and immigration-law firm alerts (Fragomen, Newland Chase).

fees.name: Short-term multiple-entry visa
fees.notes: Raised from JPY 6,000 to JPY 30,000 effective 1 July 2026; collected on issuance.

fees.name: JAPAN eVISA (online single-entry short-term visa)
fees.validity: single entry, stays up to 90 days
fees.notes: Pre-July-2026 the eVISA fee was 'equivalent to JPY 3,000' (single-entry rate), paid online by credit card. The eVISA is a single-entry visa, so the new JPY 15,000 single-entry rate is expected to apply from 1 July 2026, but MOFA had not published separate eVISA-specific confirmation at time of research - amount left null rather than guessed.

fees.name: Short-term business visa (single or multiple entry)
fees.notes: Japan does not have a separate business-visa fee tier; short-term business visits use the same single/multiple-entry fee schedule (JPY 15,000 / JPY 30,000 from 1 July 2026).

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: The old transit-visa fee was JPY 700. Reports on the 1 July 2026 revision indicate the separate transit category is merged into the single/double-entry fee category; no official post-revision transit fee could be verified on a reachable MOFA page, so amount is null.

variations.note: Indian nationals pay a reduced fee of INR 500 for both single- and multiple-entry short-term visas under a bilateral reciprocal arrangement (VFS Global official Japan-India fee page, effective 1 April 2025; other nationalities applying in India paid INR 1,750 single / INR 3,450 multiple pre-revision). Media reports state the INR 500 concession continues after 1 July 2026, but post-revision official confirmation was not reachable - verify before relying on it.

MOFA states nationals of some countries/regions are exempt from or pay reduced visa fees under reciprocal arrangements, but the per-country schedule page (mofa.go.jp) blocks automated access; standard rate JPY 15,000/30,000 applies unless a bilateral concession exists. USA/GBR/CAN nationals are visa-exempt for short tourist/business stays, so no fee normally arises.

vfs.note: India: INR 800 (incl. taxes) per application, charged even for fee-exempt applicants; optional courier INR 550. Japan outsources visa intake to VFS Global in many countries (India, China, Philippines, UK, Russia, etc.); service fee varies by country/centre.

JPN.free_visa_notes: Japan is not Schengen. No visa on arrival and no eTA yet (the JESTA electronic travel authorisation for visa-exempt visitors is planned but not launched as of July 2026). Nationals of ~70 visa-exempt countries (USA, UK, Canada, EU, Australia, etc.) need no visa and pay no fee for short stays. Fees collected only when a visa is issued; some nationalities are fee-exempt or reduced under reciprocal arrangements (e.g., India INR 500).

fees.name: Tourist visa (B12), single entry
fees.notes: Official consular fee schedule levied at Kazakh missions abroad; equivalents published as 50 EUR / 50 GBP / 60 CHF / 6,000 RUB / 385 CNY. No nationality-based variation in the schedule.

fees.name: Tourist visa, multiple entry
fees.notes: Equivalents: 80 EUR / 80 GBP / 90 CHF / 9,000 RUB / 580 CNY.

fees.name: Electronic visa (tourist/business/medical) via vmp.gov.kz
fees.notes: Applied for on the Visa and Migration Portal (vmp.gov.kz); requires invitation number. Consular fee for the corresponding visa category is charged (tourist single-entry USD 60; standard/business single-entry USD 80 per consular fee schedule). Exact category fee shown at payment on the portal.

fees.name: Business/standard visa, single entry
fees.notes: Single-entry non-tourist/non-transit visa: 80 USD / 75 EUR / 75 GBP / 80 CHF / 8,000 RUB / 515 CNY. Multi-entry visas by duration range from USD 200 (1 year) to USD 1000 (5 years).

fees.name: Transit visa, single entry
fees.notes: Equivalents: 15 EUR / 15 GBP / 20 CHF / 2,000 RUB / 130 CNY. Multi-entry transit: USD 90.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (pre-arranged, at international airports)
fees.notes: Available only as a pre-arranged visa issued at the airport; fee follows the standard consular fee schedule for the visa category. Exact published on-arrival amount not verified on an official page, so amount left null (third-party sources cite ~USD 80).

KAZ.free_visa_notes: Kazakhstan grants visa-free entry (typically 14-90 days) to nationals of roughly 80 countries, including USA, UK, Canada, EU states, China and (14 days) India; EAEU/CIS nationals such as Russians enter visa-free. For these travellers no visa fee applies for short stays. E-visa/consular fees above apply only to nationalities outside the visa-free list or for longer/other-purpose stays.

fees.name: Electronic Travel Authorisation (eTA) - standard processing
fees.validity: Valid for travel within 90 days of issuance; stay duration determined at port of entry (typically up to 90 days)
fees.notes: Fee shown at checkout on the official portal is USD 32.50 standard processing plus ~USD 1.59 bank/payment fee (total ~USD 34.09). The portal does not publish the fee on static pages, so the exact split could not be re-verified on a static official page; base government figure sometimes cited as USD 30. EAC citizens (Burundi, DRC, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, Uganda) are exempt and may stay up to 180 days. Same-aircraft/airside airport transit passengers are exempt per Kenya Embassy Washington DC.

fees.name: East Africa Tourist Visa (Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda)
fees.notes: Joint EAC visa; flat USD 100 fee confirmed on Uganda NCIC official page. For Kenya as first entry, applied via etakenya.go.ke.

fees.name: Airport transit (same aircraft / airside)
fees.notes: Exempt from eTA requirement. Travellers who leave the airport must obtain the standard eTA.

KEN.free_visa_notes: Kenya abolished visas for all nationalities in January 2024; entry is visa-free but requires a paid eTA (~USD 32.50 + bank fee) except for EAC citizens, who enter free for up to 180 days.

fees.name: Tourist visa (TS), 1 month single entry (embassy)
fees.notes: Fee published by the Embassy of the Kyrgyz Republic in the USA and Canada; 2-month single entry is USD 50. Consular fees can differ by mission.

fees.name: e-Visa (tourist, official portal evisa.e-gov.kg)
fees.notes: Official portal states 'visa fee depends on visa category, type and period' and shows the exact amount only at the payment step; it does not publish a public tariff table. Third-party guides cite roughly USD 41-52 for 30/60-day tourist e-visas incl. bank charges, but this is not verified on an official source. Fee is non-refundable if refused.

fees.name: Business visa (B), 1 month single entry (embassy)
fees.notes: 1 month multiple entry USD 70; 2 months single USD 70; 2 months multiple USD 90.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (Manas International Airport, Bishkek)
fees.notes: VOA at Manas airport is reported by third-party sources at roughly USD 50-70 depending on type, but no official published fee schedule was found; the government primarily directs applicants to the e-visa portal. Amount left null rather than guessed.

variations.note: US citizens can obtain a 10-year multiple-entry tourist/business visa (up to 180 days per visit) for USD 185 under the bilateral agreement effective 4 March 2024. Note: US citizens are also visa-free for short stays (up to 60 days).

KGZ.free_visa_notes: Kyrgyzstan is not a Schengen member. Citizens of ~60+ countries (incl. USA, GBR, CAN, RUS and other EAEU/CIS states, EU, GCC, Japan, Korea, etc.) enter visa-free for 30-90 days depending on nationality; Maldives citizens and Hong Kong/Macau SAR permanent residents get 30 days visa-free. Fees above apply only to nationalities that require a visa (e.g. IND, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD are e-visa eligible).

fees.name: e-Visa Tourist (Type T)
fees.validity: Valid 3 months from issue; single entry, stay up to 30 days
fees.notes: USD 30 visa fee + USD 6 processing fee, per the official evisa.gov.kh portal FAQ. Apply only via evisa.gov.kh; many copycat sites charge more.

fees.name: e-Visa Business/Ordinary (Type E)
fees.validity: Valid 3 months from issue; single entry, stay up to 30 days (extendable in-country)
fees.notes: USD 35 visa fee per official portal; the USD 6 e-visa processing fee applies when issued online.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival - Tourist (T)
fees.notes: Official published Type T visa fee is USD 30; visa on arrival is paid in cash (USD) at international airports and major land borders without the online processing fee.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival - Business/Ordinary (E)
fees.notes: Official published Type E visa fee is USD 35, paid in cash at the port of entry.

fees.name: Embassy tourist visa (Type T) - Berlin embassy example
fees.notes: Embassy-issued sticker visa fees are set in local currency and vary by mission; Berlin charges EUR 40 tourist / EUR 45 business.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No transit-visa fee is published on the official e-visa portal; Cambodia does not operate a distinct transit-visa scheme in practice. Amount left null rather than guessed.

KHM.free_visa_notes: Cambodia charges flat USD fees regardless of nationality (no reciprocity schedule). Nationals of ASEAN member states (and a few bilateral-agreement countries) are visa-exempt for short stays per the MFAIC visa-exemption list; everyone else pays the fees above. No eTA scheme and no outsourced visa centre (VFS/TLS/BLS) - applications go direct via evisa.gov.kh, on arrival, or at embassies.

fees.name: Visitor Visa (tourism / visiting family or friends)
fees.validity: single-entry usually up to 3 months; multiple-entry up to 6 months
fees.notes: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs & Immigration does not publish a visa fee schedule online. The official Visitor Visa application form only says to pay the 'appropriate fee' and to contact visaofficer@mfa.gov.ki for payment details. Amount left null rather than estimated.

fees.name: Visitor Visa (business purpose)
fees.notes: Business visits use the same Visitor Visa form with additional evidence of employment/business. Fee not published; contact visaofficer@mfa.gov.ki.

fees.name: Transit Visa
fees.notes: Transit Visa exists as a category on the official MFA visa page; fee not published online.

KIR.free_visa_notes: Kiribati is visa-free for the vast majority of travellers: under the Immigration Entry and Visa Exemption Order 2023, citizens of roughly 190 countries and territories (including USA, UK, Canada, all EU states, Australia, New Zealand, India and China) may enter without a visa for up to 1 month, capped at 90 days of stay within any 12-month period. Only the small remainder of nationalities need a visa in advance; there is no e-visa, eTA or visa-on-arrival scheme, and applications are handled directly by the Immigration Division (visaofficer@mfa.gov.ki) with no VFS/TLS/BLS outsourcing. Fee amounts are not published on any official source, so they are recorded as null.

fees.name: Visitor e-Visa (visa on arrival issued after online approval)
fees.validity: Single entry, up to 30 days stay
fees.notes: Applicants apply online at evisa.gov.kn; confirmation presented at passport control where visa is issued on arrival by an immigration officer. Fee corroborated on Embassy of St. Kitts and Nevis to the USA FAQ page.

fees.name: Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA) - Electronic Border Management System
fees.validity: Single entry, submit up to 90 days before travel
fees.notes: Mandatory for all visitors regardless of visa requirement, separate from the visa fee. An introductory rate of USD 8.50 applied until 1 September 2025; standard rate of USD 17 has applied since. Exact current figure not independently re-confirmed by direct fetch of the FAQ page content (search-engine cache used) - review before relying on it for payment purposes.

fees.name: Visitor visa (embassy/high commission issued, non-e-visa route)
fees.notes: St Kitts and Nevis has largely moved to the online e-Visa system (USD 100) issued on arrival; no separate confirmed official fee schedule found for a distinct paper/sticker embassy visa. Treat the e-visa fee above as the current tourist visa fee.

fees.name: Business visa
fees.notes: No distinct official business-visa fee schedule located; business travel likely uses the same e-Visa (USD 100) process as tourist visas. Not confirmed on an official source, so left null rather than assumed.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No official transit-visa fee schedule located.

KNA.free_visa_notes: Many nationalities (including EU, UK, US, Canada, most Commonwealth and CARICOM countries) are visa-exempt for short stays but ALL travellers, including visa-exempt nationalities, must obtain the Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA, USD 17) via the Electronic Border Management System before arrival. Nationalities that are not visa-exempt must additionally obtain the e-Visa (USD 100), which functions as a visa-on-arrival after online pre-approval. No official nationality-specific reciprocity fee schedule (e.g. differing rates for IND/USA/GBR/CHN/etc.) was found on government or embassy sources; VisaHQ and similar third-party visa agencies show varying service fees but these are not official government fees and were excluded per sourcing rules.

fees.name: Single-entry visa (stay 90 days or less)
fees.notes: Standard fee published by Korean embassies effective from 1 Jan 2026; actual fee charged depends on applicant's nationality due to reciprocity-based adjustments. Fee shown here is the general/default rate quoted on the US embassy fee schedule; amount may be denominated in local currency at other missions (e.g. SGD, INR).

fees.name: Single-entry visa (stay more than 90 days)
fees.notes: Standard default rate; varies by nationality.

fees.name: Double-entry visa
fees.notes: Standard default rate; varies by nationality.

fees.name: Multiple-entry visa
fees.notes: Standard default rate; varies by nationality.

fees.name: K-ETA (Korea Electronic Travel Authorization)
fees.validity: up to 2 years or until passport expiry; multiple entries for stays up to 90 days (or per exemption rules)
fees.notes: K-ETA fee is 10,000 KRW (approx USD 7-8, exact USD varies with exchange rate), non-refundable even if denied; online card processing fee charged separately. Korea's Ministry of Justice has extended a temporary K-ETA exemption for ~67 eligible nationalities through 31 Dec 2026, during which no K-ETA (and no fee) is required for those nationals for short-term visits.

fees.name: Short-term business visa (C-3)
fees.notes: Short-term business visa follows the same single/double/multiple-entry fee bands as the standard short-term (C-3) visa fee schedule above (i.e. USD 40/60/70/90 standard rate, subject to nationality adjustment); no separate published business-specific fee line was found on official sources, so left null here to avoid guessing an exact figure distinct from the general schedule.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Korea generally allows visa-free transit (up to 30 days at certain airports, e.g. Jeju, or short airside transit) for many nationalities without a transit visa fee; no distinct official transit visa fee figure was found, so left null to avoid guessing. Travelers requiring a transit visa would pay under the standard single-entry visa fee schedule.

variations.note: US citizens pay a flat USD 45 for all visa types (single, double, multiple entry) rather than the tiered standard rate, per US embassy schedule effective 1 Jan 2026. Source: https://overseas.mofa.go.kr/us-en/brd/m_4502/view.do?seq=715889

UK nationals are charged a higher adjusted rate (roughly USD 130-250 equivalent depending on visa type per US-embassy-published comparison, and SGD 26-326 range per Singapore embassy schedule) due to reciprocity; exact tiered figures were not independently confirmed per visa type on this pass, so left as range/null - see source pages for the applicable mission's exact table. Sources: https://overseas.mofa.go.kr/us-en/brd/m_4502/view.do?seq=715889 and https://overseas.mofa.go.kr/sg-en/brd/m_2444/view.do?seq=761414

Russia is listed among nationalities with adjusted (higher) visa fees (roughly USD 50-120 range per visa type cited on US embassy comparison); precise official tiered figures not independently verified line-by-line in this pass. Source: https://overseas.mofa.go.kr/us-en/brd/m_4502/view.do?seq=715889

Single-entry visa up to 90 days: INR 3,400; visa valid more than 90 days: INR 5,100 (revised fees effective 1 June 2025, per VFS Global Korea-India visa fee table). This is the government visa fee only, separate from the VFS service fee. Source: https://www.vfsglobal.com/india/southkorea/pdf/Visa-fees.pdf

vfs.note: VFS Global operates the Korea Visa Application Centres in India (New Delhi, Bengaluru, and other cities) on behalf of the Korean government/embassy. Published additional/service fee is approx INR 1,380 per application; this is charged on top of the government visa fee (e.g. INR 3,400 for a standard single-entry ≤90-day visa) and can vary by service tier or centre. VFS also operates Korea visa centres for other countries (e.g. Indonesia, per visaforkorea-id.com), but detailed fee figures for those were not captured in this pass.

KOR.free_visa_notes: South Korea is not a Schengen member. Many nationalities (currently ~67 countries including most of Western Europe, US, UK, Canada, Australia, Japan, etc.) can enter visa-free for short stays (typically 30-90 days depending on bilateral agreement), and K-ETA is temporarily waived for those nationalities through 31 Dec 2026 (Visit Korea Year exemption). Outside that exemption window, eligible visa-exempt nationals would normally need to pay the K-ETA fee (10,000 KRW) instead of a full visa fee. Nationalities not covered by visa-free/K-ETA-exempt arrangements require a paid visa per the fee schedule above.

fees.name: Kuwait Tourist e-Visa (MOI portal kuwaitvisa.moi.gov.kw)
fees.validity: Typically issued for stays up to 3 months; visit visas priced KWD 10 per month under Ministerial Resolution 2249/2025 (in force 23 Dec 2025)
fees.notes: Historic e-visa fee was KWD 3; from 23 Dec 2025 all entry/visit visas (family, business, tourist, medical) cost KWD 10 per month under the new Executive Regulations of the Residence of Foreigners Law (Ministerial Resolution No. 2249 of 2025). Exact per-issuance amount on the MOI portal could not be scraped (JS-rendered); apply only via the official portal kuwaitvisa.moi.gov.kw.

fees.name: Visa on arrival at Kuwait International Airport
fees.notes: US State Dept confirms KWD 10 visa on arrival for US citizens allowing a stay of up to three months; consistent with the KWD 10/month fee set by Ministerial Resolution 2249/2025.

fees.name: Business/commercial visit visa
fees.validity: KWD 10 per month; visit visas generally valid 3 months, renewable up to 1 year
fees.notes: Under the Dec 2025 executive regulations all visit visa categories including business are priced at KWD 10 per month.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.validity: Up to 7 days, historically arranged via carrier/shipping agent or Kuwaiti mission
fees.notes: Historic transit visa fee was around KWD 2 but no current official published amount could be verified after the Dec 2025 fee overhaul; amount left null.

fees.name: Embassy-issued entry (visit) visa
fees.validity: KWD 10 per month of validity; visit visas generally 3 months, renewable to max 1 year
fees.notes: All entry and visit visas set at KWD 10 per month by Ministerial Resolution No. 2249 of 2025 (effective 23 Dec 2025); embassies may collect equivalent in local currency.

fees.name: Laos eVisa (Tourist, single entry)
fees.validity: Enter within 60 days of approval; stay up to 30 days
fees.notes: USD 50 total (visa fee USD 35 + USD 15 processing/service charge), plus bank charge. Reduced rate USD 35 for Chinese and Vietnamese nationals. Apply only via the official portal laoevisa.gov.la.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival (Tourist, 30 days)
fees.notes: Fee varies by nationality, roughly USD 30-45 (commonly cited: USA/UK/EU USD 35, Canada USD 42, India ~USD 40). The Department of Immigration does not publish a machine-readable schedule online, so no single amount is verified; a USD 1-2 overtime surcharge applies outside office hours, weekends and holidays. Payable in cash USD at the border.

fees.name: Embassy-issued Tourist Visa (T-B3, single entry)
fees.validity: Use within 2 months of issue; 30 days stay, extendable
fees.notes: USD 50 for US/Canadian citizens; USD 10 for persons of Lao origin (service only); +USD 20 expedited. Fees at other Lao embassies differ by nationality (reciprocity).

fees.name: Business Visa (NI-B2)
fees.notes: Embassy of Laos in Washington DC lists a flat visa fee schedule without a separate published business-visa amount; fee not independently verified, generally similar to the USD 50 embassy fee.

fees.name: Transit Visa (TR-B3)
fees.notes: Transit visa exists in Lao visa classification but no fee is published online by the Department of Immigration or the Washington embassy; amount unverified.

variations.note: Reduced eVisa rate for Chinese nationals per official eVisa fee calculator.
Russian citizens are visa-exempt for stays up to 30 days under bilateral agreement; no visa fee.
Embassy of Lao PDR in Washington DC fee for US/Canadian citizens.
Nigerian, Pakistani and Bangladeshi nationals are NOT eligible for visa on arrival and must obtain a visa in advance from an embassy.

LAO.free_visa_notes: Laos is not visa-free for everyone, but ASEAN nationals (and some others e.g. Russia, Japan, South Korea, Switzerland, Luxembourg, Mongolia) enter visa-free for 14-30 days depending on nationality.

fees.name: Tourist visa on arrival (eligible nationalities)
fees.validity: 1 month, extendable free of charge to 3 months
fees.notes: Issued free at Beirut airport and land/sea border posts. Requires phone number, address in Lebanon, return ticket and no Israeli stamps. GCC (SAU, ARE, KWT, BHR, QAT, OMN) and Jordanian citizens get a free 3-6 month visa; Turkish citizens a free 3-month multiple-entry visa.

fees.name: Tourist/visit visa - General Security domestic fee schedule
fees.notes: General Directorate of General Security fee schedule: tourist/visit, work/entry, converting and renewing visas each 2,000,000 LBP. USD approximation at prevailing market rate; LBP value fluctuates.

fees.name: Transit visa - General Security fee schedule
fees.notes: Transit or residence visa (single or double entry) 2,000,000 LBP per GDGS schedule.

fees.name: Embassy sticker visa - Lebanese Embassy London
fees.validity: single entry; GBP 97 two entries, GBP 135 multiple entries
fees.notes: Same fee scale for all visa categories at the London embassy; paid in cash or postal order when the application is accepted.

fees.name: Tourist visa via VFS Global (India centres, Embassy of Lebanon New Delhi)
fees.validity: single entry; INR 11,750 double, INR 16,450 multiple
fees.notes: Embassy visa fee, excludes VFS service fee INR 1,920.

fees.name: Business visa via VFS Global (India centres)
fees.validity: single entry; INR 11,750 double, INR 16,450 multiple
fees.notes: Same scale as tourist at India centres; official-passport holders GRATIS.

variations.note: Eligible for the free 1-month visa on arrival (extendable to 3 months) per General Security.
Not VOA-eligible; must apply via Embassy of Lebanon (New Delhi) through VFS Global. Single entry INR 8,250.
Collective/tourist-group visas for Nigeria, Ghana and Ivory Coast require prior approval; 2,450,000 LBP per person per GDGS schedule.
Not VOA-eligible; pre-arranged visa with General Security approval required. No nationality-specific published fee found on an official source; domestic GDGS schedule fee is 2,000,000 LBP.

vfs.note: India centres: INR 1,920 incl. GST plus INR 150 in-person convenience charge. Varies by centre - e.g. Nepal NPR 2,700 plus NPR 2,700 mandatory two-way courier. VFS handles Lebanon visas from at least IND, NPL, BTN, LKA, THA.

LBN.free_visa_notes: Most Western, GCC and many Asian nationalities receive a free 1-month visa on arrival (extendable to 3 months at no cost). GCC citizens and Jordanians get free 3-6 month visas; Turkish citizens free 3-month multiple entry. Lebanon has no e-visa or eTA system.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival (online pre-approval, Liberia Immigration Service)
fees.validity: Approval valid for entry within 3 months; sticker issued on arrival for 30 or 90 days, single entry
fees.notes: Non-refundable; paid online by Visa/Mastercard via the official LIS portal. This is Liberia's official e-visa-on-arrival channel; third-party sites (e.g. evisaliberia.com) charge more and are not official.

fees.name: Embassy visa, single entry (1-3 months)
fees.notes: Fee schedule of Liberian Consulate General New York. Rush service: +USD 75 same day, +USD 50 next day/under 5 days. Fees non-refundable.

fees.name: Embassy visa, 1 year multiple entry
fees.notes: Same fee applies for tourist or business purpose; Liberia issues a single 'Regular' visa category.

fees.name: Business visa (Regular visa, same schedule as tourist)
fees.validity: 1-3 months single entry (multiple-entry options 150/250 USD as above)
fees.notes: Liberia does not publish a separate business-visa fee; tourist and business use the same Regular visa fee schedule.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No separate transit visa fee published on official Liberian embassy/consulate or LIS sources; transit travellers appear to use the regular visa or visa on arrival (USD 102.50 covers tourism, business or transit).

variations.note: US citizens pay USD 180 for a 3-year multiple-entry tourist/business visa (reciprocity adjustment effective 21 Oct 2024).
ECOWAS citizens (incl. Nigeria, Ghana, Senegal etc.) enter Liberia visa-free with an ECOWAS passport valid at least 6 months.

LBR.free_visa_notes: ECOWAS-member nationals are visa-free with a valid ECOWAS passport (6+ months validity).

fees.name: Libya e-Visa (tourist, single entry)
fees.validity: 90 days validity, stay up to 30 days (single entry)
fees.notes: Official portal (evisa.gov.ly, launched 21 Mar 2024) is a JavaScript app that does not publish the fee on a static page; fee is shown at payment step. Third-party sources consistently report ~USD 63 but this could not be verified on the official portal, so amount is left null.

fees.name: Business visa, 30 days single entry (Embassy of Libya, Washington DC)
fees.notes: Requires sponsorship by a company in Libya; pre-approval from Tripoli mandatory. Paid by money order to the Embassy of Libya.

fees.name: Business visa, 90 days multiple entry (Embassy of Libya, Washington DC)
Business visa, 180 days multiple entry (Embassy of Libya, Washington DC)
Embassy tourist visa
fees.notes: Embassy of Libya in Washington DC states it currently does NOT issue tourist visas; tourists are directed to the e-visa route (typically via a Libyan tour operator invitation). No embassy tourist-visa fee is therefore published.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No current official fee schedule for a Libyan transit visa could be verified on government/embassy sources; amount left null.

variations.note: US citizens: special 1-year multiple-entry visa fee of USD 160 per Embassy of Libya, Washington DC (reciprocity-based).

LBY.free_visa_notes: Libya is not visa-free for most nationalities; nationals of a small number of Arab countries (e.g. Tunisia, Jordan, Algeria) may enter visa-free. No general visa-on-arrival regime; Libya is not a Schengen member.

fees.name: Non-Immigrant Visa - Single Entry
fees.validity: Single entry, valid within a 3 month period
fees.notes: Issued by the Royal Saint Lucia Police Force Immigration/Visa Office. Fee published in EC dollars (XCD); amount_usd is an approximate conversion at the fixed XCD/USD peg (~2.70 XCD = 1 USD).

fees.name: Non-Immigrant Visa - Multiple Entry
fees.validity: Multiple entries over a one year period
fees.notes: Issued by the Royal Saint Lucia Police Force Immigration/Visa Office. Fee published in EC dollars (XCD); amount_usd is an approximate conversion at the fixed XCD/USD peg (~2.70 XCD = 1 USD).

LCA.free_visa_notes: Saint Lucia grants visa-free entry for tourism to the large majority of nationalities (including EU, UK, USA, Canada, most Commonwealth and Caribbean states), typically permitting stays of up to 6 weeks (per UK FCDO advice) or up to 90 days depending on nationality, granted on arrival at no charge. A visa (fee EC$125 single-entry / EC$190 multiple-entry) is only required for nationals of a specific list of countries not covered by visa-exempt status; no official, publicly itemised nationality-by-nationality fee schedule (i.e. no reciprocity fee schedule distinct from the flat EC$125/EC$190 rates) was found on official sources, and no e-visa, visa-on-arrival fee, eTA, or outsourced (VFS/TLScontact/BLS) visa processing centre exists for Saint Lucia as of this record's date.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C) - issued by Switzerland on behalf of Liechtenstein
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Liechtenstein has no visa-issuing authorities of its own; Switzerland represents Liechtenstein for Schengen visa issuance. Common Schengen fee of EUR 90 confirmed (increased from EUR 80 on 11 June 2024). Expedited processing may add up to a 50% surcharge.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C) for business purposes
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Same uniform Schengen type C fee; purpose of travel does not change the fee.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (type A) - Schengen
fees.notes: Uniform Schengen fee applies to type A visas. Liechtenstein has no international airport; transit visas are relevant only for Swiss airports en route.

fees.name: ETIAS travel authorisation (visa-exempt nationalities)
fees.notes: ETIAS fee set at EUR 20 (raised from EUR 7 in 2025). Not yet in operation as of mid-2026; will apply to visa-exempt travellers to Schengen countries including Liechtenstein.

vfs.note: Switzerland (acting for Liechtenstein) outsources Schengen visa intake to VFS Global in many countries. Published service fee in India is approx INR 2,690 per application (raised in 2025); amounts vary by country/centre. Verify on the local VFS Switzerland page.

LIE.free_visa_notes: Liechtenstein is a Schengen member with no visa regime of its own: EU/EEA/Swiss citizens and all Schengen visa-exempt nationalities (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN, JPN) enter free of visa charges. There is no e-visa, no visa on arrival, and no nationality-based reciprocity fee schedule; the uniform Schengen fee (EUR 90 adult / EUR 45 child 6-12 / free under 6) applies, with reduced or waived fees only per EU-wide visa facilitation rules.

fees.name: ETA / Tourist Visa (free-of-charge nationalities)
fees.notes: Fees paid prior to 25.05.2026 are non-refundable. Full designated list should be checked on eta.gov.lk before travel as it can change.

fees.name: ETA Tourist Visa - online application (non-exempt, non-SAARC nationalities)
fees.notes: On-arrival application fee is higher (USD 60) per official fee chart.

fees.name: ETA Tourist Visa - on-arrival application (non-SAARC)
fees.notes: On-arrival option costs more than pre-arrival online application; not guaranteed to be available to all travellers.

fees.name: ETA Business Visa (non-SAARC)
fees.validity: 30 days (single entry); extended options up to 90 days available
fees.notes: Longer-validity/multiple-entry business ETAs cost the base fee plus additional per-country charges per the official fee chart.

fees.name: Transit Visa
fees.notes: Free of charge for both SAARC and non-SAARC nationalities per official fee chart.

variations.note: India and Pakistan are on the 40-country free-tourist-ETA list effective 25 May 2026 (30-day validity); confirm current status on eta.gov.lk as free-visa lists have changed multiple times historically.
If applying under the standard SAARC fee schedule (applicable when not covered by a free-visa promotion): SAARC tourist visa online fee is USD 20 (USD 25 on arrival), business visa USD 30.
USA, UK, China, Russia and Canada are on the 40-country free-tourist-ETA list effective 25 May 2026 (30-day validity).

Nigeria and Philippines are not on the published free-visa list; standard non-SAARC tourist ETA fee of USD 50 (online) applies. Could not verify any country-specific surcharge for these nationalities on official sources.

LKA.free_visa_notes: Effective 25 May 2026, Sri Lanka grants a free 30-day tourist ETA to nationals of 40 designated countries (incl. USA, UK, Canada, China, India, Russia, Pakistan, EU and Gulf states) plus Singapore, Seychelles (30 days) and Maldives (90 days); children under 12 also receive free 30-day tourist ETAs regardless of nationality. All other nationalities pay the standard paid ETA/visa fees listed above. In 2024 Sri Lanka briefly routed some free-visa-eligible nationalities (incl. India, China, Russia) through a paid VFS Global processing arrangement (~USD 25.77 fee added to visa cost), which drew public controversy; official sources now indicate the government reverted to direct online ETA issuance, so VFS Global involvement in the Sri Lanka ETA process is NOT confirmed as currently active and is recorded here as used:false pending clearer official confirmation.

fees.name: Visitor visa - single entry
fees.validity: Single entry; approval letter issued as a 72-hour visa-on-arrival letter, visa endorsed at Maseru Port of Entry or Moshoeshoe I International Airport
fees.notes: M1000 (Maloti, pegged 1:1 to ZAR). Applications processed manually by Ministry of Home Affairs in Maseru via visa-applications.immigration@gov.ls; embassies do not issue visas. Diplomatic/official/UN passport and laissez-passer holders exempt from fees. amount_usd approximate.

fees.name: Visitor visa - multiple entry
fees.notes: M2000 (Maloti). Same email-based process via Ministry of Home Affairs. amount_usd approximate.

fees.name: e-Visa (SUSPENDED)
fees.notes: Ministry of Home Affairs states the eVisa application system (evisalesotho.com) is suspended; applicants must email VISA-Applications.Immigration@gov.ls. Historical e-visa fees were USD 150 single-entry / USD 250 multiple-entry per the 2017 government launch announcement (secondary confirmation via Fragomen), but no current official fee schedule is published, so amount is null.

vfs.note: VFS Global operates a Lesotho corridor from South Africa (visa.vfsglobal.com/zaf/en/lso). The published fixed VFS service fee at the Lesotho facilitation centres in South Africa is R1550 per applicant plus R185 biometric clearance fee (18+); this published figure relates to the Lesotho Exemption Permit programme and the visitor-visa service fee page was not directly retrievable (HTTP 403), so treat as indicative. Fees non-refundable.

LSO.free_visa_notes: Lesotho is visa-free for many nationalities (e.g. USA and GBR passport holders do not need a visa for short visits; SADC nationals visa-free). Fees above apply only to visa-required nationalities. No published reciprocity fee schedule by nationality was found; the flat M1000/M2000 fees apply to all standard passports, with fee exemptions for diplomatic/official/UN passports.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C)
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Lithuania is a Schengen member; the harmonised EU Visa Code fee of EUR 90 applies (raised from EUR 80 on 11 June 2024). Children 6-12 pay EUR 45 per the Lithuanian MFA (keliauk.urm.lt); children under 6, pupils/students on study trips, researchers, and representatives of non-profit organisations aged 25 or under are exempt. The MFA fee page is Cloudflare-protected; amounts were confirmed via its indexed content and the EU Commission visa-policy page.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) for business
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Business travel uses the same Schengen C visa; there is no separate business visa category or fee.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.notes: Airport transit visas are charged at the standard Schengen visa fee under the EU Visa Code.

fees.name: E-visa / ETIAS
fees.notes: Lithuania has no standalone tourist e-visa; Schengen visa applications are lodged via MIGRIS online but issued as sticker visas at consulates/VFS. Visa-exempt nationals will need the EU-wide ETIAS travel authorisation (EUR 20, valid 3 years) once ETIAS becomes operational; it is not Lithuania-specific and not yet in force as of this record.

variations.note: EU-Belarus visa facilitation agreement (in force since July 2020): reduced EUR 35 Schengen visa fee for all Belarusian citizens, confirmed on keliauk.urm.lt and EEAS.
Reduced EUR 35 fee under EU visa facilitation agreements with Armenia and Azerbaijan (EU-wide, applies to Lithuania as a Schengen member).
EU-Russia visa facilitation agreement fully suspended since September 2022 - Russian citizens pay the full EUR 90 fee; note Lithuania also restricts entry of Russian citizens for tourism.
No facilitation agreement - standard EUR 90 Schengen fee (USA, GBR, CAN nationals are visa-exempt for short stays and normally pay nothing).

vfs.note: Lithuania outsources visa intake to VFS Global in many countries (incl. India - New Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore - Nepal, China, etc.). Published service charge varies by centre; e.g. NPR 5,654 incl. VAT in Nepal per the official VFS one-pager (roughly EUR 20-40 equivalent typical range). Indian-centre INR amount not verifiable on an accessible official page at record time (VFS India pages are bot-protected); third-party sources cite ~INR 1,788 incl. GST - treat as unverified.

LTU.free_visa_notes: No visa-on-arrival or Lithuania-specific eTA exists. Nationals of the EU/EEA and the ~60 Schengen visa-waiver countries (incl. USA, GBR, CAN, JPN, AUS) enter visa-free for 90/180 days. Visa fee waived for children under 6, school pupils/students on organised study trips, researchers, and non-profit event participants aged 25 or under. National (D) visa for long stays costs EUR 140 (out of scope for short-term travel).

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C) - adult
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Standard EU-wide Schengen visa fee. Children 6-11: EUR 45; under 6 free. Fee waived for students on educational trips, researchers (EU Directive 2016/801), family members of EU/EEA/Swiss citizens, and non-profit event participants aged 25 and under. Covers tourism, family visits and business travel (same type C visa).

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C) - business purpose
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Business travel uses the same Schengen type C visa and fee as tourism; there is no separate business visa category or fee.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (type A)
fees.notes: Same EUR 90 fee as the type C visa under the EU Visa Code.

fees.name: e-Visa
fees.notes: Luxembourg does not issue e-visas; Schengen visas are sticker visas applied for at embassies/consulates or outsourced centres.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: No visa-on-arrival regime; visas must be obtained in advance.

fees.name: ETIAS travel authorisation (EU-wide, for visa-exempt travellers)
fees.notes: ETIAS is an EU-wide system, not a Luxembourg-specific fee; not yet in force at time of writing, so amount left null rather than assumed.

variations.note: Reduced EUR 35 fee under EU visa facilitation agreements (per Luxembourg Embassy New Delhi fee schedule).
EUR 35 for non-biometric passport holders under visa facilitation agreements; biometric passport holders of most of these countries are visa-exempt.

Standard EUR 90 Schengen fee applies (no reciprocity reduction). USA, GBR and CAN nationals are visa-exempt for short stays. EU-Russia visa facilitation is suspended, so Russian nationals pay the full EUR 90.

vfs.note: Published VFS Global service charge for Luxembourg visa applications in India is INR 2281 per application (short- and long-term). Service fees vary by country/centre; Luxembourg outsources to VFS Global in several source countries.

LUX.free_visa_notes: Visa-exempt nationalities (EU/EEA/CH, USA, UK, Canada, Japan and other Schengen Annex II countries) pay no visa fee for short stays. Fee waivers apply to children under 6, students on school trips, researchers, family members of EU citizens, and youth non-profit event participants.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C)
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Latvia is a Schengen member; the harmonised Schengen visa code fee of EUR 90 applies (raised from EUR 80 in June 2024). Fee exemptions for children under 6, pupils/students on study trips, researchers, and non-profit representatives aged 25 or under.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) for business
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Business travel uses the same Schengen C visa and fee; there is no separate business visa category or fee.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.notes: Airport transit visas are charged at the standard Schengen visa fee under the EU Visa Code.

variations.note: EU-Ukraine visa facilitation agreement: EUR 35 standard (10-day) processing, EUR 70 express (3-day). Most Ukrainian biometric-passport holders are visa-exempt for short stays.
Reduced EUR 35 fee under EU visa facilitation agreements, per Latvian MFA fee page.

vfs.note: Published VFS service charge at Latvian Visa Application Centres in India is INR 2999 incl. GST (student applicants INR 2434); service fees vary by country and centre - typically roughly EUR 20-40 equivalent. Latvia also uses VFS Global centres in many countries without a Latvian embassy.

LVA.free_visa_notes: No fee for EU/EEA/Swiss family members, children under 6, school pupils and students on organised study trips, researchers, and non-profit event participants aged 25 or under. Nationals of ~60 visa-exempt countries (USA, GBR, CAN, JPN, etc.) need no visa for short stays. Latvia offers no e-visa, no visa on arrival, and no national eTA; the EU-wide ETIAS travel authorisation (EUR 20) for visa-exempt travellers is expected to start in late 2026 but was not yet operational at the time of writing.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (Authorization to Enter and Stay) - individual, single entry
fees.notes: Issued at border checkpoints by the Public Security Police Force (CPSP) Immigration Department.

fees.name: Visa on arrival - individual, multiple entry
Visa on arrival - family passport
fees.notes: MOP 600 for multiple entry.

fees.name: Visa on arrival - child under 12 (individual passport)
fees.notes: MOP 150 for multiple entry.

fees.name: Visa on arrival - group (10+ persons, collective travel document)
fees.notes: MOP 150 for multiple entry.

fees.name: Advance Macau visa via Chinese embassy/consulate
fees.notes: Fee is set by the individual Chinese diplomatic mission and varies by mission and nationality; no single official published amount, so left null.

variations.note: Not eligible for visa on arrival; must obtain a Macau visa in advance through a Chinese embassy/consulate. Fee varies by mission.

MAC.free_visa_notes: Nationals of 88 countries/territories (incl. USA, GBR, CAN, AUS, JPN, SGP, EU states) are visa-exempt for stays of 14-180 days depending on nationality; Hong Kong and mainland Chinese residents use separate permit schemes. Visa-exempt entry has no fee.

fees.name: Ordinary tourist visa (single entry, up to 90 days)
fees.notes: Official Moroccan consular portal (consulat.ma) publishes the fee schedule but the page returned a WAF/'Request Rejected' block on direct fetch, so the amount could not be confirmed by direct read of the primary source. Figure of 220 MAD single-entry / 330 MAD multiple-entry is corroborated by several secondary sources referencing the official consular tariff; treat as indicative pending direct verification.

fees.name: Ordinary visa, multiple entries (up to 90 days per stay)
fees.validity: multiple entries, up to 90 days per stay
fees.notes: Same sourcing caveat as single-entry tourist visa fee above - could not directly verify on consulat.ma due to site blocking automated access.

fees.name: Business visa
fees.notes: Not independently verified on the official consular site; corroborated by secondary sources citing the same consular tariff table. Express processing may carry an additional (unpublished) fee.

fees.name: Transit visa (max 72 hours)
fees.notes: Not independently verified on the official consular site; corroborated by secondary sources citing the same consular tariff table.

fees.name: Morocco eVisa (Acces Maroc / acces-maroc.ma)
fees.notes: acces-maroc.ma is the official Kingdom of Morocco eVisa portal (launched 10 July 2022, announced via diplomatie.ma). The exact government eVisa fee could not be confirmed on the official portal itself (page is a dynamic eligibility-checker app with no visible pricing in fetched content). Secondary sources mention a non-refundable service fee 'of approximately 258 MAD per file' but this was not confirmed on an official page, so amount is left null rather than guessed. Do not trust third-party reseller sites (e.g. moroccan-visa.com quoting $90+$69) as these are not official and appear inflated with markup.

vfs.note: VFS Global operates the Morocco visa application centre for Indian applicants. Per VFS's own India-Morocco portal, service fee is INR 590 per applicant plus a mandatory tourism promotional charge of INR 140 per applicant (both inclusive of taxes), in addition to the consular visa fee. Direct WebFetch of the official VFS page (visa.vfsglobal.com) returned HTTP 403 during this research session, so this figure is from search-engine summarization of that official VFS page rather than a direct read; treat as indicative and re-verify before quoting to users.

MAR.free_visa_notes: Morocco is not a Schengen member (common Schengen fee does not apply). Citizens of a large number of countries (most EU/EEA states, UK, USA, Canada, and many others) do not need a visa for short tourist stays (typically up to 90 days) and pay no visa fee at all. This record covers fees applicable only to nationalities that DO require a visa; the specific reciprocity-based fee table by nationality (e.g. differing rates for IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, RUS, CAN applicants who are not already visa-exempt) could not be located on an official source during this research pass, so no reciprocity_variations entries are recorded - most of the listed key nationalities (USA, GBR, CAN and many EU citizens) are in fact visa-exempt for tourism, while others (e.g. IND, CHN, NGA, PAK, BGD) generally require a visa/eVisa at the standard consular tariff above.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (issued by French authorities, valid for Monaco)
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Monaco issues no visas of its own. It is not a Schengen member but applies Schengen rules via France: a Schengen visa valid for France also authorises entry to and stay in Monaco. Applications go through French consulates/France-Visas. EU Visa Code standard fee EUR 90 (adults), EUR 45 (children 6-12), free under 6. Visa-facilitation-agreement nationalities pay a reduced EUR 35 where agreements apply.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (business purpose, via France)
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Same uniform Schengen fee; business and tourism use the same short-stay visa type C.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (type A, via France)
fees.notes: Uniform EU Visa Code fee applies to airport transit visas.

variations.note: EU Visa Code reduced rate for children aged 6-12; children under 6 free.

vfs.operator: VFS Global / TLScontact (varies by country, contracted by France)
vfs.note: France outsources visa intake in most countries to VFS Global or TLScontact; the published service fee is roughly EUR 22 plus taxes and varies by centre and local currency. Since Monaco entry uses French Schengen visas, this applies to Monaco-bound applicants.

MCO.free_visa_notes: Monaco has no visa regime or fees of its own. EEA nationals and all Schengen visa-exempt nationalities (e.g. USA, GBR, CAN and other Annex II countries) enter Monaco free with a valid passport/ID. Nationalities requiring a visa must obtain a French/Schengen short-stay visa (EUR 90) which is also valid for Monaco. There is no Monaco e-visa, visa on arrival, or eTA; ETIAS (when applicable to Schengen-exempt travellers) is an EU system, EUR 20.

fees.name: Short-stay visa Type C (tourism C/T, visit C/V, sticker visa via embassy)
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Official MFA/eVisa portal fee schedule: Type C = 60 EUR. Individual embassies publish the fee in local currency and amounts vary by mission (e.g. Embassy in Washington charges USD 45; Embassy in India via VFS charges EUR 70 / INR 8,095 for C/T). Free for children under 18, diplomatic passport holders, persons originating from Moldova, and other exempt categories.

fees.name: e-Visa (Type B transit or Type C short stay via evisa.gov.md)
fees.validity: Type C: up to 90 days / 180; Type B: transit
fees.notes: Same consular fee as the regular visa: 40 EUR for Type B, 60 EUR for Type C, paid by bank card on approval via evisa.gov.md. No separate e-visa surcharge published.

fees.name: Transit visa Type B
fees.validity: transit, up to 5 days per transit
fees.notes: Airport transit visa (Type A) is 20 EUR. India VFS schedule lists Type B at EUR 60 / INR 6,938 (mission-specific variation).

fees.name: Short-stay business visa (Type C/A)
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Business (C/A) falls under the Type C short-stay fee of 60 EUR. Long-stay Type D visas (work, study, family) are 80 EUR.

variations.note: Embassy of Moldova in New Delhi (via VFS Global) publishes the C/T tourist visa consular fee as EUR 70 / INR 8,095; Type B transit EUR 60 / INR 6,938. Fees vary by diplomatic mission rather than strictly by nationality.
Citizens of the USA, UK, Canada, Russia, China (and EU/EEA and many others) are visa-exempt for stays up to 90 days in 180 - no visa fee applies.

vfs.note: VFS Global operates Moldova visa submission in India (New Delhi centre plus walk-in/logistics points in Jalandhar, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Kochi since 2024). Published VFS Service Fee for India: INR 1,350 per application; logistics/courier charges extra and vary by centre. No exemption from the VFS service charge.

MDA.free_visa_notes: Moldova is not a Schengen member; its national fee schedule applies. Many nationalities (EU/EEA, USA, UK, Canada, Japan, Russia, China ordinary-passport agreements vary - check exemption list) can enter visa-free for up to 90 days in 180. Visas are free for children under 18, diplomatic passport holders, officials of international organisations Moldova has joined, and persons originating from the Republic of Moldova. No visa-on-arrival or eTA scheme exists.

fees.name: Tourist eVisa - up to 15 days
fees.notes: Fee increased from EUR 10 to EUR 30 effective 16 Feb 2026. Official portal (evisamada-mg.com) loads the fee table dynamically; amounts corroborated via reporting citing the portal.

fees.name: Tourist visa on arrival
fees.notes: Official portal states 'The prices of the online visa are the same as those paid on arrival' - VOA available at eVisa counters at ports of entry; pay per stay tier (EUR 30/35/40/50).

fees.name: Embassy-issued non-immigrant (tourist) visa
fees.notes: Madagascar Embassy in London publishes fees only via downloadable PDFs; amount not verifiable online. In practice most travellers use eVisa or visa on arrival.

fees.name: Business visa (embassy, >90 days = immigrant/long-stay category)
fees.notes: eVisa system currently supports tourist visas only. Business/long-stay visas are handled by embassies; fee schedule not published online, so amount left null rather than estimated.

MDG.free_visa_notes: Visa fees apply to all nationalities; only diplomats and employees of certain organizations are exempt per the official eVisa portal. No nationality-based reciprocity fee schedule is published - all nationalities pay the same tiered fees.

fees.name: Tourist visa on arrival (30 days)
fees.notes: Free of charge for all nationalities; granted on arrival, no pre-approval required. Traveller Declaration (IMUGA) must be submitted online within 96 hours before travel and is also free of charge.

fees.name: Tourist visa extension (up to 90 days total)
fees.validity: up to 60 additional days (90 days total)
fees.notes: First 30 days free on arrival; extension of up to 60 further days costs MVR 750, applied for in Male' with a local sponsor. Fee per Maldives Immigration / Maldives Permanent Mission (Geneva).

fees.name: Business visa (multiple entry, 30-90 days)
fees.validity: 30-90 days per grant, max 180 days per calendar year
fees.notes: Applied via Ministry of Economic Development & Trade Business Portal (business.egov.mv). MVR 750 application fee widely published for the Business Visa Regulation (2021); amount not shown on the immigration page itself, so verify on the Business Portal at application time.

fees.name: E-visa
fees.notes: Maldives does not operate a tourist e-visa; entry is via free visa on arrival plus the mandatory free IMUGA Traveller Declaration.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No separate paid transit visa; transiting passengers who enter are covered by the free visa on arrival regime.

variations.note: Under the India-Maldives bilateral agreement, Indian nationals visiting for tourism may be granted up to 90 days free on arrival (vs the standard 30 days). Still free of charge.

MDV.free_visa_notes: Maldives grants a free 30-day tourist visa on arrival to all nationalities (90 days for Indian nationals under a bilateral agreement). No pre-arrival visa or fee for tourists; only the free IMUGA Traveller Declaration is required. Paid items are the optional MVR 750 in-country extension and the MVR 750 business visa.

fees.name: Visitor visa without permission to engage in remunerated activities (consular sticker visa)
fees.validity: typically up to 180 days per stay; visa validity commonly 180 days single entry (up to 10 years multiple-entry in some cases)
fees.notes: Fee is for reception, review and, if applicable, authorization of the visa. Covers tourism, transit and unpaid business visits (same visa type). Confirmed on SRE/embassy consular tariff pages dated 2026.

fees.name: Visitor visa with permission to engage in remunerated activities
fees.notes: USD 321 visa issuance fee plus the USD 56 reception/review fee (total USD 377). Ordinary unpaid business visits use the standard USD 56 visitor visa instead.

fees.name: Electronic Travel Authorization (SAE - Sistema de Autorizacion Electronica)
fees.validity: 30 days from issue, single entry, air travel only (participating airlines)
fees.notes: Issued free of charge via the INM SAE portal (no payment step in the application). Not valid for land or sea entry; FMM still completed on arrival.

fees.name: Multiple Migratory Form (FMM) / visitor fee (DNR - Derecho de No Residente)
fees.validity: up to 180 days, single entry (days granted at officer's discretion)
fees.notes: Not a visa-on-arrival; Mexico has no VOA. The FMM/DNR is the non-resident entry fee under the Ley Federal de Derechos, updated annually. Third-party sources report approx MXN 983 (~USD 54) for 2026, but the INM portal does not publish the amount on a fetchable page, so amount left null. Free for land stays under 7 days; included in airline ticket for air arrivals.

MEX.free_visa_notes: Many nationalities (USA, CAN, GBR, EU, JPN, etc.) and holders of valid US/UK/Canada/Japan/Schengen visas or permanent residence enter visa-free; they pay no visa fee, only the FMM/DNR non-resident fee where applicable. The SAE electronic authorization is free for eligible nationalities arriving by air. Consular visa fees are a flat worldwide tariff with no reciprocity-based variation.

fees.name: Visitor Visa (V-1)
fees.validity: Typically up to 90 days stay; issued in advance via RMI Embassy / Division of Immigration
fees.notes: Non-refundable application processing fee, per RMI Embassy Washington DC. Advance application required for nationals not on the exemption/VOA schedule.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival (VOA) - fee waived
fees.notes: RMI Division of Immigration schedule (as of March 2024) lists VOA fee as 'Waived'. Requires 6+ months passport validity and onward/return ticket. No extension, change of status, employment, study or research permitted.

fees.name: Business Visa (B-1)
fees.notes: Non-refundable application processing fee.

variations.note: Visa exempt under Compact of Free Association; no period restrictions, fee waived (also FSM and Palau).
UK listed with EU member countries on RMI exemption schedule: visa waiver 90 days in any 180, fee waived (ordinary passports).
On the VOA schedule: 90-day visa on arrival, fee waived.
Not on the exemption/VOA schedule; must apply in advance for Visitor Visa (V-1) with USD 100 processing fee.

MHL.free_visa_notes: Most visitors enter the Marshall Islands free of charge: US/FSM/Palau citizens are fully exempt (Compact of Free Association), EU + UK, Taiwan and Guatemala get a 90-day fee-waived visa waiver, and nationals of ~80 further countries get a fee-waived 90-day visa on arrival. Only nationalities outside these schedules pay the USD 100 V-1 visitor visa fee. A USD 20 departure fee applies to all travellers leaving RMI (embassy-published).

fees.name: Short-stay visa (type C, up to 90 days) - covers tourism and business visits
fees.notes: Fee per Law on Administrative Fees, Tariff No. 135. North Macedonia is not a Schengen member but follows the Schengen-style EUR 60 short-stay fee. Holders of valid multiple-entry Schengen (C) visas may enter without a Macedonian visa for short stays.

fees.name: Transit visa (type C, up to 5 days)
fees.notes: Transit is issued as a C visa at the same EUR 60 fee.

fees.name: Business visit (issued as short-stay type C visa)
fees.notes: No separate business visa category; business visits use the C visa. Long-stay D visa (work/study/family) is EUR 70 but is out of scope as a residence-track visa.

MKD.free_visa_notes: No e-visa, eTA, or visa-on-arrival regime. Many nationalities (EU, USA, GBR, CAN, and others) enter visa-free; holders of valid multiple-entry Schengen C visas may also enter visa-free for short stays. Reduced fee of EUR 35 applies to children aged 6-12; no published nationality-based reciprocity fee schedule.

fees.name: Tourist/regular visa - 3 months single entry
fees.notes: Embassy of Mali in the USA fee schedule. Fee applies to all regular visa types (tourist/business) at this mission; a December fee-schedule update was published as a PDF (Avis - Changement aux Frais Administratifs du Visa Regulier).

fees.name: Tourist/regular visa - 1 year multiple entry
fees.notes: Rush processing adds USD 50 to any fee.

fees.name: Business visa (regular visa, same schedule as tourist)
fees.validity: 3 months single entry (longer/multiple-entry options per tourist schedule)
fees.notes: Embassy applies one regular-visa fee schedule regardless of purpose (tourist/business); no separate business rate published.

fees.name: Online visa application via official MDC portal
fees.notes: Mali's official portal (diplomatiemdc.gouv.ml) handles online applications and payment, but does not publish a fee table publicly; the fee charged is the embassy/consulate fee for the applicant's jurisdiction. Amount not verifiable on the portal, so left null.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (limited nationalities, e.g. Rwanda, Kenya)
fees.notes: Mali does not offer visa on arrival to most nationalities; only limited African nationalities reported eligible. No official published VOA fee found - amount left null rather than estimated.

variations.note: Reciprocal flat fee of USD 185 for US citizens for all visa types regardless of length of stay (visas up to 5 years multiple entry). NOTE: as of 1 January 2026 Mali suspended visa issuance to US citizens; Mali also announced retaliatory visa bond fees on US travellers in Oct 2025. Source: https://maliembassy.us/visas/

MLI.free_visa_notes: Visa-free entry for ECOWAS nationals plus Algeria, Cameroon, Andorra, Monaco, Chad, Gambia, Morocco, Mauritania and Tunisia (per Embassy of Mali in the USA). Diplomatic/official visas are issued free.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - adult
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Malta is a Schengen member; the common Schengen visa fee (EUR 90 since June 2024 per EU Visa Code) applies. Children 6-12 pay EUR 45; under 6 free. Fee non-refundable. Identita (Central Visa Unit) is the issuing authority; exact fee published on per-category checklists at identita.gov.mt.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa - child 6-12
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Children under 6 are exempt from the visa fee (confirmed on identita.gov.mt FAQ: minors under 6 pay no fee).

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Business/Conference)
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Business travel uses the same Schengen C visa and fee; separate document checklist published by Identita/VFS.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.notes: Same standard Schengen Visa Code fee applies to airport transit visas.

fees.name: E-visa
fees.notes: Malta does not operate an e-visa; applications are paper-based via the Central Visa Unit, Maltese/partner Schengen missions, or VFS Global centres.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: No visa on arrival; Schengen visas must be obtained in advance except rare humanitarian border cases.

fees.name: ETIAS travel authorisation (upcoming, EU-wide)
fees.notes: ETIAS (planned fee EUR 20) is not yet in operation as of July 2026; no travel-authorisation fee currently applies to visa-exempt visitors to Malta. Amount left null until launch is confirmed.

variations.note: Reduced EUR 35 fee under EU visa facilitation agreements (applies EU-wide, including Malta). Verify per nationality; the EU-Russia and EU-Belarus facilitation agreements are suspended, so RUS/BLR applicants pay the full EUR 90.
EU-Russia visa facilitation agreement suspended since 2022; Russian nationals pay the standard EUR 90 fee.
Standard Schengen fee; no reciprocity discount. USA/GBR/CAN passport holders are visa-exempt for short stays and pay no fee.

vfs.service_fee: INR 2935 (India); EUR 28 / CNY 224-235 (China); varies by centre
vfs.note: Malta outsources Schengen visa intake to VFS Global in 20+ countries (incl. India, UK, China, UAE, Egypt, Morocco, Algeria, Ghana, Libya, Sri Lanka). Published service charge: INR 2935 per application in India (courier INR ~808, SMS INR ~149, premium lounge INR ~3988 optional); EUR 28 (224 CNY) per individual application in China. For Malta national D-visa 'Extended service' the VFS admin fee is approx EUR 150 per application (identita.gov.mt FAQ); VAC fees for D-visas capped at EUR 150.

MLT.free_visa_notes: EU/EEA/Swiss citizens and ~60 visa-exempt nationalities (incl. USA, GBR, CAN, AUS, JPN) need no visa and pay no fee for stays up to 90/180 days. Children under 6 exempt from the visa fee for all nationalities.

fees.name: Tourist e-Visa (evisa.moip.gov.mm)
fees.validity: Approval letter valid 90 days from issue; 28-day stay, single entry
fees.notes: Official Ministry of Immigration and Population portal; fee confirmed via Consulate-General of Myanmar, Los Angeles e-visa page (myanmarcgla.org). Processing up to 3 working days; fee non-refundable. Payable by Visa/Mastercard/Amex/JCB/Alipay.

fees.name: Tourist e-Visa Express (24-hour processing)
fees.validity: Approval letter valid 90 days; 28-day stay, single entry
fees.notes: Express service processed within up to 24 hours, available year-round, per Consulate-General of Myanmar Los Angeles.

fees.name: Business e-Visa (evisa.moip.gov.mm)
fees.validity: Approval letter valid 90 days; 70-day stay, single entry
fees.notes: Requires company invitation/registration documents. Fee confirmed via Consulate-General of Myanmar Los Angeles e-visa page.

fees.name: Tourist visa on arrival
fees.notes: Available at Yangon, Mandalay and Nay Pyi Taw international airports only. Per Myanmar Consulate-General Hong Kong.

fees.name: Business visa on arrival
fees.notes: Requires company registration and invitation documents. Yangon, Mandalay, Nay Pyi Taw airports.

fees.name: Transit visa on arrival
fees.notes: Per Myanmar Consulate-General Hong Kong visa-on-arrival schedule. Workshop/seminar/meeting/research VOA is USD 40 (28 days) and crew VOA USD 40 (28 days).

fees.name: Tourist visa (embassy/consulate sticker visa)
fees.validity: 3 months from issue; 28-day stay, single entry, not extendable
fees.notes: USD 40 at the LA Consulate-General, payable by cashier's check/money order. Sticker-visa fees differ by embassy/consulate; the e-visa (USD 50) is the standard route for most travellers.

MMR.free_visa_notes: Myanmar grants visa-free entry to nationals of several ASEAN countries (e.g. Thailand, Singapore, Vietnam, Philippines, Cambodia, Laos, Brunei, Indonesia) for short stays; all other nationalities require a visa. No published nationality-based fee reciprocity schedule found — e-visa fees are flat by visa type.

fees.name: Short-stay visa C (tourism/visit, embassy/VAC sticker visa)
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Consular fee published on official VFS Global Montenegro one-pagers (Contentful CDA, space xxg4p8gt3sg6): Short Term Visa EUR 35; minor children under 14 pay EUR 17.50. Montenegro is NOT a Schengen member, so the Schengen fee does not apply. Fee not itemised on gov.me (only 'proof of payment of consular fee' is required).

fees.name: Short-stay visa C (business)
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Same C-category consular fee schedule as tourism per VFS Montenegro one-pager fee tables.

fees.name: Transit visa (B category)
fees.notes: VFS Montenegro one-pager lists an identical fee table (Short Term EUR 35 / Long Term EUR 35 / minors under 14 EUR 17.50) under the B Category - Transit Visa section.

fees.name: e-Visa
