fees.notes: Montenegro does not operate an e-visa or eTA programme; applications are lodged at embassies/consulates or VFS visa application centres. Holders of valid Schengen, US, UK or Irish visas/residence permits may enter visa-free for up to 30 days per government policy.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: No visa-on-arrival regime; visas must be obtained in advance.

vfs.note: Published VFS Montenegro Visa Application Centre service charge varies by centre: EUR 30 online-payment (Uzbekistan), EUR 31-32 (Kazakhstan centres), EUR 35 incl. tax (other centres). Montenegro routes applications via VFS Global in 12+ source countries (RUS, UZB, KAZ, ARE, ARM, AZE, BHR, KGZ-region, NPL, PHL, QAT, SAU, TUR).

MNE.free_visa_notes: Citizens of ~100 countries (EU, USA, GBR, CAN, RUS, and many others) enter Montenegro visa-free for up to 30 or 90 days. Additionally, foreigners holding a valid Schengen visa, US/UK/Irish visa, or residence permit of those areas may enter without a Montenegrin visa for up to 30 days. No fee schedule differences by nationality were found for those who do need a visa (flat EUR 35 consular fee on all inspected VFS corridors).

fees.name: Tourist visa (K2), single entry - embassy sticker visa
fees.validity: Valid for entry within 90 days of issue; stay per visa (typically 30 days)
fees.notes: Double entry USD 65; fees payable in USD by money order/cashier's check at the US embassy. Other missions publish local-currency schedules that differ by reciprocity.

fees.name: Multiple-entry visa, up to 6 months
fees.notes: Multiple entry 6-12 months: USD 205.

fees.name: E-visa - Tourist (K2), single entry, 30-day stay
fees.validity: Valid 150 days from issue; 30-day stay; processed within 72 hours
fees.notes: Fee is paid online but the official portal only displays the amount at the payment step of an application; no public fee schedule page. Third-party sources cite ~USD 50-53 but this is unverified on an official source, so amount is left null. E-visa also issued for cultural/sports events (K4) and transit (K6).

fees.name: Transit visa (K6), single transit - embassy issued
fees.notes: Double transit USD 50; multiple transit USD 75. Also available as e-visa via evisa.mn.

fees.name: Business visa (B category), single entry
fees.notes: Same standard fee tier as tourist: single 50 / double 65 / multiple 6mo 105 / multiple 12mo 205 USD.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (border-port visa, Chinggis Khaan Intl Airport and select land ports)
fees.notes: No official published fee found; third-party reports range ~USD 32-70 (payable in USD or MNT cash). Amount left null pending official confirmation.

variations.note: Per the official VFS Mongolia visa centre (Seoul) fee table (updated Oct 2019), Indian nationals pay no visa fee for tourist/business/transit visas (India-Mongolia reciprocal arrangement).
Chinese nationals applying at the VFS Mongolia centre in Seoul: KRW 116,000 regular (30-day tourist/business); transit KRW 31,000. Reciprocity-based; local-currency equivalents differ by mission.

UK nationals at the Seoul VFS centre: KRW 137,000 regular tourist/business, transit KRW 45,000 - higher reciprocity tier than the default (KRW 57,000). NB: most GBR passport holders are visa-exempt for short tourist stays.
Southeast/South Asian tier (Myanmar, Indonesia, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal, etc.) at Seoul VFS centre: KRW 35,000 tourist/business, KRW 23,000 transit.
USA/CAN nationals are visa-exempt for tourist stays (USA up to 90 days). RUS nationals are visa-exempt up to 30 days under bilateral agreement; no fee applies for those stays.

vfs.note: Mongolia outsources visa intake to VFS Global in at least South Korea (Seoul Mongolia Visa Application Centre). Service fee at the Seoul centre: KRW 5,000 regular, KRW 20,000 express, paid on top of the visa fee. Fees vary by centre.

MNG.free_visa_notes: Mongolia is not a Schengen member. Nationals of ~60+ countries (incl. USA up to 90 days, most of EU, UK, JPN, KOR, CAN, AUS under temporary/permanent exemptions, RUS 30 days) enter visa-free for short stays; for them no fee applies. Others use the e-visa (K2/K4/K6) or embassy visas.

fees.name: e-Visa single entry 30 days (evisa.gov.mz)
fees.notes: Fee set in Meticais, USD equivalent floats (~$95). Official portal evisa.gov.mz returned 403 to automated fetch; amount corroborated via secondary sources citing the portal after the Feb 2026 VFS-operated relaunch. 60-day: MZN 12,504 (~$190); 90-day: MZN 18,756 (~$290). VFS service fee added on top.

fees.name: e-Visa 60 days
fees.notes: Corroborated via secondary sources; verify on evisa.gov.mz before paying.

fees.name: e-Visa 90 days
fees.notes: Corroborated via secondary sources; verify on evisa.gov.mz before paying.

fees.name: Electronic Travel Authorisation (visa-exempt nationals, online)
fees.notes: Approximate published online eTA fee (~USD 48) per secondary sources; portal blocked automated fetch. Applied on evisa.gov.mz.

fees.name: Border registration / entry fee on arrival (visa-exempt travellers)
fees.notes: MZN 650 (~USD 10 / EUR 10) SENAMI administrative fee payable on arrival, widely reported from official SENAMI notices; failure to register/pay may result in refused entry.

fees.name: Embassy sticker visa, single entry 30 days (Embassy of Mozambique, Washington DC)
fees.notes: Normal processing (10 days) USD 220; expedited (3 days) USD 280. Multiple entry 90 days: USD 240 normal / USD 310 expedited. Non-refundable.

fees.name: Business visa via embassy (same fee schedule as entry visas)
fees.validity: 30 days single entry (90-day multiple entry USD 240)
fees.notes: Embassy fee schedule is by entry type (single/multiple), not purpose; business visa requires company letters.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Transit visa exists (required unless travelling to country of origin) but no distinct fee published on the embassy page; fee not verified.

vfs.note: Since Feb 2026 the official e-visa/eTA portal evisa.gov.mz is operated by VFS Global; a service fee is added to each application but the exact published amount could not be verified (portal blocks automated access). Fee increase to ~USD 190 for 60-day e-visa attributed to VFS operation.

fees.name: e-Visa (30 days, single entry) - fee paid in cash on arrival
fees.notes: Since 5 January 2025 all visa-required travellers must obtain an e-visa via the official ANRPTS portal (anrpts.gov.mr) before boarding; visas on arrival are no longer issued. No payment is taken online - the fee (EUR 55 or USD 60) is collected in exact cash (EUR or USD) at the border/airport on arrival; no change or receipts given (UK FCDO). EUR 55 amount confirmed on the official Nouakchott airport site.

fees.name: e-Visa (90 days)
fees.notes: ANRPTS portal offers 30-day, 90-day and 360-day options. 90-day fee widely reported by unofficial sources as EUR 95 / USD 100 (EUR 70 / USD 75 for Arab/African nationals) but could not be verified on an official source (anrpts.gov.mr unreachable during research), so amount left null.

fees.name: Visa on arrival - DISCONTINUED
fees.notes: From 5 January 2025 it is no longer possible to obtain a visa on arrival in Mauritania; an e-visa must be obtained in advance (fee still paid on arrival).

fees.name: Embassy sticker visa - phased out
fees.notes: Mauritanian embassies (e.g. Washington DC, historically USD 45 for up to 3 months) have stopped issuing visas since mid-2025 and direct applicants to the ANRPTS e-visa. Embassy site blocked during research (403), so no current fee recorded.

MRT.free_visa_notes: Not free for most travellers. Nationals of ECOWAS/several African and Arab states are visa-exempt; all others need the ANRPTS e-visa. Unofficial sources report a lower fee tier for Arab/African nationals (approx EUR 40 / USD 45 for 30 days) but this could not be confirmed on an official source.

fees.name: Tourist visa (applied in advance where required)
fees.notes: Official Passport and Immigration Office: 'Visas and Extensions of stay are issued free of charge.'

fees.name: Visa on arrival (incl. medical visa on arrival)
fees.validity: medical visa granted on arrival for duration of treatment, max 6 months
fees.notes: No fee; all visas issued free of charge.

fees.name: Business visa
fees.notes: Application page states 'Visa is free of cost'.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Issued free of charge.

fees.name: All-in-One Travel Digital Form (pre-arrival travel form)
fees.notes: Mandatory pre-arrival digital form (not a visa); free of charge, QR code issued after submission.

MUS.free_visa_notes: Mauritius issues ALL visas and extensions of stay free of charge (official Passport and Immigration Office: 'Visas and Extensions of stay are issued free of charge'). Most nationalities (incl. USA, GBR, CAN, RUS, IND, CHN, EU) are visa-free or get a free entry stamp on arrival; a smaller set of nationalities must obtain a free visa in advance (processing up to 12 working days). No e-visa fee, no VFS/outsourced centres, no reciprocity fee schedule.

fees.name: Single Entry Visa (e-Visa)
fees.notes: Applied online via evisa.gov.mw. Covers tourist/visit/business purposes (Malawi's 'Tourist Visa' category is issued for visits or business). Payment by Visa/Mastercard only; fee non-refundable if rejected. A non-refundable online payment convenience fee is charged in addition.

fees.name: Multiple Entry Visa (6 months)
fees.notes: Issued via the e-visa portal; all visa applications must be submitted online.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival (Category Two countries)
fees.notes: evisa.gov.mw states Category Two nationals may obtain a visa on arrival; the portal does not publish a distinct VOA fee (expected to match the standard single-entry USD 75 fee, but not verified on an official source, so amount left null). Category One nationals must obtain authorisation before departure. The government strongly encourages applying in advance via the e-visa portal.

MWI.free_visa_notes: Malawi's broad 2024 visa waiver (which covered the US, UK, EU, Canada, etc.) was withdrawn effective January 2026: the Ministry of Homeland Security announced on 2 Jan 2026 that visas are again required for nationals of all countries except a set of exempt (mostly regional/reciprocal, e.g. SADC-area) nationalities. No published reciprocity fee schedule by nationality; the USD fee table applies uniformly to visa-required nationals. Diplomatic, official and courtesy visas are gratis categories. No outsourced visa centre (VFS/TLS/BLS) is used; all applications go through the government e-visa portal.

fees.name: Visa Without Reference (embassy/consulate sticker visa, single/multiple entry)
fees.validity: Typically 3 months to enter; stay per pass issued (usually 30 days)
fees.notes: Immigration Department publishes 'Visa Fee According To The Country' (~35 countries, RM6-RM50). Countries not listed pay RM20.00. Same schedule applies to business/social visit purposes.

fees.name: eVisa (MyVISA portal) processing charge
fees.validity: eVisa valid 3 months, single entry, stay up to 30 days (typical tourist eVisa)
fees.notes: RM105 processing charge plus the nationality-based visa fee (e.g., RM50 India, RM20 Bangladesh/Nepal) and a payment convenience fee of 0.8%-1.7%. Applied via official MyVISA portal or MVAC centres.

fees.name: Visa On Arrival
fees.notes: RM200 payable in cash; must show min USD500 funds and confirmed return ticket. Note: India and China citizens are visa-exempt for stays up to 30 days until 31 Dec 2026, so VOA is rarely needed currently.

fees.name: Malaysia Digital Arrival Card (MDAC)
fees.validity: Single arrival; submit within 3 days before entry
fees.notes: Free arrival registration, not a visa. Malaysia has no paid eTA.

fees.name: Business visit visa (Visa Without/With Reference, business purpose)
fees.notes: Malaysia does not charge a separate business visa fee; the country fee table applies regardless of visit purpose.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Airside transit without leaving the transit area does not require a visa.

variations.note: Single/multiple entry RM50; transit RM50 (imi.gov.my fee table). Visa-exempt for 30-day visits until 31 Dec 2026.
Single/multiple entry RM30 (multiple entry RM30 per imi.gov.my). Visa-exempt for 30-day visits until 31 Dec 2026.
RM6 single/multiple entry, RM20 transit per imi.gov.my table; USA citizens are visa-free for up to 90 days, so rarely applicable.
RM20 single/multiple entry and transit per imi.gov.my table.
RM20 single/multiple entry and transit per imi.gov.my table; eVisa route adds RM105 processing charge.
Not on the published country fee table; default RM20 applies. GBR/PHL/RUS/CAN are visa-exempt for tourism; NGA nationals require a visa (RM20 visa fee + RM105 eVisa processing if applying online).

vfs.operator: MVAC (Malaysia Visa Application Centre / One Stop Centre network)
vfs.note: Since Aug 2022 eVisa applications from India must go via MVAC centres (New Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai); similar outsourced centres exist in several countries. Published centre service fee not verified on an official page; total eVisa cost = visa fee + RM105 processing + centre service charge, varies by centre.

MYS.free_visa_notes: Most Western, ASEAN and many other nationalities enter Malaysia visa-free (30-90 days). India and China nationals are visa-exempt for 30-day visits until 31 Dec 2026. The free MDAC digital arrival card is required for nearly all foreign visitors.

fees.name: Visa on Entry / e-Visa (Holiday visa, non-AU nationals)
fees.notes: Apply online via official portal eservices.mhaiss.gov.na (portal is WAF-protected and could not be fetched directly; fee confirmed on official Namibian Mission page). Children 6-11: NAD 800; under 6 exempt. Fees reviewed annually.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival (non-AU nationals)
fees.notes: African Union citizens pay NAD 1,200. Cruise passengers on day visits at Walvis Bay/Luderitz harbours pay NAD 300.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival (African Union nationals)
fees.notes: Children 6-11: NAD 600; under 6 exempt.

fees.name: Tourist visa, single entry (embassy-issued, fee varies by mission)
fees.notes: Embassy sticker-visa fees are set per mission in local currency; multiple entry CHF 160 at Geneva. Minors 6-11 CHF 40, under 6 exempt. Some missions add a small handling fee (~EUR 10 / NAD 80).

fees.name: Business visa (embassy-issued, fee varies by mission)
fees.notes: Per-mission local-currency pricing.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No separate published transit-visa fee found on official sources; transiting visa-required nationals generally use the standard visa-on-arrival/e-visa fee schedule. Amount left null rather than guessed.

variations.note: Non-AU, previously visa-exempt nationals: NAD 1,600 visa-on-entry fee introduced 1 April 2025 on reciprocity grounds.
Non-AU visa-required nationals pay the standard non-AU fee (NAD 1,600) via e-visa/embassy; not eligible for the visa-exempt VOA list at all border posts - check portal eligibility.
African Union citizens pay the reduced NAD 1,200 fee.

NAM.free_visa_notes: Namibia is not visa-free for all: since 1 April 2025 previously exempt nationals (USA, UK, most EU, Canada, Australia etc.) pay NAD 1,600 (AU citizens NAD 1,200) for visa on entry/e-visa. SADC and a shortlist of countries remain visa-exempt and pay nothing. VFS Global's Windhoek centre processes outbound visas (e.g. UK) from Namibia, not visas to Namibia.

fees.name: Embassy visa, all categories (Embassy of Niger, Washington DC)
fees.notes: Flat non-refundable USD 155 money-order fee applies uniformly across business, tourism, family, student, medical, journalist, transit and official categories at the Washington embassy.

fees.name: Single-entry visa, tourism/business, 1 month (Embassy of Niger, Paris)
fees.notes: Cash only; non-refundable. EUR 50 surcharge possible for exceptional urgency.

fees.name: Multiple-entry visa, tourism/business, 3 months (Embassy of Niger, Paris)
Multiple-entry visa, 6 months (Embassy of Niger, Paris)
Visa on arrival (pre-approved 'flyer visa' at Niamey)
fees.notes: A pre-approved on-arrival arrangement exists at Niamey, but no official fee schedule could be verified from a government source; amount left null. Third-party agencies quote widely varying totals that include service charges.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Transit is listed as a category at the Washington embassy under the same flat USD 155 fee; no separately published lower transit fee found on official sources.

NER.free_visa_notes: Citizens of ECOWAS/CEDEAO member states are visa-exempt. Diplomatic/service passport holders of Tunisia, Morocco, Chad, Cuba, Algeria, Turkey and Indonesia are exempt under bilateral agreements. Niger has no official e-visa or eTA system; fees are set per embassy (e.g. USD 155 flat in Washington, EUR 90-200 in Paris) rather than by a global reciprocity schedule. US embassy note: visa issuance to US citizens suspended since 28 Aug 2025 until further notice.

fees.name: e-Visa (Short Visit, single entry - tourism/business/visiting, F4A/F5A/F6A)
fees.validity: 90 days from issuance; stay up to 30 days (tourism) / 90 days, single entry
fees.notes: Launched 1 May 2025 under Nigeria Visa Policy 2025, replacing visa on arrival. Fee is reciprocity-based and varies by nationality; the exact amount is computed and paid online on the NIS portal during application. See reciprocity_variations for the published per-country schedule (NIS reciprocity table). Third-party guides report e.g. USD 160 for US nationals, consistent with the NIS table.

fees.name: Embassy short-visit visa (single entry) - reciprocity schedule
fees.notes: Nigeria publishes a per-country reciprocity fee table (Embassy VISA Fees, immigration.gov.ng/visa-fees; archived copy via cscs.ng dated 19/06/2019, still the last published schedule). Single-entry fees range from gratis (e.g. ECOWAS, Singapore, Barbados) to USD 253 (India, Bangladesh). No single flat fee exists; see reciprocity_variations.

fees.name: Business visa (single entry F4A / multiple entry F4B)
fees.validity: single entry 90 days; multiple-entry 1/2/5-year options for some nationalities
fees.notes: Same reciprocity schedule as short-visit visas; multiple-entry fees are higher (e.g. UK: USD 472/1yr, USD 944/2yr, USD 2360/5yr; Canada USD 150; Russia USD 200 per the NIS table).

fees.name: Transit visa (F3B)
fees.notes: Applied for via the e-visa portal; fee is nationality-dependent and shown at payment on the NIS portal. No flat published amount on an official static page; third-party sources cite ~USD 80 but this is unverified.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival (discontinued)
fees.notes: VoA was phased out from 1 May 2025 and replaced by the e-Visa under Nigeria Visa Policy 2025. Before discontinuation the VoA biometric fee was USD 170 (waived for US nationals from March 2023, per Fragomen).

variations.note: single AND multiple entry USD 253 (NIS Embassy Visa Fees reciprocity table)
single entry and multiple entry (1-2 yr) all USD 160; no 5-year option
single entry USD 144; multiple entry USD 472 (1yr) / 944 (2yr) / 2360 (5yr)
single and multiple entry USD 64
not applicable - Nigerian citizens
single entry USD 68; no multiple entry
single entry USD 39; multiple entry USD 78
single and multiple entry USD 253
single entry USD 84; multiple entry USD 200
single entry USD 75; multiple entry USD 150

vfs.service_fee: USD 96.30 (USA centres; USD 60 for US citizens); CAD 139 (Canada; CAD 79.50 for US citizens); EUR 91.45 (Germany)
vfs.note: Nigeria visa applications route through VFS Global in at least USA, Canada, Germany and the Philippines (per our data/vfs corridors). Mandatory service fee paid at the centre, on top of the visa fee paid online on the NIS portal; amounts vary by centre. In the UK/US some routes use OIS Services instead.

NGA.free_visa_notes: ECOWAS citizens (15 West African states) are visa-free. Several other nationalities are gratis on the reciprocity table (e.g. Afghanistan, Barbados, Liberia, Macedonia, Sierra Leone, Singapore, Trinidad and Tobago).

fees.name: Tourist card (INTUR entry fee, paid on arrival)
fees.notes: USD 10 cash collected by Migracion on behalf of INTUR at all air/land/sea entry points; exact change recommended. Land borders may add a ~USD 3 municipal/border services fee (not verified on an official source).

fees.name: Visa consultada (Category C consulted entry visa)
fees.validity: Must be used within 6 months of authorisation; stay up to 90 days
fees.notes: Nicaragua's DGME page (mint.gob.ni) lists requirements but no fee. Per the Mexican embassy's official communique on Nicaragua's Feb 2026 rules, the consulted visa 'no tendra costo alguno' (free). Applied via solicitudes@mint.gob.ni or the online portal tramitesconsulares.mint.gob.ni (live 21 Feb 2026); visa stamped at a Nicaraguan embassy/consulate. Nicaragua has no e-visa, eTA, or standalone business/transit visa fee schedule; the former Category B (visa on arrival without consultation) was eliminated in the Feb 2026 reform.

NIC.free_visa_notes: Most nationalities (Category A) need no visa: only the USD 10 tourist card on arrival. Visa-required (Category C) nationals need a pre-authorised 'visa consultada', which is issued free of charge since the Feb 2026 reform. No visa application is routed through VFS/TLScontact/BLS.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C)
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Children 6-11 pay EUR 45; children under 6 free. Fee waived for students/teachers on school trips, academic researchers, and non-profit youth (25 and under) per netherlandsworldwide.nl visa-costs page. Non-refundable.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C) - business purpose
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Same type C visa and fee as tourist; purpose is stated on the application.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (type A)
fees.notes: Children 6-11 EUR 45; under 6 free.

fees.name: Caribbean visa (Aruba, Bonaire, Curacao, Saba, St Eustatius, St Maarten)
fees.validity: short stay in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom
fees.notes: Separate visa regime from Schengen; applied for via Dutch missions/VFS. VFS service charge of approx EUR 35 applies where outsourced.

fees.name: ETIAS travel authorisation (EU-wide, not yet in force)
fees.notes: ETIAS is not yet operational as of 2026-07-02; published fee is EUR 20 once launched, free for under-18s and over-70s. Amount set to null because it is not yet chargeable.

variations.note: Reduced fee under EU visa facilitation agreements with Armenia, Azerbaijan and Belarus (listed as 'Low fee' on Netherlands consular fees schedule). EU-Russia facilitation is suspended, so RUS nationals pay the standard EUR 90.

vfs.service_fee: 1577 + 160 convenience fee (India, incl. GST); some categories 1855
vfs.note: Netherlands outsources short-stay visa intake to VFS Global (and TLScontact in a few countries). Service fee varies by centre/country; India-published amounts shown. Non-refundable and payable even if visa fee is waived.

NLD.free_visa_notes: No e-visa or visa on arrival exists for the Netherlands. Visa-exempt nationalities (e.g. USA, GBR, CAN and other Annex II countries) currently enter free; the EUR 20 ETIAS authorisation will apply to them once ETIAS launches. Children under 6 and certain student/researcher/youth categories are exempt from the Schengen visa fee.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visitor visa (type C), adults and children over 12
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Norway is a Schengen member; the common Schengen fee applies. Children 6-12: EUR 45; children under 6: free. Fee exemptions for close family of EU/EEA nationals, pupils/teachers on school trips, researchers, and applications via the Governor of Svalbard. Visa extension after arrival in Norway: EUR 30.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa for business purposes (same type C visa and fee)
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Norway has no separate business visa category; business travellers apply for the same Schengen C visa at the standard EUR 90 fee.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (type A)
fees.notes: Standard Schengen visa fee applies to airport transit visas; UDI fee page does not list a separate reduced transit amount.

variations.note: Reduced fee under the EU-Azerbaijan visa facilitation agreement, applied by Norway per UDI fee page (all applicants over 6 years).
The EU-Russia visa facilitation agreement is suspended; Russian citizens pay the full standard Schengen fee of EUR 90.

vfs.note: Norway outsources visa application intake to VFS Global in many countries. Service fee varies by centre and country; the India range shown (INR ~1,750-2,200) is from third-party guides because the official VFS fee page could not be fetched (HTTP 403). Verify the exact amount on the VFS country page before use.

NOR.free_visa_notes: Norway has no e-visa, no visa on arrival, and no national eTA. Visa-exempt nationals currently enter free; the EU/Schengen ETIAS travel authorisation (expected fee EUR 20) will apply to visa-exempt travellers once operational, but it was not yet in force at the time of this record.

fees.name: Tourist visa on arrival - 15 days (multiple entry)
fees.notes: Payable in cash at entry points (USD preferred, major convertible currencies accepted). Confirmed on Embassy of Nepal Beijing (cn.nepalembassy.gov.np) and TIA Immigration Office pages.

fees.name: Tourist visa on arrival - 30 days (multiple entry)
fees.notes: Extension: USD 45 for minimum 15 days, then USD 3/day; max 150 days per calendar year on tourist visa.

fees.name: Tourist visa on arrival - 90 days (multiple entry)
Embassy-issued tourist visa (pre-arrival sticker)
fees.notes: Embassies charge in local currency at rates equivalent to the on-arrival USD schedule; e.g. Embassy of Nepal Beijing publishes RMB 225 (15d) / RMB 375 (30d) / RMB 950 (90d), cash only. Local-currency amounts vary by mission - check the relevant Nepal embassy.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Fill online visa application, pay USD 5 at the bank counter, then proceed to the Transit Visa desk on arrival.

fees.name: Business (non-tourist) visa
fees.notes: Business visas are issued/converted by the Department of Immigration in Kathmandu (not on arrival); the fee schedule is not published on the pages verified for this record, so no amount is recorded. Embassy of Nepal Beijing directs applicants to the Department of Immigration for pricing.

variations.note: Indian citizens do not require a visa to enter Nepal.
Chinese nationals are exempted from the tourist visa fee (gratis visa). Source: cn.nepalembassy.gov.np and immigration.gov.np.
SAARC nationals (except Afghanistan) receive a gratis 30-day tourist visa on first entry in a calendar year; standard fees apply beyond 30 days or on repeat visits within the year.
Afghan citizens: gratis visa on arrival only with prior recommendation of the Department of Immigration; otherwise must apply in advance.

vfs.note: VFS Global operates a Nepal corridor in Saudi Arabia (visa.vfsglobal.com/sau/en/npl), but the published services there are Nepali passport/consular services (SAR 200-400), not visitor visas to Nepal. Visitor visas to Nepal are issued on arrival or by embassies directly; no VFS service fee for inbound Nepal visas is published.

NPL.free_visa_notes: Not free for everyone, but gratis for: Indian citizens (visa-exempt), Chinese nationals, children under 10 (except US citizens per Embassy Beijing note), SAARC nationals (except Afghanistan) for 30 days on first visit each calendar year, and NRN card holders.

fees.name: Visitor visa (up to 1 month)
fees.notes: Fee schedule on the Department of Justice & Border Control Immigration Division page lists $50; currency not explicitly stated on the page - Nauru's legal tender is the Australian dollar (AUD). Applications are made by email to Nauru Immigration; there is no e-visa portal.

fees.name: Visitor visa (up to 2 months)
fees.notes: Currency not explicitly stated on the page; assumed AUD (Nauru's legal tender).

fees.name: Visitor visa (up to 3 months)
fees.notes: Currency not explicitly stated on the page; assumed AUD (Nauru's legal tender).

fees.name: Free visa on arrival (eligible nationalities)
fees.notes: Eligibility list corroborated by multiple secondary sources; the official Immigration Division fee schedule does not list a visa-on-arrival class. Verify with Nauru Immigration before travel.

fees.name: Business visa - general (multiple entry, up to 12 months)
fees.notes: Plus $50 processing fee. Business visitors require a local sponsor. Currency not explicitly stated; assumed AUD.

fees.name: Business visa - media (single entry, up to 3 months)
fees.notes: AUD 8,000 media visa application fee is confirmed as AUD on naurugov.nr media fact sheet; non-refundable if application is unsuccessful.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No transit visa class or fee is published on the official Immigration Division fee schedule; amount unverified.

variations.note: Russian citizens are among nationalities eligible for a free visa on arrival in Nauru (secondary sources; not on the official fee schedule page).

NRU.free_visa_notes: Nauru has no e-visa or eTA system; visas are arranged by emailing Nauru Immigration before travel. Citizens of 16 mostly Pacific states (plus Israel, Russia, Taiwan) receive a free visa on arrival. IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD and CAN nationals must obtain a visitor visa in advance ($50/$150/$250 for 1/2/3 months).

fees.name: NZeTA (New Zealand Electronic Travel Authority) - mobile app
fees.validity: 2 years (5 years for crew); stays up to 6 months in any 12-month period
fees.notes: NZD 17 via the official mobile app, NZD 23 via the website. Most travellers also pay the IVL of NZD 100 at the same time (Australian citizens/PRs and transit-only passengers are exempt from the IVL).

fees.name: NZeTA - website application
fees.notes: Plus IVL NZD 100 where applicable.

fees.name: Visitor Visa (tourist, applied online)
fees.validity: Multiple entry up to 6 months, or single entry up to 9 months in 18 months
fees.notes: Listed as 'From NZD $441'; exact total varies by citizenship and where you apply (use INZ fee tool). New Zealand issues visitor visas via online application, not embassy sticker visas for most applicants. No visa on arrival exists.

fees.name: Business Visitor Visa
fees.notes: Listed as 'From NZD $341'; varies by citizenship/location. IVL of NZD 100 may apply.

fees.name: Transit Visa
fees.validity: Transit through Auckland International Airport, up to 24 hours
fees.notes: Listed as 'From NZD $235'. Transit passengers do not pay the IVL.

variations.note: Temporarily reduced visitor visa total for Pacific nationals (from NZD 216) effective 1 June 2026 for 12 months; includes NZD 41 immigration levy. Source: https://www.immigration.govt.nz/about-us/news-centre/visitor-visa-fees-temporarily-reduced-for-pacific-nationals/

vfs.note: INZ routes paper/biometric applications in many countries through VFS Global Visa Application Centres. VAC service fees vary by centre and increased in ~25 countries (incl. India, UK, US, Japan, Australia) from 1 January 2026; published amount not centrally listed - check the local VFS NZ page or INZ fee tool.

NZL.free_visa_notes: Visa-waiver nationals (approx. 60 countries incl. USA, GBR, most EU) do not need a visa but must obtain an NZeTA (NZD 17-23) plus IVL (NZD 100). Australian citizens are visa-free and IVL-exempt; Australian permanent residents need an NZeTA but no IVL. New Zealand has no visa-on-arrival.

fees.name: Tourist eVisa (Unsponsored) - 10 Day
fees.notes: Amount corroborated via secondary travel-industry sources citing the Royal Oman Police eVisa portal; the ROP portal itself is JS-rendered and its fee table could not be directly extracted by automated fetch, so this is not independently confirmed on-page.

fees.name: Tourist eVisa (Unsponsored) - 30 Day Single Entry
fees.notes: Amount corroborated via secondary travel-industry sources citing the Royal Oman Police eVisa portal; not independently confirmed on-page due to JS rendering.

fees.name: Tourist eVisa (Unsponsored) - 1 Year Multiple Entry
fees.validity: 1 year, multiple entry, 30 days per visit
fees.notes: Amount corroborated via secondary travel-industry sources citing the Royal Oman Police eVisa portal; not independently confirmed on-page due to JS rendering.

fees.name: Transit Visa
fees.notes: Amount corroborated via secondary travel-industry sources; not independently confirmed on-page due to JS rendering.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival (holders of qualifying AUS/CAN/JPN/USA/GBR/Schengen visa)
fees.notes: Availability confirmed (e.g. for Indian passport holders per the Embassy of India, Muscat guidance) but the exact fee amount could not be verified on an official source; not guessed.

fees.name: Business/Work-related Visit Visa (Sponsored)
fees.notes: Figure reported by secondary sources as of 2025/2026; could not be independently confirmed on the official ROP portal due to JS rendering, so official flag set to false pending verification.

OMN.free_visa_notes: Oman grants visa-free entry (up to 14 days) to nationals of over 100 countries per the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (fm.gov.om); this record covers the fees for nationalities that DO require a visa. No reciprocity-based fee schedule by specific nationality was found on official sources; the eVisa fee appears to be a flat structure by visa duration/type rather than by nationality. Oman's inbound eVisa process is handled directly via the Royal Oman Police portal (evisa.rop.gov.om), not through an outsourced VFS/TLS/BLS centre.

fees.name: Pakistan e-Visa (Tourist/Visit)
fees.validity: Typically 3 months from issuance (single or multiple entry options exist)
fees.notes: The official Pakistan Online Visa System (NADRA) fee-structure page is an interactive JavaScript fee calculator that requires selecting visa category, sub-category, entry type, and applicant country to display an exact amount - it does not publish a static fee table, so an exact official figure could not be captured programmatically. Secondary sources (travel blogs citing the calculator) report single-entry tourist e-visa fees ranging roughly USD 20-75 depending on nationality, with EU citizens around USD 35 and US/Canada/UK around USD 60; nine nationalities (Afghanistan, China, Japan, Iceland, North Korea, Slovakia, Malaysia, UAE, Saudi Arabia) reportedly pay no visa fee (except work visas). These secondary figures are NOT verified against the official calculator and amount is left null pending direct verification.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival
fees.notes: Per secondary reporting, Pakistan's Visa on Arrival and Visa Prior to Arrival programs were suspended effective 1 January 2026; all eligible travellers must now apply for an e-Visa in advance via visa.nadra.gov.pk. This could not be independently confirmed against an official NADRA/MOFA announcement page during this research pass.

fees.name: Pakistan e-Visa (Business)
fees.notes: Business is a selectable category on the official fee calculator; exact amount depends on applicant nationality, entry type, and sub-category and could not be captured statically.

PAK.free_visa_notes: Not free for all - Pakistan operates a reciprocity-based e-visa fee system covering 191 eligible nationalities, with fees varying by nationality, visa category, and entry type. Secondary sources indicate roughly nine nationalities (Afghanistan, China, Japan, Iceland, North Korea, Slovakia, Malaysia, UAE, Saudi Arabia) are exempt from the visa fee, but this was not verified against an official published list in this pass. The official NADRA fee calculator (https://visa.nadra.gov.pk/fee-structure/) must be queried per-nationality/category to obtain exact authoritative amounts; no VFS/outsourced visa centre is used - applications are submitted directly via the government portal.

fees.name: Stamped tourist visa (visa estampada de turista)
fees.validity: Up to 90 days stay; issued for a term no greater than 90 days
fees.notes: B/.50.00 migration-services fee paid at presentation to the Servicio Nacional de Migracion (balboa pegged 1:1 to USD). Applicant must also show economic solvency of at least B/.500.00. Applications now routed via the 'Migracion en linea' portal on migracion.gob.pa.

fees.name: Authorized visa (visa autorizada) via consulate
fees.notes: Embassy of Panama in Washington DC requires two money orders: USD 50.00 plus USD 90.00 payable to the Consulate of Panama. Processing up to 60 business days (stamped visa up to 30 business days). Amounts may vary by consulate.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Transit visa application form exists on migracion.gob.pa, but no fee amount could be verified on an official source; commonly processed with the same B/.50.00 migration-services fee, unverified.

PAN.free_visa_notes: Most nationalities (including USA, GBR, CAN, EU and many others) enter Panama visa-free for up to 90 or 180 days with no fee. No visa on arrival and no eTA scheme exists. Panama is not a Schengen member. Visa applications are handled directly by consulates and the Servicio Nacional de Migracion online portal; no outsourced centre (VFS/TLS/BLS) is used.

fees.name: Tourist visa (Visa de Turista, consulate-issued)
fees.validity: Up to 183 days total stay within 12 months of issue; no extension
fees.notes: Published as S/ 30.00 'soles consulares'; 1 sol consular ~ USD 1 (paid in local currency per each consulate's tarifario). Paid in cash at the consulate only if the visa is approved. Application can be started online via visasonline.rree.gob.pe but issuance and payment are at the consulate.

fees.name: Business visa (Visa de Negocios)
fees.validity: Up to 183 days total stay within 12 months of issue; no extension
fees.notes: S/ 30.00 soles consulares (~USD 30) per the gob.pe tramite page (Buenos Aires consulate procedure). Note: the older consular tariff PDF (consulado.pe Tarifa_Consular.pdf, item 67) lists temporary categories (negocios, artista, estudiante, transeunte, trabajador) at S/C 50.00, so some posts may charge up to ~USD 50; the current gob.pe pages state 30.

fees.name: Transit visa (Visa de Transeunte)
fees.validity: 2 calendar days from entry, extendable up to 15 days
fees.notes: 25.00 soles consulares (EUR 25.00 at the Havana consulate's tarifario shown on the gob.pe procedure page). Charged in local-currency equivalent per each consulate's tarifario. Apply at least 30 days before travel.

PER.free_visa_notes: Most nationalities (Americas, EU/Schengen, UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Japan, South Korea, and many others) enter Peru visa-free for tourism up to 183 days. No e-visa fee, no visa on arrival, and no eTA exist; visas for non-exempt nationalities are issued by consulates. Fees are quoted in 'soles consulares' where 1 sol consular is approximately USD 1, collected in local currency per each consulate's tarifario. No nationality-based reciprocity fee schedule is published.

fees.name: 9(a) Temporary Visitor's Visa - single entry (consular)
fees.validity: 3 months validity, stay up to 59 days
fees.notes: USD 40 for non-visa-free nationals; USD 25 for Chinese nationals (see reciprocity_variations). Fees are set in USD by DFA but posts publish local-currency equivalents (e.g. Oslo NOK 360 single / NOK 720 multiple; China CNY 190/228/304 single entry).

fees.name: 9(a) Temporary Visitor's Visa - multiple entry (consular)
fees.notes: No single USD schedule published; local-currency examples (China): 6-month CNY 456 (E.O. 408 nationals) / CNY 608 (others) / CNY 760 (Chinese); 12-month CNY 684 / CNY 912. Norway: NOK 720 multiple 6-month.

fees.name: Philippine e-Visa (9(a) Temporary Visitor, evisa.gov.ph)
fees.validity: single entry (7-12 working days processing) or multiple entry (15-21 working days)
fees.notes: Fee is displayed dynamically per nationality during application on evisa.gov.ph and is not published as a static schedule; could not verify a universal amount on an official source. Reports indicate USD 25 for Chinese nationals, consistent with the consular reciprocity rate.

fees.name: 9(a) Temporary Visitor's Visa - business
fees.validity: 3 months validity, stay up to 59 days
fees.notes: The Philippines uses the same 9(a) visa for pleasure and business; same fee schedule (USD 30/40/25).

fees.name: Transit
fees.notes: The Philippines has no separate transit visa category; transiting passengers who leave the airport need a 9(a) visa if visa-required. No visa-on-arrival or eTA regime exists; visa-required nationals must obtain a visa (consular or e-visa) before travel.

variations.note: Reduced 9(a) single-entry fee for Chinese nationals (USD 25 vs USD 30/40); in China: CNY 190 single, CNY 380 3-month multiple, CNY 760 6-month multiple. Since June 2025 Chinese (and Indian) nationals also get 14-day visa-free entry for tourism/business.
Non-visa-free (non-E.O. 408) nationals pay USD 40 single entry. India additionally received 14-day visa-free entry (non-extendible) from 8 June 2025 and is e-visa eligible.
E.O. 408 visa-free nationals: 30 days visa-free on arrival at no cost; USD 30 if a 9(a) visa for longer stay is applied for at a consulate.

vfs.note: VFS Global runs Philippine visa application centres in China (service fee CNY 138 per application) and Philippine e-visa/consular service centres in several other countries (e.g. Hong Kong); many VFS 'Philippines' centres elsewhere handle passport renewal only. Service fees vary by centre.

PHL.free_visa_notes: Nationals of 157 countries (E.O. 408 list, incl. USA, GBR, CAN, RUS and most of Europe/ASEAN) enter visa-free for 30 days with no fee. China and India nationals get 14-day visa-free entry (from 2025). Visa fees above apply only to visa-required nationals or those needing longer stays.

fees.name: Tourist visa on arrival (30 days)
fees.validity: 30 days, extendable twice for 30 days each
fees.notes: Issued free at entry; official Bureau of Customs and Border Protection page lists a fee only for renewal (USD 50 per 30-day extension). Requires valid passport (6+ months), return ticket, proof of funds (~USD 200/week), Palau Entry Form QR code (palautravel.pw) and signing the Palau Pledge.

fees.name: Tourist visa extension/renewal
fees.validity: 30 days per extension, maximum two extensions
fees.notes: USD 50 per 30-day renewal; apply at Division of Immigration at least 7 days before expiry.

fees.name: Business visa on arrival (30 days)
fees.validity: 30 days, extendable twice for 30 days each (USD 50 per renewal)
fees.notes: For meetings/conferences/negotiations; no employment permitted. Renewal fee USD 50.

fees.name: Transit (under 24 hours)
fees.notes: Transit passengers staying under 24 hours are exempt from visa requirements.

fees.name: Advance visa for Bangladesh and Myanmar nationals
fees.notes: Must apply before arrival from country of residence; fee not published on the official BCBP page, so amount left null.

variations.note: No visa on arrival; must obtain a visa in advance. Fee not published on official sources.

PLW.free_visa_notes: Palau grants a free 30-day visa on arrival to virtually all nationalities (except Bangladesh and Myanmar, who need advance visas); US, FSM and RMI citizens are visa-exempt. The only published visa fee is USD 50 per 30-day extension. Separately, all visitors pay the USD 100 Pristine Paradise Environmental Fee, included in the airline ticket (not a visa fee).

fees.name: eVisa - Visitor (Tourist, Own Itinerary or Tour Package)
fees.validity: Single entry, stay of up to 60 days from date of arrival; must enter within 60 days of issue
fees.notes: Base visa fee for the Tourist visitor classes is Nil; the USD 50 charge is the eVisa processing fee for applications lodged via evisa.ica.gov.pg. All migration fees are charged in USD per National Gazette No.231 (Migration Fees Amendment 2019).

fees.name: Visitor visa (paper application at PNG mission)
fees.validity: Single entry, up to 60 days from date of arrival
fees.notes: ICA Migration Service Fee schedule lists the base fee for Tourist (Tour Package), Tourist (Own Itinerary) and Visiting Relative classes as Nil. Extension fee USD 150; late extension USD 700. Paper applications lodged with payment receipt from ICA online gateway.

fees.name: Easy Visitor Permit (EVP) 30/60 days - visa on arrival
fees.validity: Single entry; 30 days (EVP30) or 60 days (EVP60) from date of arrival
fees.notes: Base fee Nil on the ICA fee schedule. If the EVP is lodged online in advance via the eVisa portal, the USD 50 eVisa processing fee applies.

fees.name: Business Short Term Single Entry
fees.validity: Single entry, stay up to 30 days; not extendable
fees.notes: Amount read from ICA's official fee PDF whose table extraction is partially garbled; row alignment strongly indicates USD 190 for single entry. Verify at https://ica.gov.pg/visa-information/migration-service-fees before relying on it.

fees.name: Business Short Term Multiple Entry
fees.notes: Amount read from ICA's official fee PDF (table extraction partially garbled; USD 350 aligns with the multiple-entry row). Verify against the Migration Service Fee schedule.

fees.name: Transit
fees.notes: PNG has no separate transit visa. Transit under 7 hours requires no visa (fee not applicable). Transit over 7 hours requires a visitor visa (USD 50 eVisa fee applies).

PNG.free_visa_notes: All foreign visitors need a visa (no general visa-free regime), but the base fee for tourist visitor classes and the visa-on-arrival Easy Visitor Permit is Nil - the only tourist cost is the USD 50 eVisa processing fee when applying online. Fees are set in USD per National Gazette No.231 (2019 amendment). No fee reciprocity schedule by nationality exists; nationality differences affect VOA eligibility only.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C)
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Standard Schengen fee. Children 6-12 pay EUR 45; children under 6, spouses/dependants of EU citizens, students on educational trips, researchers and diplomatic passport holders are exempt. USD 106 is the published equivalent at Poland's US consulates. Appeal against refusal: EUR 80 (Ireland post).

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - business purpose
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Same C-visa fee regardless of purpose (tourism, business, visit).

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.notes: Airport transit visas carry the same fee schedule as C visas; reduced EUR 35 rate applies to visa-facilitation nationalities.

fees.name: e-Visa
fees.notes: Poland does not issue e-visas. Applications are lodged at consulates via the e-Konsulat registration system or through outsourced VFS centres; the sticker visa itself is not electronic.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: No visa-on-arrival regime; Schengen rules require visas to be obtained in advance (border visas only in exceptional humanitarian cases).

fees.name: ETIAS travel authorisation (EU-wide, not yet in force)
fees.notes: ETIAS will apply to visa-exempt travellers to Poland once operational (announced fee EUR 20); not yet in force as of 2026-07-02, so no fee is currently charged.

variations.note: EU visa-facilitation rate for Ukrainian nationals (Schengen C and airport transit); Polish national D visa free for Ukrainians.
EU visa-facilitation rate for holders of non-biometric passports of these countries (biometric passport holders are visa-exempt for short stays).

vfs.note: Published India service fee INR 1,026 incl. GST, paid online at appointment booking; optional courier INR 960. Service fees vary by country/centre - VFS Global operates Poland visa centres in India, China, Nigeria, Philippines, Bangladesh, Canada, UK and others with locally published fees.

POL.free_visa_notes: Not free in general, but EU/EEA/Swiss citizens and ~60 visa-waiver nationalities (USA, GBR, CAN, JPN, etc.) enter Poland visa-free for short stays. Fee exemptions: children under 6, family members of EU citizens, students/researchers on qualifying trips, diplomatic passports; Polish national D visa is free for Ukrainian nationals. Note: from India the national (D) visa fee is published as EUR 200 / INR 21,120 (long-term category, outside this record's scope).

fees.name: Tourist visa (tourist card issued via DPRK embassy, arranged through an authorised tour operator)
fees.notes: The DPRK government publishes no official online fee schedule. Fees are paid in cash at the issuing embassy and vary by mission (tour operators commonly cite roughly EUR 50-60 at European embassies), but no official government source confirms an amount, so it is left null. Independent travel is prohibited; visas require prior authorisation from a registered DPRK travel agency.

fees.name: Business/official visit visa (invitation-based, embassy-issued)
fees.notes: Requires an invitation from a DPRK host organisation approved by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. No official fee schedule is published online; amount unverifiable.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Transit visas exist but no official published fee; amount unverifiable from official sources.

PRK.free_visa_notes: No general free-visa regime. Limited visa-free entry exists for holders of diplomatic/service (non-ordinary) passports from certain countries (e.g. Russia, Belarus, Mongolia, Serbia 90 days; China, Cuba, Iran, Laos, Vietnam and others 30 days) and for Chinese ordinary-passport holders on short local trips to Tongrim/Sinuiju. South Korean citizens cannot enter on their passports and need special inter-Korean authorisation. There is no e-visa, no eTA, and no general visa on arrival; DPRK does not use VFS/TLS/BLS outsourced centres. Tourism remains heavily restricted as of 2026, with access largely limited to organised tours (e.g. Rason region).

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - adult
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Common Schengen fee. Children 6-12 pay EUR 45; under 6 free. Payable in EUR or local currency at ECB rates. VFS USA lists USD 104 effective Apr 2026. Fee waived for students/teachers on study trips, researchers, non-profit reps under 25, and family members of EU/EEA/CH/UK nationals.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - business purpose
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Same Type C visa and fee as tourism; purpose is stated at application.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.notes: Standard Schengen visa fee applies to airport transit visas.

fees.name: e-Visa
fees.notes: Portugal does not operate a tourist e-visa; applications are lodged at consulates/VFS. (EU ETIAS, EUR 20, is planned for visa-exempt travellers but not yet in force as of 2026-07-02.)

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: Portugal does not issue visas on arrival except rare border visas in exceptional circumstances under the Schengen Visa Code.

variations.note: EU visa facilitation agreement rate (Belarus partial). Per Portuguese MFA visa-fees page.
Cabo Verde facilitation agreement: adults EUR 67.75, children 12-18 EUR 33.75, under 12 free.
EU-Russia visa facilitation agreement suspended since 2022; standard EUR 90 fee applies.

vfs.service_fee: USD 43.91 (USA centres); MFA caps external-provider service fee at EUR 45, up to EUR 80-120 where Portugal has no consulate
vfs.note: Service fee varies by centre/country. Verified published figure: US $43.91 incl. VAT per application (VFS Portugal-USA one-pager). India and other centres publish fees dynamically on booking portals.

PRT.free_visa_notes: Visa-free for EU/EEA/Schengen nationals and ~60 visa-exempt nationalities (USA, GBR, CAN, JPN, etc.) for stays up to 90/180 days. Visa fee waived for children under 6, students/teachers on study trips, researchers, and family members of EU/EEA/CH/UK citizens.

fees.name: Consular visa (non-resident), single entry
fees.validity: single entry, stay up to 90 days
fees.notes: Payable in USD or local-currency equivalent at the consular rate. Applications for the non-resident category (tourist/technical) are initiated via the MRE online portal (visasenlinea); nationals of certain African/Asian countries need prior ministerial authorisation (~1 month processing).

fees.name: Consular visa (non-resident), multiple entry
fees.notes: Same fee applies to business travellers under the non-resident category; Paraguay has no separately priced business visa on published consular schedules.

fees.name: Visa en Línea (MRE online visa application)
fees.validity: non-resident category, stay up to 90 days
fees.notes: The online portal is the digital channel for the standard non-resident consular visa, not a separately priced e-visa product; the fee shown at payment matches the consular schedule (USD 65 single / USD 100 multiple). Portal itself does not publish a fee table.

fees.name: Visa de arribo (Silvio Pettirossi Airport, Asunción)
fees.notes: Fee depends on nationality (see reciprocity_variations): AUS 135, CAN 150, USA 160, NZL 140, TWN 100, QAT/ARE/OMN 100 USD. Cash USD only at the airport. Note: US, Canadian, Australian and NZ citizens are visa-exempt for tourism (up to 90 days) until 13 Aug 2027 under Law 7314/2024, so the fee applies only to non-tourism purposes for them during the waiver.

variations.note: Multiple entries, valid 10 years; same fee at consulates. Visa-exempt for tourism until 13 Aug 2027 (Law 7314/2024).
Multiple entries until passport expiry; visa-exempt for tourism until 13 Aug 2027.
Multiple entries until passport expiry; visa-exempt for tourism until 13 Aug 2027.
Multiple entries until passport expiry; visa-exempt for tourism until 13 Aug 2027.
Multiple entries until passport expiry.
Listed by Paraguay Consulate in Washington DC.

Standard consular schedule applies (USD 65 single / USD 100 multiple). Nationals of certain African and Asian countries require prior ministerial authorisation, extending processing to ~1 month. RUS is visa-free for short tourist stays under bilateral agreement (verify per corridor data).

PRY.free_visa_notes: Most of the Americas, the EU/Schengen area, and MERCOSUR nationals enter Paraguay visa-free. US, Canadian, Australian and New Zealand citizens are temporarily visa-exempt for tourism stays up to 90 days until 13 August 2027 (Law 7314/2024); outside that waiver they fall under the reciprocity fee schedule.

fees.name: ETA-IL (Israel Electronic Travel Authorization, required to reach the West Bank via Israeli-controlled borders)
fees.validity: Up to 2 years or passport expiry; stays up to 90 days per entry
fees.notes: Palestine issues no entry visas of its own; all access to the West Bank (Ben Gurion Airport, Allenby/King Hussein Bridge) is controlled by Israel. Mandatory since 1 Jan 2025; fee non-refundable, paid online by card.

fees.name: Israel B/2 visitor visa (consular sticker visa, required for non-visa-exempt nationalities to transit Israel into the West Bank)
fees.validity: Up to 3 months from date of issue
fees.notes: Fee is set per Israeli mission in local currency (e.g. CAD 33 at the Montreal consulate); no single global amount published, so amount left null. Verify with the local Israeli embassy fee chart.

PSE.free_visa_notes: Palestine itself charges no visa fee and issues no entry visas: border control for the West Bank is exercised by Israel (Gaza access is separately controlled and currently closed to tourism). Travellers pay Israel's fees instead - ETA-IL NIS 25 for visa-exempt nationals, or an Israeli B/2 consular visa (fee varies by mission) for others. Entry via Allenby Bridge from Jordan also runs under Israeli control.

fees.name: Hayya Tourist Visa (A1) e-visa
fees.validity: 30 days stay (extendable); enter within validity shown on approval
fees.notes: QAR 100 paid upon final approval via the official Hayya portal (hayya.qa); fee can be exempted under certain conditions (e.g. Discover Qatar hotel booking promotions).

fees.name: Hayya GCC Resident Visa (A2)
fees.notes: Applied online via Hayya portal before travel.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.validity: 30 or 90 days depending on nationality (waiver tiers)
fees.notes: Many eligible nationalities (incl. Schengen, UK, US, Canada, Australia, NZ) enter under the visa-waiver programme at no charge; the QAR 100 on-arrival fee applies where charged, and can be waived with a hotel booking through Discover Qatar.

fees.name: Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA)
fees.notes: ETA listed on MOI Qatar Visas portal (issued via Hayya); no fee published on the official page — MOI/Hayya do not state a charge, widely reported as free but not verified on an official source, so amount left null.

fees.name: Qatar transit visa (96 hours, Qatar Airways passengers)
fees.notes: Free of charge; both flight legs must be on Qatar Airways. Standalone application reportedly routed through Manage Booking / Discover Qatar stopover packages.

fees.name: Business visit visa (sponsor-arranged)
fees.notes: Arranged by the Qatari host company via MOI; MOI does not publish a public fee schedule for business visit visas online, so amount left null rather than estimated (unofficial sources cite roughly QAR 200 single-entry).

variations.note: Covered by Qatar's visa-waiver programme (102+ nationalities): free entry on arrival, no visa fee. IND/PHL/RUS/CHN are on the 30-day waiver tier; Schengen nationals get 90 days.
Not on the visa-waiver list; must obtain the Hayya Tourist Visa (A1) for QAR 100 before travel.

QAT.free_visa_notes: Citizens of 102+ countries (Schengen, UK, US, Canada, Australia, NZ, India, and others) enter Qatar visa-free / free-on-arrival under the visa-waiver programme; GCC nationals need no visa at all.

fees.name: Schengen Short-Stay Visa (Type C) - adult
fees.notes: Romania applies the common EU/Schengen-associated short-stay visa fee (raised to EUR 90 in June 2024, confirmed current on EU Commission migration/home-affairs page). Romania is an EU member applying the common visa policy for non-Schengen-area short stays; national embassies issue the visa under this standard fee schedule. Could not reach mae.ro (Ministry of Foreign Affairs) directly - site returned a bot-verification/503 response during this check, so this figure is corroborated via the EU Commission official source and cross-checked against secondary aggregator sites rather than a direct MFA fee-schedule page.

fees.name: Schengen Short-Stay Visa (Type C) - child aged 6-12
fees.notes: Reduced fee per common EU rules; children under 6 typically exempt.

fees.name: Airport/Transit Visa (Type A/B)
fees.notes: Secondary sources report transit visa fees are typically the same as the short-stay visa fee, but this was not confirmed on an official government page; amount withheld pending direct MFA verification.

fees.name: Schengen Short-Stay Visa (Type C) - business purpose
fees.notes: Business short-stay visas fall under the same Type C fee schedule as tourist visas.

variations.note: EU suspended the EU-Russia visa facilitation agreement in 2022; Russian nationals may face higher fees and no facilitation benefits, but an exact current figure was not confirmed on an official Romanian source during this check.

vfs.note: VFS Global operates Romania visa application centres in several countries including India. Published/aggregator estimates place the India service fee around INR 1,500-2,500 per applicant in addition to the consular visa fee, but this was not verified on VFS Global's own fee page during this check (only secondary aggregator sources were accessible) - treat as indicative, not authoritative.

ROU.free_visa_notes: EU/EEA/Swiss citizens and holders of certain valid Schengen visas do not need a separate Romanian visa for short stays. Romania is progressively integrating into the Schengen area (air/sea borders from 2024, land borders joining in 2025-2026); short-stay visa policy already follows the common Schengen fee schedule for non-exempt nationalities.

fees.name: Unified Electronic Visa
fees.notes: Consular fee widely reported at 52 USD (payment platform accepts CNY or AED equivalents); children under 6 exempt. Official evisa.kdmid.ru portal states a fee applies but does not itself publish the numeric amount on the fetched page, so this figure is corroborated by MFA consular department pages (e.g. washington.mid.ru, houston.mid.ru) and third-party guides rather than a single definitive number on evisa.kdmid.ru. CORRECTION (2026-07-08): validity was previously recorded here as "60 days from issue, up to 16 days stay", which directly conflicts with data/countries/RUS.json's own visa_policy record ("valid 120 days from issue; single entry", max_stay_days: 30) - both cite kdmid.ru sources. Cleared pending manual re-verification against the official portal rather than showing a third, unreconciled figure alongside the other two.

fees.name: Single/double-entry ordinary (sticker) visa - consular fee, US applicants
fees.validity: up to 30 days per entry (varies by visa)
fees.notes: Consular fee for US citizens is a reciprocity-based flat rate; other nationalities' consular fees are set separately by the relevant Russian consulate and were not individually verified here.

fees.name: 3-year multiple-entry visa - consular fee, US applicants
fees.notes: Corrected 2026-07-02: official VFS Global Russia USA fee table lists $160 for Single Entry, Double Entry, and 3-Year Multiple Entry alike (regular and expedited). The previously recorded $185 figure from a third-party guide is stale/incorrect and has been replaced with the confirmed official amount.

fees.name: Business visa - consular fee (general)
fees.notes: Official consulate fee-schedule page (newyork.mid.ru) could not be fetched successfully in this research pass (connection reset). Business visa consular fees are known to exist and are typically similar in range to tourist visa fees for the same nationality, but the exact amount was not verified from an official source, so amount is left null.

fees.name: Transit visa - consular fee (general)
fees.notes: Could not verify exact transit visa fee from an official source in this research pass; official consulate fee schedule page did not load successfully.

variations.note: Reciprocity-based consular fee for US citizens; per official VFS Global Russia USA fee page, $160 applies uniformly to single entry, double entry, and 3-year multiple entry (regular and expedited).
Citizens of the USA, UK, Canada, and Australia are NOT eligible for the unified e-visa and must apply for an ordinary consular visa instead.

vfs.note: VFS Global operates the Russia Visa Application Centre for US applicants; published service charge is 38 USD (incl. VAT) per application on top of the consular fee. Reports of a much higher commission (up to 365 USD) circulate in third-party sources following disruptions to Russian visa center operations in the US (only the New York center currently accepting mail-in applications); this higher figure was not confirmed on the official VFS Global page and is noted here for awareness only, not recorded as the fee.

fees.name: V-1 Visitor's visa (holiday), single entry
fees.notes: Same fee whether obtained as e-visa (Irembo), on arrival, or at a mission.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (all nationalities since 1 Jan 2018)
fees.notes: Payable in USD or by card at Kigali airport; AU/Commonwealth/Francophonie nationals free 30 days; EAC citizens get a free 6-month entry pass.

fees.name: e-Visa via Irembo portal (V-1)
fees.notes: Optional pre-arrival application; same fee schedule as visa on arrival.

fees.name: V-11 East African Tourist Visa (Rwanda, Kenya, Uganda)
fees.validity: 90 days, multiple entry within the three countries

fees.name: V-5 Conference/meetings visa, single entry
fees.notes: V-6 business survey: USD 50 single / USD 70 multiple (90 days); V-9 itinerant business: USD 200, multiple entry, 2-10 years.

fees.name: Transit
fees.notes: No dedicated transit visa category is published on the DGIE visitor-visa schedule; short transits are covered by the universal visa on arrival. Fee not separately verified.

variations.note: Nationals of African Union, Commonwealth and La Francophonie member states (incl. India, UK, Nigeria, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Canada) receive a free 30-day visa on arrival. USA, China and Russia are not in these blocs and pay the standard USD 50/70; verify current waiver list on migration.gov.rw.
Philippines is on Rwanda's bilateral visa-free list: free entry visa for 90 days (also Qatar, Singapore, Indonesia, Ghana, Senegal, etc.).

RWA.free_visa_notes: Visa on arrival available to all nationalities since 1 Jan 2018. Free 30-day visa for nationals of African Union, Commonwealth and La Francophonie member states; free 90-day visa for a bilateral list (Philippines, Qatar, Singapore, Indonesia, Ghana, Senegal, Mauritius, Seychelles, etc.); EAC citizens get a free 6-month entry pass.

fees.name: Saudi eVisa (Tourist)
fees.validity: 1 year multiple entry, up to 90 days per visit
fees.notes: Total of government visa fee (SAR 300) + mandatory medical insurance (SAR 180) + online platform processing fee (SAR 55), per secondary sources citing the official portal visa.visitsaudi.com (which returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch during this research). Uniform fee across all eligible nationalities; no nationality-based surcharge reported.

fees.name: Saudi Visa on Arrival (Tourist)
fees.validity: 1 year multiple entry, up to 90 days per visit
fees.notes: Same components as eVisa minus the SAR 55 online platform processing fee. Payable by card only at airport kiosks (Visa/Mastercard/Mada); cash not accepted. Official portal page returned HTTP 403 during direct fetch; figure corroborated by multiple secondary sources referencing the official portal/MOFA.

fees.name: Saudi Business Visa
fees.notes: No single official fee amount could be verified. Secondary sources report a wide range (SAR 800-2,000 / roughly USD 210-530 depending on single vs multiple entry and processing), but MOFA's official 'Visa Fees payment' e-service page (svc78.aspx) could not be fetched directly to confirm exact current figures. Amount left null per accuracy rules; treat range in notes as indicative only, not verified.

fees.name: Saudi Transit Visa
fees.notes: Secondary sources indicate transit visas are often free or discounted versus the full tourist visa, but no verified official fee amount was found. Amount left null per accuracy rules.

SAU.free_visa_notes: No nationality-based fee variation was found for the tourist eVisa/visa-on-arrival - the SAR 535/480 fees are reported as uniform across all ~66 eligible nationalities (including IND, USA, GBR, CHN listed among eligible countries; no reciprocity schedule identified). VFS Global's presence in Saudi Arabia (Jeddah/Riyadh/Khobar/Jubail centres) serves Saudi residents applying for visas to OTHER countries (Schengen, UK, US, Canada, etc.) - it is not used as an outsourced intake channel for inbound visas to Saudi Arabia itself, which are processed via the official eVisa portal or airport VOA kiosks. Direct WebFetch of visa.visitsaudi.com and visitsaudi.com returned HTTP 403 (bot-blocked) during this research; fee figures rely on consistent secondary reporting attributed to those official sources rather than a first-hand fetch, hence confidence is set to medium rather than high.

fees.name: Entry Visa (business/tourist/other, non-Sudanese applicants) - Embassy of Sudan, Washington DC
fees.notes: Embassy of Sudan in Washington DC lists a flat $154 processing fee covering business, work, humanitarian and other entry-visa categories; no separate 'tourist' visa category is listed on this page. Requires an entry permit from the Sudan Ministry of Interior prior to application. Processing time up to 10 working days.

fees.name: Entry Visa (non-Sudanese applicants) - Embassy of Sudan, London
fees.notes: Embassy of Sudan in London charges GBP 100 (cash or postal order) for non-Sudanese applicants; requires an entry permit from the Ministry of Interior in Khartoum first. Fee for Sudanese nationals holding foreign passports is GBP 50 (not a foreign-traveller fee, excluded here).

fees.name: Sudan Ministry of Interior e-service entry permit
fees.notes: Sudan requires applicants to first obtain an entry permit via the Ministry of Interior e-service portal (eservice.passport.gov.sd) before applying for a visa at an embassy. Could not verify an official published fee amount for this online step from an accessible official source; do not guess. Third-party sites cite ~$100 for visa-on-arrival with a letter of invitation, but this was not confirmed on an official government page and is therefore omitted as a priced entry.

SDN.free_visa_notes: Sudan does not offer visa-free entry to most foreign nationals; almost all travellers require a visa, generally preceded by an entry permit from the Ministry of Interior. No reciprocity fee schedule by nationality was found on official Sudanese sources; fees appear to be a flat rate per issuing embassy rather than nationality-based. No VFS/TLS/BLS outsourced visa centre found for Sudan - applications are handled directly by Sudanese embassies/consulates.

fees.name: Senegal biometric e-Visa (pre-enrolment via visasenegal.sn)
fees.notes: Official Senegal e-visa/pre-enrolment portal. Base fee of EUR 50 plus a card-processing fee of EUR 2.50-5.00 depending on payment method, non-refundable if refused. WebFetch of visasenegal.sn returned only header content (JS-rendered site); amount corroborated via secondary aggregator sources citing the official portal, not independently confirmed on-page by this session. Senegal announced in 2025 a move to a broader reciprocity-based e-visa policy; exact country-by-country fee schedule under that new system was not found on an official source as of this record's date.

fees.name: Consular sticker visa (embassy/consulate-issued)
fees.notes: Senegal consulate (Paris) visa application page lists required documents for visa categories A/B/C but does not publish fee amounts on-page; page directs applicants to contact infovisa-paris@diplomatie.gouv.sn for current fees. Not verified numerically from an official source.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No official fee schedule found for a distinct transit visa category.

fees.name: Business visa
fees.notes: Business visa follows the same e-visa/consular sticker process as tourist visa; no distinct official fee found beyond the general EUR 50 e-visa base fee.

variations.note: Official U.S. State Department reciprocity schedule states Senegal charges NO visa issuance fee ('None') to U.S. citizens across all nonimmigrant visa categories (tourist, business, student, work, etc.), though standard e-visa/administrative enrolment steps may still apply. Source: travel.state.gov Senegal reciprocity page.

SEN.free_visa_notes: Senegal is not visa-free for all nationalities; many nationalities require the online e-visa/pre-enrolment (visasenegal.sn) plus consular issuance, though a number of nationalities benefit from visa exemptions or reciprocity waivers (e.g., U.S. citizens pay no fee per State Department reciprocity data). A 2025 government announcement indicated a broader reciprocity-based e-visa policy was being rolled out; a detailed, current official fee table by nationality was not locatable on an official Senegalese government source as of 2026-07-02.

fees.name: Singapore e-Visa (visa-required nationals)
fees.validity: Single or multiple entry, typically issued for up to 2 months; processed within ~3 working days
fees.notes: Non-refundable S$30 processing fee, payable online by Visa/Mastercard credit or debit card. Applies uniformly across visa-required nationalities per ICA guidance; no separate reciprocity schedule found on ICA site.

fees.name: Visa fee via Singapore Overseas Mission / authorised visa agent
fees.notes: ICA confirms the S$30 government fee applies; any additional mission/agent handling charge is not published by ICA and was not verifiable on an official source, so left null rather than estimated.

SGP.free_visa_notes: Singapore grants visa-free entry to most passport holders (including USA, GBR, most EU/Schengen states, many others) for short tourist stays. A visa (S$30 e-Visa fee) is required only for nationals of specific countries per the ICA visa-required list (e.g. India, China, and others). Singapore is not a Schengen member; no Schengen fee applies.

fees.name: Visitor Visa - Tourist (e-visa)
fees.validity: 30 days on arrival, single entry, max stay up to 150 days
fees.notes: Standard visa fee is USD 100, plus a USD 50 online application/administration fee (total commonly cited as USD 150 for the e-visa). Fees are levied in USD and converted to Solomon Islands Dollars (SBD) at time of payment. Extension fee is also USD 100.

fees.name: e-Visa online application fee (surcharge added to visa fee)
fees.notes: Non-refundable online application/administration fee charged in addition to the underlying visa fee (e.g. USD 50 + USD 100 tourist visa = USD 150 total). Site notes online payment 'will be operational soon'; applications currently also accepted in person in Honiara.

fees.name: Business Visa (Short-Term)
fees.notes: Short-term business visa fee as published on the Immigration Division visa types page.

fees.name: Transit Visa (Commercial Maritime)
fees.validity: issued on arrival, 7 days (max stay up to 14 days)
fees.notes: Listed as a visa-on-arrival category for commercial maritime transit; no fee amount published on the official site, so left null rather than guessed.

SLB.free_visa_notes: Citizens of the US and most Commonwealth/EU/MSG (Melanesian Spearhead Group) countries can enter visa-free or receive a free visitor permit on arrival for up to 3 months within any 1-year period; the MSG visitor visa category is also listed as free (60 days, single entry). No official reciprocity fee schedule by nationality was found on immigration.gov.sb, so no per-nationality variations are recorded; only the general 'not required for many nationalities' vs 'visa required' distinction applies.

fees.name: Sierra Leone eVisa
fees.notes: Fee reported by third-party evisa guide sites referencing the official evisa.sl portal; the portal itself (evisa.sl) did not expose fee text to automated fetch, so this figure should be re-verified against the live application flow at evisa.sl before quoting to travellers.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival - non-AU nationals
fees.notes: From Sierra Leone Immigration Department (slid.gov.sl) search-indexed content; page returned 404 on direct fetch at time of research, so figure is taken from Google-cached snippet of the official domain, not a live page render.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival - African Union nationals
fees.notes: Free for ECOWAS member states, diplomats, UNLP holders, and nationals of countries with reciprocal fee-waiver agreements. Same sourcing caveat as above (indexed snippet, not direct page fetch).

fees.name: Landing Visa - non-ECOWAS African Union citizens (single entry)
fees.notes: Le250,000 single entry / Le375,000 multiple re-entry. Amount in Leones (new currency, SLE code post-2022 redenomination). USD conversion not calculated to avoid a false-precision estimate; direct page fetch returned 404, sourced from indexed snippet of the official domain.

fees.name: Landing Visa - other nationalities (single entry)
fees.notes: Le800,000 single entry / Le1,200,000 multiple re-entry. Free for ECOWAS, diplomats, UNLP holders. Same sourcing caveat: indexed snippet of official domain, page 404'd on direct fetch.

SLE.free_visa_notes: Visa on arrival and landing visa are free for ECOWAS member-state nationals, diplomats, UN Laissez-Passer holders, and nationals of countries with reciprocal fee-waiver agreements with Sierra Leone, per slid.gov.sl. No reciprocity schedule for the specific key nationalities (IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, RUS, CAN) was found on official sources beyond the AU/non-AU and ECOWAS/non-ECOWAS categories above; NGA as an ECOWAS member would fall under the free-visa category. No VFS/TLScontact/BLS outsourced visa centre was found for Sierra Leone; applications route through the official evisa.sl portal or on-arrival/immigration department channels. Direct fetches of slid.gov.sl visa-on-arrival and landing-visa pages returned HTTP 404 at research time (2026-07-02); figures come from search-engine indexed snippets of the same official domain and should be re-confirmed via a live browser session before publishing as authoritative.

fees.name: Tourist card (tarjeta de turismo) on arrival
fees.validity: 90 or 180 days depending on passport validity/purpose; single entry
fees.notes: Not a visa - an entry tourist card purchased at the port of entry. El Salvador is part of the CA-4 agreement (free movement with Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua for 90 days total). Fee confirmed on US State Dept country page; DGME does not publish it online.

fees.name: Consular visa (Visa Consular / Sin Consulta, Category B)
fees.notes: Applied for at Salvadoran embassies/consulates (or by emailing form to visaselsalvador@rree.gob.sv). Fee amount is NOT published on rree.gob.sv or migracion.gob.sv; third-party sources report roughly USD 30-60 but this could not be verified on an official source, so amount left null.

fees.name: Consulted visa (Visa Consultada, Category C)
fees.notes: Requires prior approval from DGME before the consulate can issue. Application form F-46 is published by DGME; the fee amount is not published online, so amount left null. Holding a valid US/Canada/Schengen visa can upgrade the applicant from Category C to consular-visa (B) treatment per rree.gob.sv/visas.

fees.name: Special Entry Permit (Permiso Especial de Ingreso, PEI)
fees.notes: Online application and payment via DGME - functions as the closest thing El Salvador has to an e-visa. USD 100.00 migration service fee confirmed on the official DGME page.

SLV.free_visa_notes: Most Western/Latin American nationalities (Category A) need no visa - only the USD 12 tourist card on arrival. Visa fees by nationality reciprocity are not published; El Salvador instead uses a three-tier category system (A exempt / B consular / C consulted) and no per-nationality fee schedule could be verified on official sources.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (via Italy, required for entry to San Marino)
fees.notes: San Marino does not operate its own visa regime for general travellers; travellers who need a visa to enter must obtain a Schengen visa from an Italian diplomatic mission, since San Marino cannot be reached without transiting Schengen territory. The European Commission confirmed the standard adult Schengen visa fee rose from EUR 80 to EUR 90 effective 11 June 2026 (Regulation (EC) 810/2009 as amended).

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa - child fee (age 6-12)
fees.notes: Children under 6 are exempt (fee: 0).

SMR.free_visa_notes: San Marino is an enclave surrounded entirely by Italy with no independent border control or airport handling scheduled international flights; it cannot be reached without transiting the Schengen Area. It does not issue its own visas for general tourism - travellers who are visa-exempt for Schengen/Italy (including US, UK, Canadian, most nationalities) can visit San Marino without any visa or fee. Travellers who require a visa to enter the Schengen Area must obtain a standard Schengen short-stay visa (processed via an Italian consulate) to visit San Marino; no separate San Marino-specific fee exists.
