From late 2026, visa-exempt nationals will also need an ETIA travel authorisation (EUR 20, EU-wide, not San Marino specific) to enter Schengen territory including San Marino - excluded from 'fees' above per scope (eTA/ETIAS is an EU-wide instrument, not a San Marino national scheme) but noted here for completeness. Reciprocity fee variations (IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, RUS, CAN) could not be separately verified for San Marino because it does not run its own reciprocity fee schedule; the applicable schedule is Italy's/EU's standard Schengen visa fee table, which does not vary by nationality except for a small number of facilitation-agreement countries (fee reductions/waivers for certain former USSR states, not applicable to the ten reference nationalities).

fees.name: Somalia eVisa / eTAS (federal, mandatory since 1 Sep 2025)
fees.notes: Official federal eVisa/eTAS portal (etas.gov.so, linked from evisa.gov.so and visa.gov.so) is JavaScript-rendered and blocks automated fetch, so the exact fee could not be read directly off the government page. Secondary sources (embassy-adjacent travel guides, visa agencies) consistently report the official portal fee as $64-$65 USD. Treat amount as best-available-evidence, not confirmed on-page by this crawl.

fees.name: Somaliland Visa on Arrival (Hargeisa and other Somaliland-controlled airports)
fees.notes: Somaliland (self-declared, not internationally recognized as separate from Somalia) continues to issue its own visa on arrival, distinct from the federal eVisa. No official Somaliland government fee schedule could be located/verified; amount left null rather than guessed.

SOM.free_visa_notes: Somalia has no general visa-free regime; nearly all foreign nationals require a visa, now issued as a mandatory federal eVisa/eTAS (effective 1 September 2025) applied for online before travel via etas.gov.so / evisa.gov.so. No reciprocity/nationality-tiered fee schedule was found published on the official portal. Third-party agents (e.g. evisasomali.com) charge an all-inclusive $94 USD service fee, which is NOT the official government fee and is excluded from the fees array above.

fees.name: Short-stay visa (Visa C)
fees.notes: Consular fee stated by Embassy of Serbia in New Delhi as 92 EUR / 9,240 INR. Children under 12: 47 EUR / 4,722 INR. Fee is paid in local currency at the mission where applied; amount may vary slightly by country/exchange rate. General MFA visa-requirements page confirms a visa fee applies but does not itself publish the amount.

fees.name: Long-stay visa (Visa D)
fees.notes: Consular fee stated by Embassy of Serbia in New Delhi as 52 EUR / 5,222 INR. Not a tourist-specific product but the general long-stay visa category; included for completeness.

fees.name: eVisa (Visa C, submitted via Welcome to Serbia portal)
fees.notes: The e-visa portal (evisa.welcometoserbia.gov.rs) lets eligible applicants submit a Visa C or Visa D application online instead of visiting a mission in person, but the portal itself does not publish a distinct fee schedule -- the same consular visa-C/visa-D fees apply. Could not verify a separate published e-visa amount, so left null rather than guessing.

variations.note: 92 EUR (~9,240 INR) for Visa C up to 90 days; 47 EUR (~4,722 INR) for children under 12. Source: Embassy of Serbia in New Delhi.

SRB.free_visa_notes: Serbia maintains an extensive visa-free regime: nationals of most EU/Schengen countries, the US, UK, Canada, and many other countries can enter visa-free for short tourist stays (typically up to 90 days). Nationals of China, Armenia, Mali and Syria are exempt from paying the visa fee even when a visa is required, per bilateral agreements (per general search of MFA-linked sources; verify per-nationality exemption on the country-specific 'Visa regime for entering Serbia' pages at mfa.gov.rs before publishing per-country claims). Serbia does not use VFS Global or another outsourced centre for its own outbound visa issuance -- applications are handled directly by Serbian diplomatic-consular missions or via the Welcome to Serbia e-visa/e-services portal; VFS Global centres in Belgrade found in search results serve applications INTO other countries (e.g., Canada, UK), not into Serbia.

fees.name: South Sudan Visa (Embassy-issued, single entry, standard nationalities)
fees.notes: Fee schedule published by the Embassy of South Sudan in Washington DC; issued within ten business days (stated as a temporary measure). Fees may vary slightly by issuing embassy/consulate.

fees.name: South Sudan Visa - bordering African countries
fees.notes: Published embassy fee schedule.

fees.name: South Sudan e-Visa
fees.notes: Official e-visa portal (evisa.gov.ss) charges fees that vary by nationality and visa type (single entry / 3-month multiple entry / 6-month multiple entry). The exact amounts are not published in static page content and require searching by country on the portal; could not verify a specific figure from an official source, so amount is left null rather than guessed.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival at Juba International Airport
fees.notes: No official government source with a confirmed VOA fee amount was found; third-party sources cite figures around USD 100 (USD 160 for US passport holders) but these are not confirmed on an official government page, so amount is left null. Payable in cash USD at the airport per third-party reporting.

variations.note: US passport holders charged USD 160 per Embassy of South Sudan (Washington DC) published fee schedule.
Rest of Africa, Asia, Gulf countries, Canadian, and European nationals charged USD 100 per Embassy of South Sudan published fee schedule. NGA falls under 'rest of Africa' (non-bordering).

SSD.free_visa_notes: East African Community (EAC) member state nationals and Egyptian nationals travel visa-free per the Embassy of South Sudan's published schedule. Diplomatic/official passport holders are exempt (gratis).

fees.name: eVisaST (online pre-visa application)
fees.validity: Single entry, valid 90 days from issue, stay up to 30 days
fees.notes: Official Serviço de Migração e Fronteiras (SMF) e-visa portal (smf.st) does not publish an online application fee; it states payment is made at the border ('O pagamento será feito na fronteira!'). No fee amount is disclosed on the official site or its Taxas (fees) page (smf.st/taxas.php), which lists only passport-issuance fees in STD, not visa fees.

fees.name: Tourist visa stamping fee (paid on arrival at airport)
fees.notes: Not confirmed on an official government page with an explicit amount; multiple third-party visa-guide sites (unofficial FAQ hosted alongside the e-visa guide, VisaHQ, iVisa) consistently cite a 20 EUR cash stamping fee collected by Immigration at São Tomé International Airport, payable in EUR, USD, or local Dobra. Children under 18 reportedly pay half. Treat as indicative, not officially verified, until confirmed directly on smf.st.

fees.name: Business visa stamping fee (paid on arrival at airport)
fees.notes: Same caveat as tourist visa: figure comes from an unofficial visa-guide FAQ, not directly confirmed with an amount on the official smf.st site.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (limited nationalities, e.g. Chinese ordinary passport holders)
fees.notes: Sources indicate holders of ordinary Chinese passports (and some other nationalities) may obtain a visa on arrival for up to 15 days, but no official fee schedule was found; amount left unverified.

STP.free_visa_notes: EU, CPLP (Community of Portuguese Language Countries), and reportedly US/Canadian passport holders can enter visa-free for stays up to 15 days per some sources, though this is not confirmed with a fee amount on an official page since no fee applies to visa-exempt entrants. No reciprocity fee schedule by nationality was found on any official source; the official SMF e-visa portal (smf.st) does not publish itemized visa fees online, stating only that payment occurs at the border.

fees.name: Entry Fee (formerly E-Tourist Card)
fees.notes: Plus a non-refundable online processing/service fee of USD 14 (or USD 18 per the fee-schedule page, which appears to be the standardized service fee for all application types). Payable in USD or EUR (EUR 35 for the entry fee itself).

fees.name: Entry Fee (single entry, general)
fees.notes: Also payable as EUR 50. Plus service fee (see vfs.service_fee).

fees.name: Multiple Entry Fee (5 Entries)
fees.notes: Also payable as EUR 75. Plus service fee.

fees.name: Business Visa - 3 months validity
fees.notes: Also payable as EUR 85. Plus service fee.

fees.name: Business Visa - 5 years validity
fees.notes: Also payable as EUR 305. Plus service fee.

fees.name: Tourist Visa - 3 months
fees.notes: Also payable as EUR 50. Multiple entry, max stay 90 days. Plus service fee.

fees.name: Tourist Visa - 1 Year
fees.notes: Also payable as EUR 175. Multiple entry, max stay 90 days. Plus service fee.

fees.name: Transit Visa
fees.notes: Also payable as EUR 10. Single entry. Plus service fee.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival (diplomatic/service/official/Interpol passport holders only)
fees.notes: Standard tourist visa-on-arrival was discontinued in October 2019; only this narrow diplomatic/official category remains eligible at the airport. No official fee amount was found published by an official source, so amount is left null.

variations.note: 5-year multiple-entry Business Visa for USA passport holders costs USD 160 versus the general rate of USD 360, per the official VFS Global Suriname e-Visa fee schedule.

vfs.note: VFS Global is the official government-authorized partner operating Suriname's e-Visa/Entry Fee portal. A non-refundable online processing/service fee applies to all application types: the Entry Fee (tourist card) page states USD 14 (EUR equivalent not separately listed), while the general fee-schedule page lists a flat service fee of USD 18 or EUR 17 for all application types. This is charged in addition to the visa/entry fee itself.

SUR.free_visa_notes: Suriname is not visa-free for most nationalities; most travelers require either an Entry Fee (tourist card, for ~52 eligible nationalities) or a full e-Visa/tourist visa. Nationals of some countries (e.g., other CARICOM/regional states) may be visa-exempt per Suriname's visa policy, but no official fee-schedule source enumerating a visa-free list was captured in this research; consult the official portal's nationality list for exemptions.

fees.name: Schengen Short-Stay Visa (Type C) - standard fee
fees.validity: Short-stay, up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Slovakia is a Schengen member and applies the common EU short-stay visa fee. Fee confirmed via European Commission Migration and Home Affairs official page; could not independently confirm on mzv.sk (Slovak MFA site returned 403 to automated fetch).

fees.name: Schengen Short-Stay Visa (Type C) - child fee (6-12 years)
fees.validity: Short-stay, up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Children under 6 are generally exempt from the fee under EU visa code, but this was not independently verified on a Slovak-specific source.

fees.name: Schengen Airport Transit Visa (Type A)
fees.notes: Airport transit visas typically fall under the same €90 standard Schengen fee schedule, but a Slovakia/EU-specific amount could not be independently confirmed on an official source in this research pass. Left null rather than guessed.

fees.name: Schengen Short-Stay Visa (business purpose)
fees.validity: Short-stay, up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Business travel uses the same Schengen Type C visa category and standard fee; no separate business-visa fee schedule found.

variations.note: Reduced Schengen visa fee under EU visa facilitation agreements, per European Commission Migration and Home Affairs page.
Reduced Schengen visa fee under EU-Cabo Verde visa facilitation agreement.

vfs.service_fee: 30 EUR (destination-country base) plus local service charge that varies by centre, e.g. approx INR 1750-2200 for applicants filing in India
vfs.note: VFS Global operates Slovakia's outsourced visa application centres in numerous countries. The service fee is charged in addition to the €90/€45 Schengen visa fee and varies by application centre/country; amounts above are indicative figures found via web search, not independently verified against a live official VFS Slovakia fee page (vfsglobal.com pages returned 403 to automated fetch in this research pass).

SVK.free_visa_notes: Not applicable — Slovakia requires a Schengen short-stay visa for non-exempt nationalities. Many nationalities are visa-exempt for short stays under the EU visa-exemption list and pay no fee at all in that case; this record covers the fee schedule for nationalities that DO require a visa.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C)
fees.validity: up to 90 days within any 180-day period
fees.notes: Uniform Schengen visa fee, applies to Slovenia as a Schengen member state. Confirmed on Slovenia's official government portal (gov.si) as well.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - child 6-12
fees.validity: up to 90 days within any 180-day period
fees.notes: Children under 6 are exempt from the fee.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.notes: Official source confirms airport transit visas exist and are exempt from prior consultation requirements, but does not publish a distinct fee; in practice the standard EUR 90 Schengen visa fee schedule applies to transit visas issued under the common Schengen rules. Left null pending a source that states the transit-specific figure explicitly.

variations.note: Reduced Schengen visa fee under EU visa facilitation agreements, per European Commission Migration and Home Affairs and gov.si.
Reduced Schengen visa fee under EU-Cabo Verde visa facilitation agreement.

vfs.service_fee: ~90-110 (varies by country, e.g. approx USD 105 in the USA)
vfs.currency: local currency of centre (e.g. USD in USA)
vfs.note: VFS Global operates outsourced visa application centres for Slovenia in many countries. Service fee is charged in addition to the EUR 90 official visa fee and varies by country/centre; could not confirm an authoritative published figure via a directly-fetchable official VFS page (visa.vfsglobal.com returned 403 to automated fetch), so this figure is drawn from a secondary aggregator summarizing VFS USA pricing and should be treated as indicative only.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (up to 90 days) - adult
fees.validity: Up to 90 days within a 180-day period
fees.notes: Common EU Schengen short-stay visa fee, raised to EUR 90 for adults effective June 2024. Sweden is a full Schengen member and applies the common EU fee schedule; fee is non-refundable if rejected.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa - child 6-11 years
fees.validity: Up to 90 days within a 180-day period
fees.notes: Half the adult common Schengen fee.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa - child 0-5 years
fees.validity: Up to 90 days within a 180-day period
fees.notes: Fee waived for young children.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa - business purpose
fees.validity: Up to 90 days within a 180-day period
fees.notes: Same fee schedule and application type as the tourist Schengen visa; category is set by purpose of travel, not a separate fee tier.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (ATV)
fees.notes: Standard Schengen visa fee applies to airport transit visas as well; exact amount not separately itemised on the source page, recorded at common Schengen rate pending direct confirmation.

fees.name: ETIAS travel authorisation (future requirement for visa-exempt travellers)
fees.notes: ETIAS is an EU-wide (not Sweden-specific) pre-travel authorisation for visa-exempt nationals, not yet enforced as of 2026-07-02 per official rollout guidance; fee amount left null pending an official EU/ETIAS launch confirmation. Do not confuse with the Schengen visa fee above.

variations.note: Citizens of countries with an EU Visa Facilitation Agreement (Albania, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Cape Verde, North Macedonia, Moldova, Montenegro, Serbia, Ukraine) pay a reduced Schengen visa fee; exact reduced amount not published on the Migrationsverket summary page - applicants directed to contact the relevant Swedish embassy/consulate for the specific figure.

vfs.note: VFS Global operates Swedish visa application centres in many source countries (including India, Nigeria, Bangladesh, Philippines, and others). Published one-pager quotes a service fee of approx EUR 21 / USD 24.44 in addition to the Migrationsverket visa fee; the exact amount varies by country/centre and is typically charged in local currency at the centre's rate.

SWE.free_visa_notes: Sweden is a full Schengen Area member; nationals of many countries (EU/EEA, and a long visa-waiver list including USA, CAN, GBR, NZL, JPN, KOR and others) do not need a visa for short stays up to 90/180 days and pay no fee, though ETIAS authorisation will eventually apply to those visa-exempt travellers once enforced EU-wide.

fees.name: Single-entry visa (tourist/business/volunteer/intern), 3 months
fees.notes: Fee published in Emalangeni (E80). Same visa covers tourist, business, volunteer and intern visits up to 30 days stay per entry. SZL is pegged 1:1 to ZAR.

fees.name: eVisa (evisa.gov.sz, pilot programme)
fees.notes: Official eVisa portal launched Aug 2025 (pilot); tourist, business, student and transit categories exist, but the portal does not publish the fee schedule publicly - fee is shown inside the application dashboard. Amount unverified, so left null.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (prior authorisation)
fees.notes: Visa-upon-arrival is possible only in certain circumstances with prior authorisation; no general VOA scheme and no separate fee published (standard visa fees presumed to apply).

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Transit visas exist but the Ministry of Home Affairs page does not publish a separate transit fee; amount unverified.

SWZ.free_visa_notes: Citizens of most Commonwealth countries, the USA, Japan and most EU countries do not need a visa for short stays. The Ministry also exempts visa fees for officials on official government duty, UN passport holders, and delegates on official business with His Majesty's Office.

fees.name: Travel Authorisation (Tourist Visa Exempt Entry)
fees.validity: Single entry; visitor's permit initially valid up to 3 months on arrival
fees.notes: Seychelles is visa-free for virtually all nationalities. Every traveller must instead obtain an online Travel Authorisation before departure via the official Seychelles Electronic Border System (SEBS, govtas.com) or the Seychelles E-Border app. Standard application fee is EUR 10.90 per person; some third-party trackers report total charges up to ~EUR 12.06 after processing add-ons, but the official government-stated standard fee is EUR 10.90.

fees.name: Visitor's Permit (issued on arrival)
fees.validity: Up to 3 months, extendable to a total of 12 months (extension incurs a fee)
fees.notes: Free of charge on first issuance. Extensions beyond the initial period are charged; exact extension fee not confirmed from an accessible official source (fee schedule PDF at ics.gov.sc/downloads/service-fees could not be parsed as text).

fees.name: Visa (Kosovo passport holders only)
fees.notes: Seychelles is visa-free for all nationalities except passport holders from Kosovo, who require a visa. Official source states this exception but does not publish the fee amount online; could not verify a specific figure from an official source, so amount left null rather than guessed.

SYC.free_visa_notes: Seychelles operates a visa-free entry policy for all nationalities except Kosovo. In place of a visa, all travellers must obtain an online Travel Authorisation (EUR 10.90, official standard fee per the Ministry of Foreign Affairs) before departure, after which a free Visitor's Permit is issued on arrival. No reciprocity-based fee variations by nationality were found on official sources — the EUR 10.90 Travel Authorisation fee applies uniformly.

fees.name: Entry visa (single-entry, up to 15 days) - Group 8 (e.g. USA)
fees.notes: Reported by travel-agency and news sites as issued under Syrian Ministry of Interior Decree No. 148/8 (effective July 6, 2025), applying entry visa fees at all airports and land borders by nationality-based reciprocity tiers. Could not independently verify on an official Syrian government portal - evisa.sy shows 'Coming Soon' and returned a certificate error; mofaex.gov.sy (Ministry of Foreign Affairs eServices) had no fee schedule; the U.S. Embassy Damascus visas page returned an error page. Amount unverified against a primary source; treat as indicative only.

fees.name: Entry visa (single-entry, up to 15 days) - unlisted nationalities
fees.notes: Same caveat as above - secondary-source reporting only, not confirmed on an official Syrian government page.

fees.name: eVisa (Syria eVisa platform)
fees.notes: Official Syria eVisa portal (evisa.sy) currently displays 'eVisa Coming Soon' - the platform is not operational as of 2026-07-02, so no current official e-visa fee can be confirmed. A prior version of the platform (from May 2024) existed but appears to have been taken down/relaunched under the transitional government.

variations.note: Reported under Group 4 ($75, 15 days) in secondary reporting of Decree No. 148/8; not verified on an official source.

Reported under Group 8 ($300, 15 days) in some secondary sources; other secondary sources cite $200 single-entry / $400 multiple-entry for US citizens. Figures are inconsistent across non-official sources and unverified officially.
Reported under Group 7 ($250, 15 days) in secondary reporting; not verified on an official source.
Reported under Group 3 ($40, 15 days) in secondary reporting; not verified on an official source.
Reported under Group 6 ($150, 15 days) in secondary reporting; not verified on an official source.
Reported under Group 4 ($75, 15 days) in secondary reporting; not verified on an official source.
Reported under Group 6 ($150, 15 days) in secondary reporting; not verified on an official source.

SYR.free_visa_notes: Some nationalities (e.g. Jordan, Lebanon, Malaysia, Mauritania per secondary reporting - 'Group 1') are reported as visa-fee-exempt for stays up to 6 months, but this has not been confirmed on an official Syrian government source. No official confirmation exists that Syria has a general visa-free regime; a visa (paid, reciprocity-tiered) is understood to be required for most nationalities under Ministry of Interior Decree No. 148/8 (reported effective 2025-07-06), pending official verification. IMPORTANT: This entire fee schedule is sourced from post-2024-transition secondary/travel-industry reporting because Syria's official e-visa portal (evisa.sy) is not operational and no other official fee schedule could be located as of 2026-07-02. Confidence is set to low; this record should be re-verified once evisa.sy or another official Syrian government page publishes a fee table.

fees.name: Chad e-Visa (short stay, all ordinary visa categories via evisa.td)
fees.validity: short-stay e-visa previously issued as 90-day multiple-entry; validity under new May 2026 tariff schedule not publicly enumerated
fees.notes: Since 11 May 2026 ALL Chad visa applications (tourist, business, transit, etc.) must be made online via the official portal evisa.td under a new fee schedule (Arrete conjoint n.033/PR/PM/MFBEPCI/MSPI/2026); visas issued outside the platform after 21 May 2026 are invalid. The portal does NOT publish the new tariff grid publicly - fees are shown only inside the application flow - so amounts cannot be verified on an official source. At launch (2024-2025) the officially communicated price for the 90-day multiple-entry short-stay e-visa was EUR 100 / ~65,000 XAF (media reports of the official launch; travellers reported paying ~67,500 XAF incl. service charge), but this may have changed under the May 2026 grille tarifaire.

fees.name: Embassy sticker visa (discontinued)
fees.notes: Embassy-issued visas and manual entry authorisations were abolished effective 11/21 May 2026; only diplomatic and courtesy visas remain with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (free of charge). Embassy visas issued before that date remain valid until expiry.

fees.name: Visa on arrival / manual entry authorisation (abolished)
fees.notes: The official announcement states manual entry authorisations are definitively abolished ('les autorisations manuelles d'entree sur le territoire sont definitivement supprimees'); travellers must obtain the e-visa before arrival.

TCD.free_visa_notes: Nationals of 24 states/territories are visa-exempt per the official portal: Barbados, Benin, Bermuda, Cameroon, Congo, Cote d'Ivoire, Dominica, Gabon, Gambia, Equatorial Guinea, Haiti, Mauritius, Cook Islands, Malaysia, Mali, Micronesia, Niger, Nigeria, Central African Republic, Rwanda, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Singapore, Suriname, Togo.

fees.name: Tourist e-Visa (single entry, 15 days)
fees.notes: Togo's official e-visa portal (voyage.gouv.tg / dgdn.gouv.tg) confirms all foreign nationals must obtain an e-visa and that fees apply, but its published pages are JavaScript-rendered and did not expose exact fee figures to automated fetch. This amount (25,000 XOF, ~USD 40) is corroborated by multiple third-party visa-service aggregators citing the government eVisa fee schedule; treat as indicative pending direct confirmation on voyage.gouv.tg.

fees.name: Tourist e-Visa (multiple entry, 30 days)
fees.notes: Reported as USD 80 by aggregator sources; some list 45,000 XOF for this tier and others cite differing XOF/USD splits. Not independently confirmed on the official government portal - verify directly at voyage.gouv.tg before relying on this figure.

fees.name: Tourist e-Visa (multiple entry, 90 days)
fees.notes: Reported as USD 115 by aggregator sources; XOF figure (65,000) reported by another aggregator for the same tier. Not independently confirmed on the official government portal - verify directly at voyage.gouv.tg before relying on this figure.

fees.name: Business visa
fees.notes: Official DGDN (Direction Générale de la Documentation Nationale) page confirms a business visa category exists and is subject to fees, but does not publish an amount. No verified figure found.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No official published fee amount found for a transit visa category.

TGO.free_visa_notes: Togo operates ECOWAS free movement for other ECOWAS member-state nationals (no visa required). All other nationalities generally require a visa, obtainable via the official e-visa portal (voyage.gouv.tg) administered by DGDN; no reciprocity/nationality-based fee schedule was found on official sources. No VFS or other outsourced visa application centre was identified for Togo - applications are processed directly online or via the DGDN office/embassies.

fees.name: Tourist Visa (embassy/consulate-issued, single entry, incl. e-Visa applications submitted via thaievisa.go.th)
fees.notes: Government fee schedule from Bangkok Immigration Division 1 lists Tourist Visa issuance at 1,000 THB per entry. This is the domestic issuing/changing-type-of-visa fee; consular tourist visa fees charged abroad may differ by embassy/consulate and were not separately confirmed on an official page during this check.

fees.name: Thailand e-Visa (Ministry of Foreign Affairs online application, thaievisa.go.th)
fees.notes: The official MFA e-Visa portal (thaievisa.go.th) requires selecting nationality and visa category before a fee is shown; no fixed published fee table found on the public pages during this check. Third-party sources cite figures around USD 40-99 depending on nationality/processing speed, but these are NOT official and were not used. Treat the underlying visa-category fee (e.g. Tourist Visa 1,000 THB per the Immigration Bureau fee schedule) as the closest official reference.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival
fees.validity: 15 days, single entry, cannot be extended
fees.notes: 2,000 THB, payable in cash (THB only) at the immigration counter on arrival; non-refundable even if refused. Fee has been periodically waived for specific periods/nationalities by Thai government notification - travellers should check current waiver status before travel.

fees.name: eTA / electronic travel authorisation
fees.notes: Thailand does not operate a separate eTA scheme distinct from its e-Visa system as of this check. Visa-exempt travellers instead complete the free Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) online, which carries no fee.

fees.name: Non-Immigrant Visa (Business/B category), single entry
fees.notes: Multiple entry: 5,000 THB per year (or 5,000 THB per 3 years for APEC-member nationals).

fees.name: Transit Visa
fees.validity: 90 days from issue date, max 30 days per stay
fees.notes: 800 THB per entry.

variations.note: VFS Global India cites Thailand Tourist Visa (single entry) fee of INR 2,500 (multiple entry INR 12,000), separate from the VFS logistics/service charge. Indian ordinary-passport holders also benefit from a visa-exemption arrangement for short tourist stays under current Thai government notifications, effective from mid-2024; verify current exemption status before assuming a visa is required.

vfs.note: VFS Global is the official visa outsourcing partner for the Royal Thai Embassy in India. Service/logistics fee varies by centre: approx. INR 250 at Mumbai/Pune/Goa/Ahmedabad centres, INR 500 at Chennai/Cochin/Bengaluru/Hyderabad centres, charged in addition to the government visa fee (e.g. INR 2,500 for single-entry tourist visa). Fee levels are third-party-reported based on a VFS notice; confirm current amount on the VFS India-Thailand portal before relying on it.

THA.free_visa_notes: Thailand is visa-free/visa-exempt on arrival for many nationalities (durations vary, commonly 30-60 days) under bilateral agreements; visa-exempt travellers must instead complete the free online Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) before arrival, which carries no fee. This record covers only fees for travellers who DO require a visa or VOA.

fees.name: Single-entry e-visa
fees.notes: Amount consistently reported by third-party visa-guide sources (evisaguides.com, tajikistan-evisa.com, traveldoc.aero). Could not independently confirm the fee schedule text on evisa.tj because the official site loads its content via client-side JavaScript that could not be rendered by automated fetch. Treat as high-likelihood but unverified-official; re-check directly on evisa.tj before relying on it.

fees.name: Multiple-entry e-visa
fees.notes: Reported by third-party sources; same rendering limitation as single-entry e-visa above. Not independently confirmed on the official portal text.

fees.name: GBAO (Gorno-Badakhshan Autonomous Region) permit add-on
fees.notes: Add-on permit fee on top of the e-visa fee, reported by third-party sources ($20-30 range cited); could not confirm exact current amount on the official portal directly.

fees.name: Standard consular visa (embassy-issued), USA nationals
fees.validity: up to 1 year (visa types K, KhS1, O1, O2)
fees.notes: Official published consular fee schedule at the Embassy of Tajikistan to the USA, dated 25.11.2019 (still live on the embassy site as of 2026-07-02, not confirmed re-dated). Fee is set per bilateral reciprocity with the USA and is notably higher than for most other nationalities. Visa type 'M'/'TB' (business/work-related) is 190 USD; minor-citizen visas of any type are 160 USD.

fees.name: Standard consular visa (embassy-issued), USA nationals - business/work type (M, TB)
fees.notes: Official embassy-published fee for visa types 'M' and 'TB' issued to US citizens.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (airport)
fees.notes: Reported by a visa-service intermediary, not confirmed on a government source. Tajikistan's visa-on-arrival availability is limited and nationality-dependent; verify eligibility and current fee directly with the airport immigration authority or MFA before travel.

variations.note: Official embassy-published reciprocity fee for US citizens (visa types K/KhS1/O1/O2, up to 1 year) is markedly higher than the general e-visa fee; business/work types (M/TB) are 190 USD. Source: mfa.tj Washington consular fees page.

fees.name: Single-entry visa, 10-day validity (normal processing)
fees.notes: Embassy sticker visa priced by validity/entry type rather than by 'tourist' category; requires a Letter of Invitation from a registered Turkmen travel agency. Same schedule published on US embassy site (usa.tmembassy.gov.tm). Longer validities and multiple-entry cost more (up to $385 single-entry / $515 multiple-entry for 12 months); expedited (1-3 day) processing costs an additional 100% surcharge. Children 7-16 pay 50%, under 7 free.

fees.name: Single-entry visa, 1-year validity (normal processing)
fees.notes: Top end of single-entry fee range; see full table on source for all validity tiers (10 days to 12 months).

fees.name: Transit visa, up to 5 days, one-time (normal processing)
fees.notes: Urgent/expedited processing costs $55 instead.

fees.name: E-visa (planned, not yet operational)
fees.notes: Turkmenistan's April 2025 visa-reform law authorizes creation of an e-visa system, but as of mid-2026 the platform (evisa.gov.tm or similar) has not launched and no Presidential decree setting e-visa fees, categories, or validity has been published. Do not treat as available; amount left null pending official launch.

TKM.free_visa_notes: No researched official source indicates any nationality travels visa-free to Turkmenistan; all foreign visitors require a visa (sticker visa via embassy, requiring a Letter of Invitation from a registered local travel agency) or, in future, an e-visa once the pending system launches. No nationality-differentiated (reciprocity) fee schedule was found on official Turkmen embassy pages checked (US, India) - both list the identical validity-based fee table, suggesting fees are uniform across nationalities rather than reciprocity-based. This could not be independently confirmed for all key nationalities (GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, RUS, CAN) via official sources within this research pass.

fees.name: Tourist Visa (visa on arrival / issuance)
fees.notes: Fee is USD $30, payable in cash, usually collected on arrival at Presidente Nicolau Lobato International Airport or Dili Sea Port. No e-visa system exists as of 2026-07-02; land border entrants for most nationalities must obtain a Visa Application Authorization in advance but pay the same fee on arrival.

fees.name: Tourist Visa Extension
fees.notes: May be extended once for a further 30 days at USD $40.

fees.name: Business Visa Class I (VNG1)
fees.notes: For short-term business/prospecting visits.

fees.name: Business Visa Class II (VNG2)
fees.validity: 6 months initial, extendable up to 2 years, multiple entries
fees.notes: Extension fee also USD $150.

fees.name: Transit Visa
fees.validity: Max 72 hours, up to two entries
fees.notes: Extension fee also USD $20, generally not permitted except under article 51 exceptions.

TLS.free_visa_notes: Portuguese and United States nationals, and Timorese nationals holding Portuguese passports, are exempt from visa requirements for tourism. No reciprocity-based fee schedule (e.g. differing amounts for IND, GBR, CHN, etc.) was found on official sources; the flat USD fee schedule above applies uniformly to non-exempt nationalities. No official e-visa or eTA system exists as of 2026-07-02; all listed fees are collected via on-arrival/embassy processing by the Immigration Service of Timor-Leste. No VFS/TLScontact/BLS outsourced visa centre found for Timor-Leste.

fees.name: Visitor visa on arrival (eligible nationalities)
fees.notes: Official Ministry of Revenue & Customs page lists eligible nationalities for a free 30-day visitor visa on arrival and does not state a fee amount, implying no charge for this category. Unofficial travel-agency sources cite a fee of approximately TOP$69, but this could not be verified on any official government page, so amount is left null pending confirmation.

fees.name: Entry permit (visa) for non-exempt nationalities
fees.notes: Official source states an entry permit must be obtained in advance from the Immigration Department (contact: tongapermit@gmail.com) but does not publish a fee schedule online. No official fee amount could be verified.

fees.name: Visa/stay extension
fees.notes: Official page describes the extension process (apply at Immigration Office, Nuku'alofa or Neiafu) but does not publish an extension fee. Third-party sources cite approximately TOP 50, unverified on an official page, so left null.

TON.free_visa_notes: Tonga's Ministry of Revenue & Customs page lists a large set of nationalities (including AUS, NZL, USA, GBR, CAN, JPN, most EU states, RUS, and Pacific island states) that receive a 30-day visitor visa on arrival with no fee stated, suggesting it is issued free of charge for these nationalities. Citizens of all other countries must obtain an entry permit in advance from the Immigration Department; no official published fee schedule for this permit or for visa extensions could be located, so those amounts are recorded as null rather than guessed. No VFS/outsourced visa centre is used by Tonga.

fees.name: eVisa (Multiple Entry) Application Fee
fees.validity: Duration of approved stay; multiple entry
fees.notes: ttconnect.gov.tt (official government portal) publishes TTD 400 non-refundable for the Multiple Entry eVisa. However, the Ministry of National Security's Immigration Division eVisa page states TTD 800 for the same Multiple Entry eVisa - the two official sources disagree, possibly reflecting a fee revision effective Jan 1, 2026 (first major revision since 2007) that has not been uniformly updated across government sites. Recorded here is the ttconnect figure; verify directly with immigration.visas@gov.tt before relying on this amount.

fees.name: eVisa (Multiple Entry) Application Fee - Ministry of National Security figure
fees.validity: Duration of approved stay; multiple entry
fees.notes: Ministry of National Security Immigration Division eVisa page states TTD 800 non-refundable, payable by Visa/Mastercard only. Conflicts with ttconnect.gov.tt's published TTD 400. Both are official .gov.tt sources; discrepancy unresolved as of this record's date.

fees.name: Tourist Visa - Single Entry (sticker/embassy-issued, third-party reported)
fees.notes: Third-party visa agency (VisaHQ) cites TTD 216.76 (~USD 32) single entry and TTD 433.53 (~USD 64) multi-entry, but this could not be confirmed on any official Trinidad and Tobago government source (nationalsecurity.gov.tt, ttconnect.gov.tt, foreign.gov.tt all lack a published sticker-visa fee schedule). Amount set to null per accuracy rules pending official confirmation.

fees.name: Business Visa
fees.notes: Third-party aggregator (visarun.ai) cites a USD 60-120 range for business visas, but no official Trinidad and Tobago government source publishes a separate business visa fee schedule; the eVisa system does not appear to break out a distinct business-visa fee from the standard multiple-entry eVisa fee. Amount set to null pending official confirmation.

fees.name: Transit Visa
fees.notes: No official source found publishing a distinct transit visa fee for Trinidad and Tobago. Not confirmed.

TTO.free_visa_notes: Trinidad and Tobago operates a nationality-based visa-required/visa-free list; CARICOM nationals and many Commonwealth, EU and other listed countries' nationals do not require a visa for short tourist stays. Visa-required nationals must apply via the eVisa system (evisa.ttservices.online, linked from nationalsecurity.gov.tt and ttconnect.gov.tt). No VFS Global, TLScontact, or BLS International outsourced visa centre was found for Trinidad and Tobago - applications are processed directly online through the government eVisa portal or through Trinidad and Tobago diplomatic missions abroad. No official reciprocity fee schedule by nationality (e.g. differing fees for IND, USA, GBR, CHN, etc.) was located on any government source; if one exists it was not published on nationalsecurity.gov.tt, ttconnect.gov.tt, or foreign.gov.tt at the time of this record.

fees.name: Tunisia sticker visa - single entry
fees.notes: Fee published by the Tunisian Embassy in the United States; fee applies to tourist, business, and transit visa types per the embassy page. Fees may differ at other Tunisian embassies/consulates worldwide - this is not a universal fee schedule. Payment by money order only; fees non-refundable.

fees.name: Tunisia sticker visa - multiple entry
fees.notes: Fee published by the Tunisian Embassy in the United States. Fees may differ at other Tunisian embassies/consulates worldwide.

fees.name: Tunisia business visa
fees.notes: Embassy page states current visa fees ($90 single entry / $180 multiple entries) apply to all visa types including business, but does not itemize a separate business-visa fee. Could not verify a distinct official amount.

fees.name: Tunisia transit visa
fees.notes: Embassy page states fees apply for all visa types (tourist/business/transit) at $90/$180, but does not itemize transit separately. Amount not independently verified from an official transit-specific schedule.

fees.name: Tunisia e-Visa
fees.notes: Tunisia launched an e-visa platform (evisa.tn) following a 2024 international tender for a short-stay single-entry tourism e-visa (processed in ~3 working days). Could not verify the official fee amount: evisa.tn returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch and no independent official source confirmed a specific fee figure as of 2026-07-02. Do not treat as free - amount is unverified, not zero.

TUN.free_visa_notes: Tunisia has a visa-exempt list for many nationalities (e.g. most EU, US territories arrangements vary); this record covers fees only for nationalities that require a visa. No universal free-visa regime exists for all travellers.

fees.name: Turkey e-Visa (evisa.gov.tr)
fees.validity: Typically 180 days from issue, single or multiple entry depending on nationality; stay length varies by nationality (commonly up to 30 or 90 days)
fees.notes: Official portal states the fee 'varies according to country of travel document and type of travel document' and is only revealed after selecting nationality in the application form - no published flat rate or public price list exists. Third-party sources report a wide range (approx. USD 20-96 depending on nationality; e.g. ~USD 43 commonly cited for Indian passport holders) but these are NOT confirmed on an official government page, so amount is left null. Do not treat third-party figures as authoritative.

fees.name: Sticker (consular) tourist visa - non-e-visa eligible nationalities
fees.notes: Base adult visa fee shown on a VFS Global country-specific 'visa fees at a glance' page (Czech Republic applicants): EUR 80 for adults, EUR 40 for children aged 6-12, free under 6, EUR 35 for certain reduced-fee nationalities (e.g. Albania, Bosnia-Herzegovina, North Macedonia). Consular visa fees are reciprocity-based and vary by applicant nationality and VFS jurisdiction - this is an illustrative example, not a universal rate. No single global official price list was found; the Turkish MFA directs applicants to a fee PDF that could not be verified as current (the fetched copy was dated 2014 and is outdated).

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: MFA confirms transit visa requirements exist for certain nationalities but does not publish a specific fee amount on the general information page; no current official fee schedule could be located.

variations.note: Multiple third-party visa-agency sites (not official sources) commonly cite approx. USD 43 for Indian e-visa applicants in 2026, but this could not be confirmed on an official government page - amount left null per accuracy rules.

vfs.note: VFS Global operates Turkish visa application centres for many source countries. Published service/logistics fee is typically EUR 20-26 (inclusive of VAT) per application on top of the consular visa fee, but varies by centre/country - e.g. EUR 20 shown on the Czech Republic VFS page, EUR 26 cited in general search summaries. India-specific VFS fee (visa.vfsglobal.com/ind/en/tur) could not be retrieved (403 Forbidden) and was not confirmed.

TUR.free_visa_notes: Turkey is not visa-free for most nationalities but offers e-visa or visa-free entry to many countries depending on reciprocal agreements; this record does not cover visa-free eligibility, only fee schedules where a visa/e-visa is required.

fees.name: Visitor Permit (issued on arrival)
fees.notes: US Department of State travel advisory (official government source, not Tuvalu's own portal) states visitor permits are issued on arrival for a fee of AUD 100, valid up to one month. Tuvalu's own official immigration site (gov.tv, Immigration & Customs page) could not be reached during this research (DNS resolution failure) to independently confirm; this fee is corroborated by multiple secondary sources (ivisa, visaHQ) citing the same AUD 100 amount.

TUV.free_visa_notes: No separate embassy-issued tourist e-visa, eTA, or business visa fee schedule was found; Tuvalu appears to operate primarily an on-arrival visitor permit system (AUD 100) rather than a pre-arrival visa regime. Could not independently verify against Tuvalu's own official immigration portal (gov.tv) due to a DNS/connectivity failure during this research session; amount is corroborated by the US State Department and multiple secondary visa-information sites but should be re-verified against gov.tv when reachable.

fees.name: Visitor Visa - Single Entry (overseas application)
fees.validity: 3 months from issue, stay up to 90 days depending on nationality
fees.notes: Fee is NT$1,600 if applied for inside Taiwan; US$50 if applied for overseas. Official currency for overseas applications is USD per BOCA fee schedule.

fees.name: Visitor Visa - Multiple Entry (overseas application)
fees.validity: up to 3 years depending on nationality, stay up to 90 days per entry
fees.notes: Fee is NT$3,200 if applied for inside Taiwan; US$100 if applied for overseas.

fees.name: eVisa (online visitor visa)
fees.validity: typically 3 months from issue, stay per visa type
fees.notes: NT$1,600 base fee plus NT$46 online credit-card processing fee = NT$1,646 total. Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina, Colombia, Haiti, Mauritius, Montenegro, Panama, Peru, and Turkiye receive eVisas free of charge.

fees.name: Visa-on-arrival surcharge
fees.notes: Additional charge of NT$800 or US$24 on top of the applicable visa-type fee, per Article 4 of the BOCA visa fee schedule.

TWN.free_visa_notes: Taiwan operates a broad visa-exemption program (visa-free entry, typically 14-90 days depending on nationality) for many countries including most of the EU, USA, UK, Canada, Japan, Korea, Australia, and others; those travellers pay no visa fee. Fees above apply only to nationals who require a visa. BOCA's fee schedule references a general reciprocity clause (extra charge equal to what a country charges Taiwanese passport holders) but does not publish a country-by-country reciprocity fee table, so no verified per-nationality amounts (e.g. for IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, RUS, CAN) could be confirmed from an official source; reciprocity_variations left empty rather than guessed. Taiwan is not a Schengen member. No VFS/outsourced visa centre network was found for Taiwan visa applications; visas are processed directly by Taiwan's overseas missions (Taipei Economic and Cultural Offices) or via the official eVisa portal.

fees.name: Ordinary (Single Entry) e-Visa
fees.notes: As of Jan 2025, visa on arrival was abolished; all visitors must apply via the official e-visa portal visa.immigration.go.tz before arrival. Official notice warns any invoice above 50 USD for the Ordinary Visa indicates use of an unauthorised agent.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival
fees.notes: Visa on arrival was abolished as of January 2025; all applicants must now obtain an e-visa online prior to travel.

variations.note: US citizens are required to apply for the Multiple Entry Visa (100 USD, valid 12 months) for holiday/tourism purposes rather than the 50 USD single-entry Ordinary Visa, per the Tanzania Embassy in Washington D.C.

TZA.free_visa_notes: A 'Gratis Visa' (free) category exists on the official fee schedule for specific exempted cases (e.g. diplomatic/reciprocal arrangements), but standard tourist/business travel requires a paid e-visa for virtually all nationalities. No official reciprocity fee breakdown by nationality (India, UK, China, Nigeria, Pakistan, Philippines, Bangladesh, Russia, Canada) was found beyond the US-specific rate; these likely pay the standard 50 USD Ordinary Visa fee, but this was not independently confirmed on an official nationality-by-nationality schedule, hence amounts for those nationalities are not separately listed.

fees.name: Uganda Tourist Visa (single entry, e-visa)
fees.validity: Approval valid 90 days from approval; grants up to 3 months stay
fees.notes: Applied for online via visas.immigration.go.ug. Non-refundable; online payments subject to a bank/card surcharge.

fees.name: Transit Visa
fees.notes: Non-refundable; payments subject to a bank charge.

fees.name: East African Tourist Visa (Uganda/Kenya/Rwanda joint visa)
fees.validity: 90 days from date of issue, multiple entry within the 3-country bloc, not renewable
fees.notes: Covers Uganda, Kenya and Rwanda only; for tourism purposes, employment prohibited.

fees.name: Multiple-Entry Visa (6-12 months)
fees.notes: Also offered at 24 months for USD 200. Not a work permit.

fees.name: Multiple-Entry Visa (24 months)
fees.notes: Longer-validity tier of the multiple-entry visa.

UGA.free_visa_notes: Uganda operates a flat-fee e-visa system published by the National Citizenship and Immigration Control (NCIC) portal; no nationality-based reciprocity fee schedule was found on official sources for the tracked nationalities (IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, RUS, CAN) as of this record's date - all pay the same standard fees listed above. All applications are processed directly through the government e-visa portal (visas.immigration.go.ug); no VFS Global/TLScontact/BLS outsourced centre is used for Uganda visas.

fees.name: e-Visa (single entry, 30-day validity)
fees.notes: Consular fee doubles to $40 for urgent (1 working day) processing; non-urgent takes 3 working days.

fees.name: e-Visa (double entry, 30-day validity)
fees.notes: Consular fee doubles to $60 for urgent processing.

fees.name: Short-term (type C) visa - basic fee, regular service
fees.validity: up to 90 days within 180 days; issued for up to 6 months or longer per supporting docs
fees.notes: Fee doubles for expedited service (processed in up to 5 working days vs 10 for regular). Applied for at Ukrainian embassies/consulates or VFS-run Visa Application Centres.

fees.name: Transit (type B) visa - basic fee
fees.validity: each transit period max 5 days; visa itself valid up to 1 year
fees.notes: Single/double/multiple entry all charged the same basic $65 rate before reciprocity adjustment; fee doubles for expedited service.

fees.name: Short-term (type C) visa - business purpose, basic fee
fees.notes: Business is one of the C-type visa purpose categories; same basic fee schedule as tourist/short-term visas, subject to reciprocity.

fees.name: Emergency visa on arrival at Boryspil/Odesa international airports
fees.validity: issued by MFA visa divisions at the airport border checkpoints
fees.notes: This is not a general visa-on-arrival regime; it applies only in specific emergency circumstances at these two airports. amount_usd not set because official fee is published in UAH and rates fluctuate.

variations.note: Short-term (C) visa single entry $85; double entry $130 (per official reciprocal fee schedule via VFS-published Ukraine visa fee sheet).
Short-term (C) visa single entry $165; double entry $255.
Listed as 'no visa needed' in the official reciprocal fee schedule for short stays (visa-free/visa-waiver arrangement); not a paid visa fee.

vfs.note: Published VFS Global service fee for Ukraine visa applications in India is INR 2,970 per applicant (inclusive of INR 650 convenience charge), payable in addition to the consular visa fee. Service fees vary by country/centre; Ukraine visa applications are processed through VFS Global Visa Application Centres in 48 countries per the MFA's published VAC list.

UKR.free_visa_notes: Ukraine is not a Schengen member and has no visa-free regime for everyone; many nationalities (e.g. US, UK, Canada, EU/Schengen states) are visa-exempt for short stays per the reciprocal fee schedule, while others require a visa (embassy/VFS/e-visa) with fees as listed above. China, Nigeria, Philippines, Bangladesh, and Russia were not found within the retrieved portion of the official reciprocal fee PDF (a multi-page document); their reciprocity status/fee could not be confirmed from available official sources and is left unset rather than guessed.

fees.name: Uruguay Consular Visa (tourist)
fees.notes: Fee published by the Uruguayan Consulate General in Sydney; same amount stated for tourist, work, business, student, and congress/convention/seminar visas. Fee is charged in local currency at each consulate and 'subject to minor variation depending on the exchange rate between the Australian and US dollars', so amounts differ by issuing post. No single global flat-rate fee schedule was found on an official portal.

fees.name: Uruguay Consular Visa (business)
fees.notes: Same fee schedule as tourist visa at the Sydney consulate; amounts vary by issuing consulate/currency.

fees.name: No e-visa system
fees.notes: Uruguay does not operate an e-visa or electronic travel authorization (ETA) platform as of 2026. Travelers either enter visa-free or must obtain a conventional consular visa in advance. Could not verify this negative claim on an official gub.uy page directly (page fetch attempts on official consular sites returned errors); based on consistent secondary-source reporting only, so not marked official.

variations.note: Secondary sources (Embassy of Uruguay in India contact listings via search aggregators) report no visa fee is currently charged to Indian citizens for a Uruguay tourist visa, but this could not be independently confirmed by directly fetching the embassy's own page (page returned empty content). Treat as unverified.

Reported by secondary sources referencing the Embassy of Uruguay in New Delhi as the fee for citizens of Nepal, Maldives, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Bhutan. Could not be directly verified on an official embassy page (page fetch returned no content), so this figure is unverified and excluded from the official fees array.

URY.free_visa_notes: Uruguay operates a broad visa-free policy: the large majority of nationalities (around 80+ countries/jurisdictions) may enter visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days. Only a limited set of nationalities require a consular (sticker) visa obtained in advance from a Uruguayan embassy/consulate; no visa-on-arrival, eTA, or e-visa option exists. Fee amounts for the nationalities that do require a visa are set per-consulate in local currency and were not found published in one authoritative global schedule; the Sydney consulate's AUD 84 figure is the only fee amount independently confirmed on an official gub.uy page during this research.

fees.name: B1/B2 Nonimmigrant Visa (Machine Readable Visa / MRV application fee)
fees.validity: Varies by nationality (typically up to 10 years multiple entry for many countries)
fees.notes: Base MRV application fee is non-refundable and must be paid regardless of visa outcome. Some nationalities additionally pay a reciprocity issuance fee on top of this (see reciprocity_variations).

fees.name: C-1 Transit Visa (MRV application fee)
fees.notes: Same base non-petition MRV fee schedule as B1/B2.

fees.name: B1 Business Visa (MRV application fee)
fees.notes: B1 is combined with B2 on the same MRV fee schedule ($185).

fees.name: ESTA (Electronic System for Travel Authorization) - Visa Waiver Program
fees.validity: 2 years or until passport expiry, multiple entries, stays up to 90 days
fees.notes: ESTA fee increased from $21 to $40 (base) effective September 30, 2025 under recent budget/appropriations legislation. Independently reconfirmed directly on the official ESTA application portal (esta.cbp.dhs.gov), which currently states the total application fee is $40.27 USD. Corrected from a prior recorded value of $40 (which understated the confirmed current official amount).

USA.free_visa_notes: US visas are not free; MRV application fee ($185) applies to all nonimmigrant visa categories not covered by ESTA. Visa Waiver Program nationals traveling for tourism/business up to 90 days can instead use ESTA ($40) in lieu of a visa. Reciprocity issuance fees (charged after visa approval, varies by nationality per the DOS Visa Reciprocity Tables) were not itemized here for the specified key nationalities (IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, RUS, CAN) because official per-country reciprocity tables require individual lookups beyond this research pass; amounts range from $0 to over $200 depending on nationality and visa class. US visa applications are processed directly via US embassies/consulates and travel.state.gov appointment system, not through a third-party VFS/TLScontact/BLS outsourced centre.

fees.name: E-Visa - Single entry
fees.notes: Official portal is JS-rendered and could not be scraped directly; amount corroborated by multiple secondary sources (Advantour, TourFixer) citing the official e-visa.gov.uz fee schedule. Same fee regardless of nationality.

fees.name: E-Visa - Double entry
fees.validity: 90 days to use, 30 days stay per entry
fees.notes: Amount corroborated via secondary sources citing official portal; could not directly render e-visa.gov.uz fee page (JS app).

fees.name: E-Visa - Multiple entry
fees.validity: 90 days to use, 30 days stay per entry
fees.notes: Amount corroborated via secondary sources citing official portal; could not directly render e-visa.gov.uz fee page (JS app).

fees.name: Embassy-issued tourist visa - single entry (30 days)
fees.notes: Sourced from Embassy of Uzbekistan in the United States public visa page; treated as official-embassy but not independently re-verified line by line this session. Fee schedule varies by embassy/consulate.

fees.name: Embassy-issued tourist visa - double entry (30 days)
fees.notes: Embassy of Uzbekistan in the United States fee schedule.

fees.name: Embassy-issued tourist visa - triple entry (30 days)
fees.notes: Embassy of Uzbekistan in the United States fee schedule.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Could not verify a specific official transit-visa fee on official sources this session; amount left null rather than guessed.

fees.name: Business visa
fees.notes: Business e-visa exists on the official portal but specific fee could not be confirmed distinct from standard e-visa tiers this session; left null rather than guessed.

variations.note: Historical embassy fee for US citizens was $185 (higher due to reciprocity with US visa fees for Uzbek citizens). NOTE: Uzbekistan announced a visa abolition for US citizens for tourist visits up to 30 days, effective 1 January 2026 - US travellers should now be visa-free for short tourist stays; this reciprocity fee entry is retained for historical/edge-case reference only and should be re-verified.

vfs.note: VFS Global operates visa application centres for Uzbekistan for several countries (e.g. Ireland, Czech Republic, Hungary, UK, Finland application pages seen). Published service fee example: EUR 20 inclusive of VAT per application for Ireland-processed applications; fee varies by centre/country (Czech Republic example cites EUR 17). Not all Uzbekistan visa routes use VFS - e-visa applicants apply directly via e-visa.gov.uz.

UZB.free_visa_notes: Uzbekistan operates a broad visa-free regime for roughly 90 countries (durations 10-90+ days depending on nationality/bilateral agreement, commonly 30 days for USA/UK/EU/Japan/Australia/South Korea/GCC). Effective 1 January 2026, Uzbekistan abolished visa requirements for US citizens for tourist stays up to 30 days per a November 2025 presidential order. Citizens of ~80+ other countries not covered by the visa-free list can use the e-visa system; the remainder require an embassy-issued sticker visa.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (type C) via Italy
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Vatican City issues no visas of its own and has an open border with Italy. Entry is only possible through Italian/Schengen territory, so Italy's Schengen short-stay visa applies de facto. Adult fee EUR 90; children 6 to under 12 pay EUR 45; under 6 free (Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1415, in force since 11 June 2024).

fees.name: ETIAS travel authorisation (for visa-exempt nationalities entering via Italy)
fees.notes: EUR 20 fee confirmed by the European Commission; applicants under 18 or over 70 exempt. Applies to entry into Italy/Schengen, through which Vatican City is reached. Not yet in force as of this record's date.

fees.name: Schengen airport transit visa (type A) via Italy
fees.notes: Same harmonised Schengen fee schedule as the short-stay visa.

vfs.note: The Holy See has no visa application system; travellers needing a visa apply for an Italian Schengen visa. Italy outsources visa intake to VFS Global in many countries (e.g. India, China, Philippines); the service fee is set per centre and varies by country - check the local VFS Italy page. No single published amount is recorded here to avoid guessing.

VAT.free_visa_notes: Vatican City has no visa regime of its own: there are no border controls between Rome and the Vatican, and the Holy See issues no tourist visas. Entry requirements are those of Italy/the Schengen Area. Nationals who are Schengen visa-exempt pay nothing today (ETIAS EUR 20 once operational); others need an Italian Schengen visa (EUR 90 adult).

fees.name: Entry visa (Ministry of National Security / Foreign Affairs)
fees.notes: Non-refundable local fee of EC$200.00. Application is made to the Ministry of National Security in St. Vincent; Foreign Affairs arranges interview with sponsor. XCD is pegged at 2.70 per USD (~USD 74). No separate published business or transit visa fee schedule found on official sources.

VCT.free_visa_notes: Most nationalities (180+ countries) enter Saint Vincent and the Grenadines visa-free, typically for stays up to 90 days. Only a short list of nationalities requires an entry visa. There is no e-visa, eTA, or visa-on-arrival fee regime.

fees.name: Tourist e-Visa (TR-V) via Cancillería Digital
fees.validity: Single-entry typically 30-90 days; multi-entry options available up to 1 year with 90-day-per-visit limits
fees.notes: Venezuela's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MPPRE) launched a new online e-visa system (Cancillería Digital, cancilleriadigital.mppre.gob.ve) in April 2026, replacing the prior paper process. Immigration-law sources (Fragomen) and the U.S. Embassy in Caracas report the fee rose from USD 60 to USD 180, but this could not be independently confirmed on the official Cancillería Digital portal itself (the site did not return a public fee schedule via automated fetch). Treat this figure as provisional pending direct portal confirmation.

fees.name: Business e-Visa (TR-N) via Cancillería Digital
fees.validity: Similar to tourist e-visa; single or multi-entry options
fees.notes: Same online system and fee as the tourist e-visa per secondary immigration-law reporting; not independently verified on an official .gob.ve fee schedule.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: No evidence found of a visa-on-arrival option for Venezuela; visas must be obtained in advance via the Cancillería Digital e-visa portal or an embassy/consulate.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No official fee schedule for a Venezuelan transit visa could be located; could not verify whether a distinct transit visa category and fee currently exist.

VEN.free_visa_notes: Venezuela is not visa-free for most nationalities requiring advance visas; a subset of nationalities (largely regional/Latin American and some others) are visa-exempt for short tourist stays per Venezuela's visa policy, but this varies by nationality and was not exhaustively verified against an official government list for this record. No reciprocity-specific fee schedule (e.g., differing amounts for IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, RUS, CAN) could be located on official sources; the Cancillería Digital portal appears to charge a flat USD 180 fee regardless of nationality per secondary reporting, but this is unconfirmed directly.

fees.name: Vietnam e-Visa - single entry
fees.notes: Fee set by Ministry of Finance Circular No. 28/2026/TT-BTC (effective 1 Apr 2026), which replaced Circular 25/2021/TT-BTC and Circular 62/2023/TT-BTC. Paid online in USD at application on the official portal.

fees.name: Vietnam e-Visa - multiple entry
fees.notes: Fee set by Ministry of Finance Circular No. 28/2026/TT-BTC (effective 1 Apr 2026).

fees.name: Visa-on-arrival stamping fee - single entry
fees.notes: Stamping fee payable in cash (USD or VND) at the airport on arrival, separate from a private visa-letter service fee charged by travel/visa agents (not an official government fee, varies by agent). Same rate as the e-visa stamping fee under Circular 28/2026/TT-BTC.

fees.name: Visa-on-arrival stamping fee - multiple entry
fees.notes: Stamping fee payable in cash (USD or VND) at the airport on arrival.

fees.name: Embassy/consulate sticker visa (tourist) - single entry
fees.notes: Vietnamese embassies/consulates confirm fees follow the national stamping-fee schedule (Circular 28/2026/TT-BTC): USD 25 single-entry / USD 50 multiple-entry for standard processing; embassy pages do not publish a separate line-item fee table and direct applicants to the consular division. Expedited service may cost more.

fees.name: Embassy/consulate sticker visa (tourist) - multiple entry
fees.notes: Follows the national Circular 28/2026/TT-BTC stamping-fee schedule.

fees.name: Business visa (DN1/DN2) - embassy/e-visa route
fees.notes: Business visa stamping fee generally follows the same single/multiple-entry schedule (USD 25/50) under Circular 28/2026/TT-BTC, but an official line-item confirming this specific category was not located; set to null rather than guessed. Verify directly with the immigration department before publishing a firm number.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Most nationalities transiting Vietnam without leaving the international zone, or staying under visa-exempt transit rules, do not need a visa. No official fee schedule for a standalone transit visa was found on evisa.gov.vn; left null rather than guessed.

VNM.free_visa_notes: Vietnam unilaterally exempts a list of nationalities (e.g. many ASEAN countries, and since 2023 an extended list including most Western Europe, Japan, South Korea) from a visa for short stays (typically 45 days); those travellers pay no visa fee. All other nationalities must obtain an e-visa, embassy sticker visa, or (where eligible) visa-on-arrival, at the USD 25 (single-entry) / USD 50 (multiple-entry) government fee described above. No official, publicly documented nationality-specific fee variations (e.g. for IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, RUS, CAN) were found beyond this single/multiple-entry structure that applies uniformly to all fee-paying nationalities; Vietnam does not appear to operate a reciprocity-based differential fee schedule like some other countries.

fees.name: Tourist Visa (non-exempt nationalities)
fees.notes: Amount reported via search-indexed cache of the official Department of Immigration page (direct fetch returned 403); confirm on immigration.gov.vu/fees/ before quoting to travellers.

fees.name: Visitor Visa
fees.notes: Amount reported via search-indexed cache of the official Department of Immigration page (direct fetch returned 403); confirm on immigration.gov.vu/fees/ before quoting to travellers.

fees.name: Transit Visa
fees.validity: up to 24 hours, airport proclaimed area only
fees.notes: Amount reported via search-indexed cache of the official Department of Immigration page (direct fetch returned 403); confirm before quoting to travellers.

fees.name: Business Visa
fees.notes: Search-indexed sources gave conflicting figures (20,000 VUV or 35,000 VUV) which could not be reconciled against the live official fees page (immigration.gov.vu/fees/ returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch). Amount left null pending direct verification; do not guess between the two figures.

fees.name: eVisa (evisa.gov.vu)
fees.notes: Vanuatu operates an official eVisa portal (evisa.gov.vu) but the fetchable page content did not expose a fee schedule or nationality-based pricing table. Amount left null; needs a follow-up crawl of the portal's visa-type/eligibility subpages.

fees.name: No visa-on-arrival fee for exempt nationals
fees.validity: up to 90 days (typical for visa-exempt entry)
fees.notes: Visa-exempt nationals receive a free visitor permit stamp on arrival with no application and no fee; this is not a paid visa-on-arrival product.

VUT.free_visa_notes: Vanuatu grants visa-free entry (free visitor permit, no application, no fee) to citizens of 117 countries per the official visa-exempted-countries list. All other nationalities require a paid tourist/visitor visa. No evidence found of nationality-based reciprocity fee variations (e.g. for IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, RUS, CAN specifically) — these all appear to fall under either the exempt list or the standard non-exempt fee, but this was not independently confirmed against the exempt-country list contents. No VFS/TLScontact/BLS outsourced visa centre found; visas are processed directly by the Department of Immigration and Passport Services or via the official evisa.gov.vu portal. Direct WebFetch of immigration.gov.vu returned HTTP 403 (bot-blocked); all figures above come from search-engine cached extracts of the official pages and should be re-verified with a browser-based fetch or Firecrawl before being treated as final.

fees.name: Visitor's Permit (issued free on arrival)
fees.notes: Multiple secondary sources (Samoa Pocket Guide, thingstodoinsamoa.com, AE-SQUARE) consistently state Samoa issues a free 90-day Visitor's Permit on arrival for eligible nationalities, with no visa fee charged. Could not retrieve a readable official fee schedule from mpmc.gov.ws (Immigration Division, 403 on fetch) or a Contentful/PDF fee sheet to independently confirm the exact figure of 0, so official flag is left false pending direct confirmation.

fees.name: Visitor Permit extension
fees.notes: Reported extension fee of ST$100 (Samoan Tala) for extending a visitor permit beyond the initial free 90-day stay. Sourced from secondary travel-guide sites citing the Ministry of the Prime Minister and Cabinet (MPMC) Immigration Division; the MPMC official page (mpmc.gov.ws/divisions/immigration/) returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch so this could not be verified against the primary source in this session.

WSM.free_visa_notes: Samoa issues a free 90-day Visitor's Permit on arrival to most eligible nationalities (no visa application fee). No evidence found of a paid e-visa, eTA, or VFS-outsourced visa process for Samoa. Long-stay/work permits and visitor-permit extensions (reported ST$100) are outside the free entry-permit scope. Government primary source (mpmc.gov.ws Immigration Division) could not be fetched directly (403) to confirm exact figures, hence confidence is medium rather than high.

fees.name: Short-stay visa (Type C)
fees.validity: Up to 90 days within a 180-day period
fees.notes: Embassy-issued sticker visa; apply in person at a Kosovo diplomatic/consular mission up to 3 months before travel. Fee waived for children under 6, holders of diplomatic/official passports, and pupils/students/accompanying teachers on educational trips. Payment is made by bank transfer to the specific mission (bank details published per embassy). Kosovo is NOT a Schengen member, so the Schengen fee does not apply; however, holders of valid multi-entry Schengen visas or Schengen residence permits are visa-exempt for short stays.

fees.name: Short-stay visa (Type C) for business purposes
fees.validity: Up to 90 days within a 180-day period
fees.notes: Business travel uses the same Type C short-stay visa and fee; there is no separate business visa category or fee.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.notes: Kosovo legislation provides for a Type A airport transit visa, but no fee amount for Type A is published on the MFA/embassy fee pages consulted; amount left null rather than guessed. General MFA guidance lists 40 EUR as the standard visa fee.

XKX.free_visa_notes: Kosovo maintains a liberal visa regime: citizens of the EU/Schengen area, US, UK, Canada and many other states are visa-exempt, and holders of valid multi-entry Schengen visas or Schengen/EU residence permits may enter visa-free for up to 15 days. Visa fees are waived for children under 6, diplomatic/official passport holders, and students/teachers on educational trips. No e-visa, eTA or visa-on-arrival scheme exists; nationals requiring a visa must obtain an embassy-issued sticker visa. No published reciprocity-based fee differences by nationality — the flat 40 EUR (Type C) / 80 EUR (Type D) schedule applies to all.

fees.name: Embassy-issued single entry visa (USA - Washington DC)
fees.notes: Yemen Embassy in Washington DC states visa fee is $65 (money order), but the embassy is NOT currently issuing tourist visas due to the ongoing conflict/political situation; visas are largely restricted to persons of Yemeni origin, international-organization staff, journalists/media, and diplomats.

fees.name: Single entry visa - Embassy of Yemen in Poland
fees.notes: Fee reported via search snippet from official embassy site; not independently re-verified with a direct fetch.

fees.name: Single entry visa - Consulate General Frankfurt, Germany
fees.notes: Fee reported via search snippet from official consulate site; not independently re-verified with a direct fetch.

fees.name: Yemen e-Visa (yemenevisa.org)
fees.notes: Yemen's Immigration, Passports and Nationality Authority launched an e-visa portal (yemenevisa.org) around June 2025, but no fee schedule or online payment is currently published on the portal's visas/FAQ pages. Amount left null - could not verify.

YEM.free_visa_notes: Yemen is not visa-free for any major nationality. Due to the ongoing internal conflict, most Yemeni diplomatic missions (including the Washington DC embassy) have suspended issuance of tourist visas; visas are largely restricted to persons of Yemeni origin, international-organization staff, journalists/media delegates, and diplomats. No reciprocity-based fee schedule could be verified for IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, RUS, or CAN nationals; no VFS/outsourced visa centre was found for Yemen. A new e-visa portal (yemenevisa.org) exists but does not publish a verifiable fee schedule as of this record's date.

fees.notes: Base consular fee schedule published by the South African Embassy in Washington DC. Amounts are often waived (gratis) for specific nationalities under bilateral agreements (e.g. India) - see reciprocity_variations.

fees.notes: Official DHA eVisa portal does not publish a fixed fee schedule; the underlying visa-category fee (equivalent to the sticker-visa fee for the visa type applied for) applies but was not independently confirmed on the portal at time of writing. Set to null rather than guessed.

fees.name: South African Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA)
fees.notes: DHA has not published a fixed public ETA fee schedule as of 2026-07-02; fee is reportedly based on reciprocal visa-fee arrangements with each applicant's country and is only shown inside the application portal at payment step. Reported as free/gratis for Indian nationals at the Oct 2025 ETA launch, per secondary reporting - not independently confirmed on an official page with a fee figure, so amount left null.

variations.note: Visa fee is gratis (waived) for Indian nationals per VFS Global South Africa India visa-fees-at-glance page; applicant still pays the non-waivable VFS service/logistics fee (see vfs block).

vfs.note: Published VFS Global India logistics/service fee for South Africa visa applications: INR 2,040 (inclusive of taxes) at Delhi and Mumbai centres; INR 2,301 (inclusive of taxes) at other Indian centres (Gurgaon, Jaipur, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Pune, Goa, Bangalore). This service fee is separate from and additional to any government visa fee, is non-refundable, and is charged regardless of visa-fee waivers. South Africa also routes visa applications through VFS Global in numerous other source countries beyond India; fee schedules there were not individually re-verified in this pass.

ZAF.free_visa_notes: South Africa is not visa-free for most travellers requiring a visa/ETA; many nationalities (e.g. most EU, UK, USA, several SADC states) are visa-exempt for short tourist stays under separate visa-exemption rules and pay no visa fee at all (not applicable to this fee record). For nationalities that DO require a visa, the government sticker-visa fee schedule is USD 36 (short-stay) / USD 127 (long business) per the SA Embassy Washington schedule, with fee waivers (gratis) negotiated bilaterally for specific countries such as India.

fees.name: Single Entry e-Visa
fees.notes: Statutory fee $25 plus card-payment administrative fee; total shown ($50.50) is the card-payment total on the official pricing page. Mobile money payment total may be slightly lower. Applied for online via eservices.zambiaimmigration.gov.zm or on arrival.

Two separate listings (single-entry $25 base and multiple-entry $75 base) both appear on the official fee schedule; card-payment totals for double and multiple entry converge at $80.80 per the pricing page.

ZMB.free_visa_notes: Nationals of 53 countries are visa-exempt for stays up to 90 days per 12-month period per the official Zambia Department of Immigration visitor page. The official pricing page does not publish nationality-specific fee variations (e.g. no distinct IND/USA/GBR/CHN/NGA/PAK/PHL/BGD/RUS/CAN rates were found) - all listed fees appear to be flat rates for non-exempt nationalities requiring a visa. Zambia visa applications are processed directly through the government's own e-Services portal (eservices.zambiaimmigration.gov.zm); no outsourced visa application centre (VFS/TLScontact/BLS) is used.

Fee is stated on the application platform at time of applying.

ZWE.free_visa_notes: Zimbabwe operates a visa regime for most nationalities; it is not visa-free for the general population. Some nationalities (mostly African/COMESA/SADC states and a handful of others) are visa-exempt or visa-on-arrival eligible per the Department of Immigration's country list, but a paid visa/eVisa is required for the majority of travelers, including the key reciprocity nationalities checked in this record (IND, USA, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, RUS, CAN — all pay the standard USD 30 single-entry rate unless a higher category is chosen; only GBR and CHN have documented higher fixed rates).
